194000.description:
Despite living on an island, Do-Hyun's fear of the ocean after his father's drowning has kept him from learning how to swim. An energetic, ocean-loving tourist named Ji-Ho appears, throwing Do-Hyun off balance. They're opposites, but when disaster nearly strikes Do-Hyun finds himself getting caught up in Ji-Ho's current...

(Source: Manta)
synonyms: [2023 Beyond Short Stories] Riding Your Wave

title.native: 幸運の初期値が異常に高かった高校生が、缶詰ガチャで手に入れたスキルを使って現代ダンジョンで最強になる物語
title.romaji: Kouun no Shokichi ga Ijou ni Taka katta Koukousei ga, Kanzume Gacha de Te ni Ireta Skill wo Tsukatte Gendai Dungeon de Saikyou ni Naru Monogatari

194003.description:
Tang Yue had thought that she would be sold by her foster father for 30 million to a gay Huo Shengxuan as a nominal wife, which should be an easy job. But Huo Shengxuan arranged her to marry his half-brother Huo Shengzhi who onced served in the special force. Huo Shengzhi firmly objected the marriage due to remeberance of his late wife. However, as time went by and with the increasing interactions between the two, Huo Shengzhi found it difficult to let go of the coquetish young girl, Tang Yue.

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: Law of True Fragrance of Love

194004.description:
Onizuka Raita and his younger brother Fuuta are infamous at their high school for being tough alphas who aren't afraid to take names and kick butt. It's also public knowledge that they're both down bad for Kazusa, a delicate-looking, pretty omega. Despite his appearance, Kazusa has an unwavering sense of justice and chivalry. He wishes that he could be stronger and not be seen as another omega in need of protecting, but his world is shaken when he gets his first heat unexpectedly, and his doctor announces that his fated mate is likely nearby. What happens when Kazusa's suppressants go missing and his heat hits when he's alone with the Onizuka brothers?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Note:
- Originally published as a one-shot in LiQulle pathos Vol.2, later picked up for serialization.
- Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 俺たちはケモノじゃない

194005.description:
Yi just wants his romantic happily ever after with a handsome alpha. Unfortunately, he’s so tall for an omega that everyone thinks he’s an alpha. When he finally starts dating Keyao, a handsome, heroic, and kind alpha, his romance plans are back on track… until Keyao’s unexpected aversion to omegas spells the end of Yi’s dreamy dating life. But the two can’t seem to avoid each other and when back luck lands Yi in Keyao’s spare bedroom, will romance spark anew?!

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

194006.description:
1-4. Aisare Ganbou no Hime (愛され願望の姫); COMIC Magnum Vol. 159, 163, 167, 172
5. NOT Office Love Desu no De (NOTオフィスラブですので); COMIC Magnum Vol. 156
6. One More One Night Love (ワンモア・ワンナイトラブ); COMIC Magnum Vol. 152
7. Watashi Dake no Hero (私だけのヒーロー); COMIC Magnum Vol. 176
synonyms: NOT Office Love Desu no De
NOTオフィスラブですので
ワンモア・ワンナイトラブ

194007.description:
Can two rival Alphas end up as a couple? Ask Cloud Ling, who gets hit by a car while escaping loan sharks. The driver? None other than his ex-rival, Marius Ji! Their journey from childhood friends to estranged rivals takes a dramatic turn when Cloud feigns amnesia to avoid an awkward reunion, only for Marius to insist that they're boyfriends! As Cloud grapples with this bizarre claim, he wonders: Is this mishap a stroke of luck, reigniting a long-lost bond, or are some chapters best left closed?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: 記憶喪失のフリをしたら彼氏ができた
My Rival Said I Was His Boyfriend

title.native: 假装失忆后情敌说我是他的男朋友
title.romaji: Jiazhuang Shiyi Hou Qingdi Shuo Wo Shi Ta De Nanpengyou

194009.description:
In his previous life, Yu An pretended to be stupid and obedient, changed his surname and gave up his position, and tried every means to please his brother, but he did not expect that he would be killed by his brother in the end. In his new life, Yu An looked at the well-dressed Fu Mingyi, and in addition to taking away everything from him, he also wanted to make him fall into the blood taboo that he had always hated, and lure him into ruin with his own body!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)
synonyms: After Being Wantonly Demanded by My Morbid Brother

title.native: 被病态弟弟肆意索要后
title.romaji: Bei Bingtai Didi Siyi Suoyao Hou

194010.description:
Big crisis for the face-chasing lover! Sunny local dog Jiang Jiaojiao (straight man) fell in love with Zhong Minyu (male) at first sight! An accident turned the originally unattainable cold-faced nobleman into a spoiled and fragile "Lin Daiyu", and used his beauty to win the other party's favor!! But as they got to know each other better, Jiang Jiaojiao gradually discovered Zhong Minyu's yandere nature, and the huge secrets hidden behind his family and two generations...

(Source: Bilibili, translated)
synonyms: Everyday I Want The Yandere Prince Die
Dragging the Yandere Prince to Ruin
I Want to Kill the Yandere Prince Everyday

title.native: 每天都想让病娇王子社死
title.romaji: Meitain Du Xiang Rang Jiao Wangzi Shesi

194011.description:
You Zhao, OMEGA, rose-like appearance, hot pepper-like personality, workplace elite, young CEO, born with too high a concentration of pheromones, afraid of losing control, carries inhibitors with him every day, and gives himself an injection when he is in heat. Qu Jing, ALPHA, sandalwood-like fragrance, black ink-like heart, sandalwood-like fragrance, black ink-like heart, workplace elite, young CEO, born with too high a concentration of pheromones, afraid of losing control, carries inhibitors with him every day, and gives an injection to anyone who is in heat. You Zhao and Qu Jing, usually spend 99% of their time and energy on work, not love but money. Until one day, they got married.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

194012.description: A manga about cousins who were on awkward terms staying overnight in the same room

title.native: 夜な夜なふたりはわるいこと
title.romaji: Yona Yona Futari wa Warui Koto

194013.description:
Laura Davis never believed in fate. She didn't believe in fate when her father married another woman. Neither did she believe in fate when she was thrown to the valley all by herself.She started from scratch and became so powerful that people were scared of her. Since justice didn't come itself, she fought for it.

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: The Mandate of Heaven for the Phoenix

194014.description:
“You are the villainess who will stand in the heroine’s way and meet a tragic end—Mimosa Southcross!”

With these shocking words, her mother reveals an unexpected truth—Mimosa is the villainess in a story destined for a tragic fate!

Her mother, who possesses rare knowledge due to being reincarnated from another world, has foreseen her daughter’s dark future and decides to help her survive. And so, Mimosa’s life becomes a relentless struggle to avoid every trap that could lead to her doom.

But no matter how hard she tries, the fated day arrives—her mother passes away, just as written in the story, leaving Mimosa alone to face her impending fate!

Yet, she refuses to give up. She has memorized her mother’s teachings well. Now, she must confront the schemes of her stepmother and half-sister while avoiding the greatest threat to her life—her fated encounter with the second prince, Alcor Astralis!

Armed with her mother’s records on the events of this “Otome Game”, Mimosa embarks on a battle against destiny, determined to break every death flag that stands in her way!

A unique fantasy novel that blends intelligent plotting, survival tactics, and a fierce heroine fighting to escape her doomed fate!

194015.description:
It is a story about a demon spirit stick who wants to die but cannot, and a semi-obscure male star friend who is having a hard time becoming popular again. They each get what they want from him, but they discover that there is someone else who is eyeing them.

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: Long Time No See a Dim-Witted Guy

194016.description:
Exhilarating matching with an enthusiastic fresh graduate. ♥

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic Shitsurakuten 2025-02, 07
synonyms: CaimanMotors 後期兎繁殖補助課

194017.description:
“Four souls existing in one body at the same time?!”

Sang Wan is a young woman who's just been forced to marry the heir of the Gu family. When her new husband hits his head on a wall, she discovers that he has dissociative identity disorder. She has to get used to all four of his personalities, which are all very different from each other!

(Source: Comikey)

title.romaji: Wo Yu Si Ge Gu Xiansheng

194018.description:
Su Xiao one day wakes up and finds himself shrunk down to 5cm, not knowing how or why it happened. In his eyes, everyday items are gigantic, and insects and small animals are terrifying monsters. With his landlady in the same situation, they both must live and test their survival instincts.

(Source: INKR)

194022.description: Shintaro Mugiwara presents another passionate baseball manga! A genius baseball player reincarnated as a dog becomes a big star in the future of professional baseball! Can he lead his clumsy baseball team to victory?

194023.description:
A playboy goes after an innocent-seeming girl, having no idea what he's getting into.

Note: Originally posted on Twitter. On April 25, 2025 it was announced that the manga got licensed by Gangan Pixiv.
194023.hashtag: #クマとウサギは友達ではいられない
synonyms: チャラ男くんと清楚ちゃん
Bear and Bunny Cannot Be Friends

title.native: クマとウサギは友達ではいられない
title.romaji: Kuma to Usagi wa Tomodachi dewa Irarenai

194024.description:
Dojun Seo was once a warrior from another realm, so powerful that many called him The Sword God. However, he was a god in name only, as even he failed to predict or stop the destruction of his home world. Now reincarnated into the young man Dojun, he seeks to fulfill a quest he failed to complete in his previous life: finding happiness. After a lifetime of fighting, Dojun’s grandma and little sister are slowly filling a hole in the warrior’s heart he didn’t realize existed.

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: The Sword God from a Ruined World
The Sword God From the Destroyed World
滅びた世界から来た剣神

title.english: The Sword God from the Lost World

194025.description:
On the same day and at the same time, three children who cannot be born will be born. One of them holds the fate of all, and depending on the child's choice, one family will be annihilated and the child will die in the child's appearance. I, Theoderic, bet everything on my curse. As if by curse, on the same day and at the same time, Michael, Ezra, and Flora are born. The three eventually face each other as if it were a predetermined fate, and Flora must choose one of the two...

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

194027.description:
Mei was forced to get a job at a funeral home. She couldn't get used to the job of mourning the dead, but there are as many lives as there are funerals. This is a touching human drama that weaves together the various types of funerals and the human relationships behind them!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title.native: おわるう ございます〜葬儀社人情物語〜

194031.description:
The story begins with Snow White, who fell asleep after eating a poisonous apple, waking up in modern-day Japan. After wandering the streets of the city, she arrives at Kabukicho, where she is called out to by a woman named Karen. Karen also seems to come from a fairy tale world, just like Snow White, and the two hit it off. However, one day, after going to meet the "prince," Karen's behavior becomes strange... In order to return to her original world, Snow White unites with "princesses" from other worlds, such as Cinderella, and struggles to activate magic.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

Note: Chapters 2 to 13 were split into multiple parts in the original serialization and later combined in the volume releases.

title.native: メルヘン・ガール・ランズ!!!

194032.description:
He finds a risqué video on a hard drive he thinks is his. She takes the blame to protect her friend—and pretends to be into it. But as they keep up the act, neither of them is prepared for how real it starts to feel.

(Source: Toomics)

194034.description:
Sister Alicia is popular for her pure and righteous behavior. But her mind is always filled with perverted fantasies! Her feelings and fantasies for her junior nun, Leon, explode in this perverted sister love comedy!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 妄想シスターでも少年修道士に恋していいですか？
title.romaji: Mousou Sister Demo Shounen Shuudoushi ni Koishite Ii Desu ka?

194035.description:
Ko Inashiki (23) gave up on his dream of becoming a manga artist and is now working as an office worker at a stable company. He left his parents' home and started living in a rundown apartment where the company housing is run down! All the residents there are women and they all love drawing manga! This is a story about finding your own fun in a place where people with similar interests can gather, have fun over drinks.

(Source: Comic Fuz, translated)

194037.description:
After losing her mother, Mizuki Kamo is the eldest daughter, raising her younger siblings on her own. Mizuki tends to be relied on by those around her, but in reality, she wants someone to pamper her. Then, her motherly colleague, Mano-san, appears before her. Although he is a good-looking man, he is also caring and tolerant, and Mizuki can't help blurting out, "Please be my mom!"

A heart-warming and heart-fluttering romantic comedy filled with love and doting begins!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title.native: わたしのママは真野くんです。
title.romaji: Watashi no Mama wa Mano-kun desu.

194038.description:
“Do not worry, chop him on the road.”

Su Liu'an was tossed aside by a scumbag, whom she took with her to the grave. But instead of dying, she woke up to find that she had become another person and was forced to get married!

(Source: Comikey)
synonyms: Mad Concubine Provoking and Offending People: The Prince Unbridledly Spoils
Wild Concubine Stirring up the Fire: The Prince Wantonly Pampers

title.romaji: Rehuo Kuang Fei: Wangye Fangsi Chong

194039.description:
Running late, Cheng Jiajia decides to break the school rules and rides an electric scooter to school, only to crash into a BMW sports car. Turns out the condescending driver, with whom she has exchanged information, is the new substitute teacher in her psychology class.

(Source: Webcomics)

194040.description:
A straight man who serializes romance novels, a rebellious girl who lacks fatherly love, and three monsters who can do nothing but mess things up. Together they stage a story in which the male protagonist from the city and the female protagonist who lives on the island help the monsters return to their hometown.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)
synonyms: There are monsters on this island
Help! This Island has Some Monsters!

194041.description:
Maison Puana is a shared house in Osaka where seven women who range from their 20's to 60's live. There is a rule that every Friday night, all seven of them gather at the table for dinner. They share their problems and worries over seasonal cuisine and live vigorous lives.

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title.native: メゾンプアナの7人の食卓

194042.description:
The Kuroshirou family moves in across the street from the Andou family in a quiet residential area. The mistress of the family is a dangerous woman who can control crows...!? What will become of Yoshiko Andou, who gets caught up in the turmoil caused by this strange family...

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

194043.description:
San-ho has been crushing on Eui-Hyun since their high school days, so ending up at the same college as him feels like fate. The problem is, Eui-Hyun doesn’t remember him at all. Still, San-Ho’s not about to give up that easily. But how long can his one-sided puppy love last if Eui-Hyun keeps looking the other way?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes four side story chapters.
synonyms: ティッピング・ポイント〜僕と先輩の転換点〜

194044.description:
“Don’t you think it’s about time we tried living together?”

On my twentieth birthday, my girlfriend Momiji-senpai invites me to move in with her, and that’s how our life together begins. She loves alcohol, and once she starts drinking, she gets a little provocative… My self-control is already at its limit!!

A sweet and slightly risqué cohabitation rom-com about a pure couple in love.

(Source: Gangan Online)
synonyms: Sweet Cohabitation Romcom with My Senior Girlfriend and Alcohol Starts at Twenty

title.native: お酒と先輩彼女との甘々同居ラブコメは二十歳になってから
title.romaji: Osake to Senpai Kanojo to no Amaama Doukyo Love Comedy wa Hatachi ni Natte kara

194045.description:
Knee deep in debt, I might just believe this crazy man claiming to be a dragon...

(Source: Lalatoon)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.
synonyms: ะวังใจให้ดี แถวนี้มังกรดุ

194046.description:
Ritsuko, a divorced woman in her fifties, lives alone while working two part-time jobs. Her hobby is gardening on her balcony. And her beloved partner is her cat, Muumuu! She lives a carefree, relaxed life with Muumuu, who looks like an old man but is very cute!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

194047.description:
"It's about time for us to move in together.”

On the day Takashi turned 20, that's what his girlfriend, Kureha-senpai, said to him. Their new zero-distance lovey-dovey cohabitation life is about to begin! Kureha loves to drink, but when she gets a little drunk, she becomes even more aggressively seductive… Takashi's rational thoughts are on the verge of breakdown! The two love each other dearly, and whether they are drinking at home or out, they boldly explore their relationship by flirting with each other in every possible way!

(Source: HJ Bunko, translated)
synonyms: Sweet Cohabitation Romcom with My Senior Girlfriend and Alcohol Starts at Twenty

title.native: お酒と先輩彼女との甘々同居ラブコメは二十歳になってから
title.romaji: Osake to Senpai Kanojo to no Amaama Doukyo Love Comedy wa Hatachi ni Natte kara

194049.description:
Kana Tsugawa's former colleague, Kiwami Chihara, and his wife, Chiyo, move into the apartment next to her. Kiwami is an elite businessman, but he is also emotionally abusive towards Chiyo.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

194050.description:
After a prophetic dream foretells her sister’s death in a political marriage, Arasilla Hugo takes matters into her own hands and marries in her place. Her groom? Demian Vandermeer, the knights’ captain and the brother of her sister’s former betrothed. The only problem is that mages and knights are sworn enemies, and their sharp tongues and stubborn hearts turn every situation into a competition. Arasilla races to save her sister from a tragic fate, while Demian fights for the dukedom. Will their rivalry stay just that? Or will their contractual marriage burn into something more?

(Source: WEBTOON)

194051.description:
To confess to his crush Meng Suli who is addicted to the Internet, tech geek Jiang Tingxian designs a game for her. The game, however, is later infected. The NPCs become self-aware and begin to make a pass at her, one after another. Now that they are trapped in the game with three other guys, can he win her over?

(Source: Webcomics)

194052.description:
A strange door appears in front of lawyer Han Beom-Sang. Beyond it exists a space where time does not flow.

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: The Subspace of an Ordinary Lawyer

194053.description:
34-year-old Marie's hobby is saving money. One day, when her younger boyfriend sees her bankbook, his attitude suddenly changes. While running away from him, Marie ends up at a mysterious bar.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.romaji: Watashi no Oshi wa Okane desu

194054.description:
"Do you want to change who you are now?"

A critical response to love in the marriage market! Charismatic advisor Seira Kotobuki will guide you to a happy marriage!

(Source: Champion Cross, translated)

194055.description:
At the age of 42, Kobari Akira started "middle-aged marriage hunting". Due to past experiences, Akira has become cautious about love, and within a year of marriage hunting, her heart was completely worn down. Then, one day, a man she had been in contact with on a dating app invited her out to dinner...

This is a story about an unfashionable, unattractive middle-aged woman who stitches together her torn future, remaking her life.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: 婚活とミシン もう一度恋がしたいけどめんどくさい気もする
title.romaji: Konkatsu to Machine Mouichido Koi ga Shitaikedo Mendokusai ki mo suru

194056.description:
The world of elementary school entrance exams is deeper than junior high school entrance exams!

A new comic essay series that depicts the struggles of parents and children to get into a prestigious elementary school! Peri starts working at an early childhood classroom for entrance exams. What she sees there is shocking! It is also full of information that will be useful for elementary school entrance exams!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title.native: 小学受験のイロハ！ ～6歳の受験生、合格目指してがんばります～
title.romaji: Shougaku Juken no Iroha: 6-sai no Jukensei, Goukaku Mezashite Ganbarimasu

194057.description:
A few years after Marina and Katsu's marriage, the Oishi family was filled with sadness... What was the reason?

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

Note: Includes 12 extra chapters.

title.native: あの山越えて 日・日・天のたより
title.romaji: Ano Yama Koete Nichi Nichi Sora no Tayori

194058.description:
Yu Min-Ah struggles to live with the debt her parents left behind. When she is threatened by a loan shark who comes to her goshiwon to collect her growing debt, she receives help from Soo-Hyun, who has a huge amount of cash and even uses strange abilities. While helping her, Soo-Hyun becomes intrigued by Min-Sh's wit and asks her to help him find his old friend, since she has become too deeply involved in his secret. Min-Ah quickly figures out that Soo-Hyun has a secret that he has not told her, but decides to cooperate to steal the huge amount of money he has...

(Source: Naver, translated)

194059.description:
There are no rules when drinking alone. You can choose the snack, place, and time as you like! Make spring rolls using leftover ingredients from the fridge and pair them with white wine, or on a hot day, grill and marinate summer vegetables and enjoy them with a fruit liquor on the rocks. Have a glass of beer in the kitchen while frying kushikatsu. On a nice day, go outside and feel the breeze while you make your bento.

Grilled squid, tacos, carpaccio, and more... This is a great value solo drinking essay filled with over 15 snack recipes to color the four seasons!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title.native: 思い立ったがおつまみ～今日も楽しいひとり飲み～
title.romaji: Omoitatta ga wo Tsumami: Kyou mo Tanoshii Hitori Nomi

194060.description:
In the southern part of the Queen Amar Empire continent, a small rural village bordering the sea, 'Ober'. After the war, Nixie, a former soldier who bought a house in a corner of Ober with all her savings, wants to become a farmer and live each day happily. There, she meets Benjamin Richter, a deserter and painter from the enemy country, the Earth Empire...

"Painter, I'll give you all my savings, 260 gold, so paint a picture for me."

"...Yesterday, your savings were 500 gold?"

"Wow, I got caught."

Nixie, who lives with the modifiers of crazy and mad, follows Benjamin around and harasses him(?) as befitting those descriptions.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

194061.description:
Born and raised in a family that everyone envies, brothers Cho Kyu-Bin (Su) and Cho Eun-Bin (Gong) are so bad that they haven't had a proper conversation with each other for over 10 years. Then one day, Eun-Bin suffers from memory loss and regresses to the age of elementary school due to an unexpected accident. Kyu-Bin takes responsibility for the accident and decides to take care of Eun-Bin. When Eun-Bin was having a hard time dealing with his younger sibling who was acting like an adult, crying and clinging to him, Eun-Bin secretly visits Kyu-Bin's room late at night. "Hyung, my dick hurts." Kyu-Bin looks at his younger sibling who is sobbing without knowing what an erection is or how to relieve that desire through masturbation, and ends up having sex with him half-heartedly. Gyu-Bin realizes his mistake, but thinks, “I’ll just play around with it until his memories come back. Anyway, once his memories come back, that kid will be embarrassed and won’t be able to tell anyone.” and ends up falling into a swamp from which he can no longer get out…

(Source: Naver Series, translated)

194062.description: Komori Mari, modest, quiet, and lacking self-confidence in herself. When she was in junior high school, she was traumatized by hulan relations because she could not get along with the people aroudd her. She went out of school because she did not do well at the high school she went to, so she decided to go to Correspondence High School instead of going to a full-time high school. One day, Kamogawa Eiichiro, another show-looking boy who is also going to correspondence course, came,to help her, who was having trouble submitting assignments. The boy heard the voice of a clumsy little girl. It is an examination of the beginning of their irreplaceable youth.

title.native: 明日へ紡ぐコバルトブルー

194063.description:
Why didn't I realize that...
That the woman I love...
She doesn't “love” me...

(Source: Pixiv, translated)

title.native: 僕の彼女は、僕とはセックスしたくない
title.romaji: Boku no Kanojo wa, Boku to wa Sex Shitakunai

194064.description:
A young scholar named Ren makes her way to Meaheim, the last town on the border of the Dark Lands—a bizarre place where horrifying monsters run amok, and reality itself is all but unrecognizable. With the aid of a Guide named Tobia, Ren sets off on a journey into the very maw of chaos, where she must overcome monsters known as "Witches," traitorous adventures, and the godforsaken land itself to retrieve the panacea and save her brother...

(Source: Kodansha USA)

194065.description:
Damn! Did the Devil think he could use tricks to trap her always? Did he remember he is a boss? She was once a cold killer and remains impossible to be trapped by anyone. Though she had a child of his, she was still planning an escaping plan. This time, she would not fail...

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: Don't Mess With the Evil Chairman

title.romaji: Fu Hei Zongcai Bie Luan Lai

194066.description:
One day, Chizuru, an ordinary high school girl who helps out at her family's drinking establishment, becomes friends with a handsome musician who comes to the bar. But that's where it all began: a one-sided love outbreak!

A nonstop love triangle with an unpredictable ending!

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title.native: 恋はのむとものまれるな
title.romaji: Koi wa Nomutomo Noma Reru na

194067.description:
Tina is a maid who remembers that she played a video game that contained this world in her past life. But she's not just any maid... she works under the throwaway character Prince Viself who's fated to die as the kingdom falls into ruin! Now she's on a mission: save the kingdom by ensuring Prince Viself doesn't ruin his engagement. However, things take a turn from what she knows from the game story when all these main characters start taking an interest in her...?!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: I Was Reborn as the Throwaway Prince's Maid?!: I'm Just a Background Character, so Why Is My Life Suddenly So Chaotic?! All right... I won't let him break off his engagement with the heroine!
title.native: 当て馬王子の侍女に転生!?よし、ヒロインと婚約破棄なんてさせません!～モブ令嬢のはずなのに、なんだか周囲が派手なんですが?～
title.romaji: Ateuma Ouji no Jijo ni Tensei!? Yoshi, Heroine to Konyaku Haki nante Sasemasen!: Mob Reijou no Hazu nanoni, Nandaka Shuui ga Hade nandesu ga?

194068.description:
Twenty-first-century yin yang master Zhao Mingyue dies in a fierce battle to reclaim the sacred treasure Taiyin Lingxi from villains. Her soul, meant to dissipate, is suddenly summoned to another world, where she revives in the body of a freshly buried girl. But just as she emerges, she narrowly escapes being killed by a ghost-masked man.

(Source: Bilibili Comics, translated)
synonyms: Flourishingly Spoiled Imperial Concubine of Yin and Yang
Vigorously Pampering the Yin-Yang Imperial Concubine

194069.description:
I don't want to succeed or advance. Am I out of touch with the times? A story of a woman surviving in modern society.

(Source: Elegance Eve, translated)

194070.description:
It is a story about two high school girls who have known each other since childhood, and their mixed emotions as they emerge from childhood.

(Source: Melonbooks, translated)

Note: Released at COMITIA152.
synonyms: The Melancholy of a Childhood Friend

title.native: アニメポケットモンスター ライジング４コマボルテッカーズ

194072.description:
I thought Kuroi-san, the classmate sitting next to me, was quiet, but she turns out to be a cheerful girl with a cat-like charm!?

Akama-kun, the protagonist aiming for a fresh start in high school, keeps trying to become popular but always ends up fumbling instead. Kuroi-san, the cat-like girl who’s been giving him cold stares, is actually incredibly lively — and by wholeheartedly going along with his clumsy invitations, she helps to brighten up the lives of Akama-kun and their classmates. A cat-themed romantic comedy with a surprising twist that took social media by storm!

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

Note: Originally self-published on Twitter, it was then licensed by Square Enix for serialization on 2025-12-27.
synonyms: Taciturn But Absurdly Enthusiastic Black Cat–chan
The Quiet but Incredibly Spirited Black Cat Girl
A quiet but extremely cheerful black cat

title.native: 寡黙だけどめちゃくちゃノリのいい黒猫ちゃん
title.romaji: Kamoku dakedo Mechakucha Nori no Ii Kuroneko-chan

title.native: ディアスポリス－異邦警察－９９９篇

194074.description: A Mahjong one-shot published in the September 11, 1981 issue of Weekly Manga Times.
synonyms: 異色青春麻雀 紅花牌

194075.description:
Anko and Kou are assigned to investigate a mysterious religious cult called "Paradise", after Amu Miyamoto from the idol group "Wednesday is Sunday" reaches out for assistance. Her fellow band mate, Mei, is entangled with this sect. The group's enigmatic leader appears ageless and perpetually radiant, hinting at a vampiric nature.

Their arrival in the secluded countryside where "Paradise" is based is met with suspicion and hostility... and thus, the pursuit kicks off!

title.english: Call of the Night: Paradise Arc
title.native: よふかしのうた -楽園編-
ゴーダ哲学堂空気人形

194077.description: After falling through a magic mirror, Nanako and company find themselves stuck in a world where the people are talking animals - and now must find their way back home.

194079.description:
This time around, we follow Kana Ichikawa, Kyotaro’s big sis! She’s got a ton of gal pals, but she’s never had a guy friend before, let alone a boyfriend. She’s given up on ever being popular with the guys, and is just trying to focus on living her best life. But it seems maybe there’s someone harboring secret feelings for her after all. Maybe now she’ll finally get to experience the young love she never got as a teenager?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title.english: The Dangers in My Heart: The Romantic Comedy Won’t Start
title.native: 僕の心のヤバイやつ ラブコメディが ︀︀始まらない
title.romaji: Boku no Kokoro no Yabai Yatsu: Love Comedy ga Hajimaranai

194080.description:
Kazune Ayu, a high school student who lost his dreams, regains his passion once again when he hears his classmate Aoha Hanamoto sing! Kazune, who once produced a hit song as a popular Vocaloid producer, is moved by Hanamoto's voice and recruits her to try and participate in the world's number one music festival, "WORLD SOUND." The two begin to walk into a reckless dream of becoming the number one in Japan in three years!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.native: アプネア～特命課戦史漂流記～
身代わり花嫁は命を賭して 主君に捧ぐ忍びの花
title.romaji: Migawari Hanayome wa Inochi wo Toshite Shukun ni Sasagu Shinobi no Hana

title.native: 身代わり花嫁は命を賭して 主君に捧ぐ忍びの花
title.romaji: Migawari Hanayome wa Inochi wo Toshite Shukun ni Sasagu Shinobi no Hana

title.native: モラハラ夫に裏切られています～浮気相手は配信者～
title.romaji: Morahara Otto ni Uragira Rete Imasu: Uwaki Aite wa Haishinsha

194085.description: A romantic comedy about a rich young man who admires delinquents, who decides to make a strong move on a former delinquent girl.

title.native: 紫苑くんの仰せのまま
紫苑くんの仰せのまま
アカツキ町のサンタクロース

194090.description:
A prince with no claim to the throne, Yi Tae-Rok lives a quiet life removed from power. At thirteen, he is entrusted with raising his nephew, Yi Nan-Yeong, a gentle boy with no talent for the sword and no expectations placed upon him. At first, Tae-Rok sees it only as duty. But Nan-Yeong grows up looking only at him. What begins as admiration slowly shifts into something deeper, something neither of them can easily name. Tae-Rok notices the change and chooses silence, drawing careful lines he refuses to cross. In the end, Nan-Yeong seeks clarity in the only way he can, by testing his feelings with another man. And Tae-Rok sees it.

“Then you become my scandal. And I become yours.”

In a court bound by rules, blood, and reputation, their bond teeters on the edge of ruin, where desire threatens to turn into something neither can undo.

(Source: Lezhin US)

194091.description:
During her final evening together with Julius, her appointed mating partner for their "Coming of Age Ceremony," Cornelia tells him that she wants him to live freely, without feeling bound to her by this unfair system, but…?

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

Note: Originally published in Volume 6 of the "Dekiai Reijou wa Danna-sama kara Nigeraremasen" anthology series, the chapter was revised and expanded for stand-alone publication as a side story of the series "Hakushaku Reijou wa Kenen no Naka no Elite Kishi to Kyousei-teki ni Tsugai ni Saserareru".

title.native: 亡国の姫は最後の騎士と強制的につがいにさせられる 伯爵令嬢は犬猿の仲のエリート騎士と強制的につがいにさせられる
title.romaji: Boukoku no Hime wa Saigo no Kishi to Kyouseiteki ni Tsugai ni Saserareru: Hakushaku Reijou wa Kenen no Naka no Elite Kishi to Kyousei-teki ni Tsugai ni Saserareru

title.native: 万能魔薬はありまセン!

194093.description:
Jiang Hao found himself reborn into the life of a common peasant, only to be sold off and conscripted into the Demonic Sect as a disciple. His ambition was simple: to engage in unobtrusive cultivation and steadily accumulate strength to survive this world. Yet, his goals were thwarted at every turn by a formidable Demoness whose power eclipsed his own, forcing him to endure ceaseless humiliation. Lacking a powerful patron to back him, Jiang Hao eventually garnered favor of the sect leader, allowing him to focus on his cultivation without further distractions. However, when he ascended to the role of chief disciple and finally met the stunning leader of the sect, he was left dumbfounded…

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: Staying by the Side of the Devil

194094.description:
Fu Yu wrongly traveled to an immortal novel world and became a miserable supporting role. Unexpectedly, with an omniscient perspective, high IQ and EQ, she struck back and became a popular heroine.

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: This Supporting Female Can't Afford to Offend

194095.description:
The dream of living alone comes true, but your neighbor turns out to be a ghost...!?

Ichigo Kurusu is about to start living alone as she enters university. She is excited about her new life, but there is an uneasy atmosphere coming from the apartment next door... When she looks out to see what is going on, she finds out that it is a ghost! This is the first volume of a forbidden, slightly erotic comedy about a girl and her neighbor!

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

title.native: お隣さんは得体が知れない

194096.description:
Karen Mikogami, eldest son of the president of a large company called the Mikogami Group, lives a lazy life while bossing around his servant Nanami Miyamori.

For some reason, he has to deal with his father, who loves cross-dressing and forces him to "dress up" almost every day. But one day, he is told a major secret that has been passed down in the Mikogami family...!?

The fate of the company is entrusted to his "cross-dressing"!?

The hectic training of a cross-dressing man to become a great president begins!!

title.native: 御子神かれんの隠しごと

194098.description:
Alicia the Saint had fought with the Demon King's Army, protecting the Kingdom. She had risked her life for the people and sealed the Demon King in herself. However, the Prince, who was her fiance, suddenly accused her of betrayal. He and his mistress, the fake Saint Flaura, had prepared fake evidence that Alicia was a witch. She was arrested on a false charge and was executed in front of people. When she saw everyone wished her death, Alice was thrown into despair. On the verge of her death, she yelled out--"Ruin upon your dammed country!!" The next moment, she was back to life...and the Demon King was in front of her. "Will you marry me?" he asked. With him, Alicia will tread the path of vengeance!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: The Fallen Saint Dances in Vortex of War
title.native: 闇堕ち聖女は戦渦で舞う
title.romaji: Yami Ochi Seijo wa Senka de Mau

194099.description:
Hong Do-Hye, a flower-like 26-year-old. The youngest Do-Hye, who has only received an abundance of love, has not had any major ups and downs in her life. However, after joining the company, a huge and sharp thorn named Team Leader Kwon Sa-Woo appears, and her flower-like life turns into a path of thorns...

(NEW) Tweet 30 seconds ago. @Xx_4woo ▶ (Video) 11:11.

A video uploaded at the same time and then suddenly deleted. I clicked on the video with a pounding heart, and why was there a large, straight wick and sticky breathing sound... ?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

194100.description:
Ryu Ho-Kyung and Baek Hee-Won, who are like enemies, are trapped in a suspicious cave one day. To make matters worse, the cave is filled with a sexual scent, and if things continue this way, their danjeon is in danger of being destroyed.......

“Let’s just solve it among ourselves. We just need to calm down anyway.”

“You crazy bastard! Come to your senses, Ryu Ho-Kyung!”

“Hee-Won, relax a bit. Be nice. I’m just doing this to make you feel better.”

(Source: Lezhin, translated)
synonyms: If You're Trapped in a Barrier With Your Enemy
When You Are Confined in a Barrier With Your Foe

194101.description:
Genius. Champion. National treasure. Nam Woo-Joon has always admired Seo Si-Won, but only from afar. That is, until the night he woke to find his idol on top of him, completely lost in pleasure. Now, as the heat between them rises, Woo-Joon’s learning the rules of a new game, and he’s playing to win.

(Source: Lezhin US)

194104.description:
Princess Cha Cha's birth, steeped in prophecy, spelled doom for the Yanchi Dynasty, leading to calls for her death. In response, the emperor executed the dissenters and exiled her and her mother in the cold palace. Years later, young Cha Cha, with her enchanting innocence, greeted him with a fish from the lotus pond. Despite her small stature, Cha Cha gradually wins over her tyrannical father and siblings with her wits and charm, defying the omens and reshaping her destiny in the Yanchi Dynasty.

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: 親バカ暴君の溺愛日記

194105.description:
A mysterious handsome guy who's good at teasing... High school days of being constantly pestered by him begin!

Miyako, a lonely girl who is self-conscious about her sharp eyes, is saved by a young man named Kou when he picks her up. When they first meet, Kou teases Miyako about her eyes, which Miyako finds unpleasant, but on the other hand, Kou becomes more and more interested in Miyako...!?

(Source: Flower Comics, translated)

title.native: 引っ掻き回してそれから愛でて

194106.description:
After Wen Li, a social animal, witnessed his lover Chi Haoye killing someone, he was entangled by Chi Wuye. However, it seems that the real abnormality is not his lover, but this world?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

194107.description:
Shiho is the ace and captain of a strong volleyball team, and with her fervent desire to win the Spring High Tournament, which decides which team is best in Japan, she is constantly relied on by those around her. She puts her own needs on the back burner and is feeling crushed by the pressure.

In the midst of all this, Shiho reunites with her childhood friend Ryou, who is one year younger than her. When she meets him again after a long time, he has grown into a large, selfish, cheeky young man, with all the traces of the cute boy she used to protect once having vanished.

"Be more selfish. I'll grant your selfish wishes."

Her selfish youth begins now!

(Source: Flower Comics, translated)
synonyms: Being Selfish is Just Right For Youth

title.native: 青春は我儘くらいがちょうどいい
title.romaji: Seishun wa Wagamama Kurai ga Chodoi

194108.description:
Quinton Lewis was once a ruthless mafia boss until a fatal gunshot ended his life. When he reopens his eyes, he wakes up in a stranger's bed, dressed in lingerie. Acting on instinct, Quinton attempts to attack the stranger only to uncover a shocking truth: he's transmigrated into an omegaverse world as a pampered Omega and the stranger turns out to be his supposed Alpha lover, Cain Lloyd. Trapped in a body and role he never chose, Quinton must navigate power, desire, and danger once again.

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: Transmigrated as the Alpha Boss' Golden Goose

title.english: Transmigrated as an Omega Who Snags His Alpha
title.romaji: Chuan Cheng Alpha Dalao De Jin Si Da E

194109.description:
A youthful romantic comedy about a heroine of justice and a boy who is a former bully begins!

Shiori, who has just entered high school, unexpectedly reunites with her old bully, Ryoga, who attended the same elementary school as her! She had dreamed of a peaceful high school life, but she finds herself constantly being tangled up with him and pushed around.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

194110.description:
Orika, a lazy girl who is a total slacker, is on the verge of repeating the year because she skipped too many classes. In order to reform her ways, she is put into the student council, where she begins to spend her troublesome but fun days with Mizuki, the president whose motto is to have fun in life!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: イヤです会長! 面倒です!!

194111.description:
The moment her engagement was broken off, Countess Shirley Lila Fontaine's memories of her past life returned to her.

After being dumped by her fiancé for being overweight, who said "I have no intention of marrying a pig," Shirley is reborn as a beautiful young woman, making full use of the knowledge from her past life as a beautiful culinary researcher.

From that point on, her fate begins to change drastically, and she ends up serving the castle as a maid to the first princess, Adele, but...!?

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title.native: 転生料理研究家は今日もマイペースに料理を作る～あなたに興味はございません～
title.romaji: Tensei Ryouri Kenkyuuka wa Kyou mo My Pace ni Ryouri o Tsukuru: Anata ni Kyoumi wa Gozaimasen

194112.description:
Ema, ​​who grew up in the countryside, has just moved to Tokyo. She is lost and in trouble, but is saved by a city boy... or so she thinks. Then she thinks she's seen him on TV!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: 花道の途中でキスをして
title.romaji: Hanamachi no Tochuu de Kiss wo Shite

title.native: 転生料理研究家は今日もマイペースに料理を作る～あなたに興味はございません～
title.romaji: Tensei Ryouri Kenkyuuka wa Kyou mo My Pace ni Ryouri o Tsukuru: Anata ni Kyoumi wa Gozaimasen

194115.description:
I’ve always wondered if life would be better as a character in a novel, and now I have my answer. After waking from a nap, I found myself as Tracy De Viana, the youngest granddaughter of the Marquis of Viana and a doomed background extra fated to die. I may only be six years old, facing a brutal trial, but I don’t want to die. I refuse to, no matter how fate tries to toy with me. I’ll do whatever it takes to survive, even if I have to become the villain.

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: 呪われ令嬢ですが、王国を救うヒロインになります
Becoming Queen at the Age of Six
Becoming the Queen at the Age of Six

title.english: From Six to Sovereignty: The Girl Who Ruled
title.romaji: Liu Sui Kai Shi Cheng Wei Nüwang

194117.description:
Sakurako Kuramochi has totally remade herself into a more popular girl since her debut in high school. However, deep down inside, she still bears the scars of being dumped by a girl she used to like. One day after school, while walking downtown, Sakurako bumps into another girl, who turns out to be that girl who rejected her in the past! For some reason, she proclaims that she's fallen in love with Sakurako at first sight, and asks if they can meet again. Sakurako gets angry at the girl for not recognizing her, and comes up with a plan to get revenge...?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

194118.description:
Sara Kureha is the popular "big sister" of an all-girls academy. She has obtained her social position through her unflagging efforts. Rui Mareshino, who is widely recognized for her natural grace and beauty, offers Sara a certain game. Before the school's top-girl contest in two months' time, the two of them decide on a way to settle the matter beforehand.......

“We should become lovers.”
"Wha......?”

The one who makes the other swoon is the girl who deserves to be at the top of the school! Now the two of them are in a secret relationship, as the mutual seduction battle begins...... Who will be the one to make the other surrender, body and soul?

A fierce romantic comedy battle between two beautiful girls!

(Source: Nico Nico Seiga, translated)
synonyms: Makemasenkara to Iiharu Kaonoii Onnanoko wo, Zenryokude Kuppuku Saseru Yuri no Ohanashi

title.native: 負けませんからと言い張る顔のいい女の子を、全力で屈服させる百合のお話
title.romaji: Makemasen kara to Iiharu Kao no Ii Onnanoko wo, Zenryoku de Kuppuku Saseru Yuri no Ohanashi

194119.description:
She has trouble getting along with Miyakubo, a boy who acts surprisingly cute sometimes.

(Source: Margaret, translated)

Note: Originally published in Margaret magazine 2025 issue no. 12.

title.native: 全方向あざとかわいい

194120.description:
When Kawada accidentally knocks over a gravesite's offering, who is the unexpected boy she runs into!?

(Source: Margaret, translated)

Note: Originally published in Margaret magazine 2024 issue no. 6.

194121.description:
Sanpei Kamata, a brilliant but slightly odd boy, accidentally finds a manga notebook on a desk during a classroom move. The next day after writing "It was fun" in the notebook and returning it to its original location, the owner, Misaki Arakawa, calls out to him. Although his life is the complete opposite of hers, they discover that they both love drawing manga, and they end up exchanging manga on impulse. As they gradually become closer, Misaki tells Sanpei about the existence of a manga vocational school...

(Source: Sunday Webry, translated)

194122.description:
Cover Illustration: Aizaki Utau
1. Unknown Heart (アンノウン・ハート) [Aizaki Utau]
2. Kawaii dake ja Dame desu ka? (かわいいだけじゃだめですか？) [Kodama Naoko]
3. Seishun wa Kankitsu no Aji (青春は柑橘の味) [Laspberry.]
4. Yasashii Hari (やさしい針) [Itou Hachi]
5. Omajinai (おまじない) [Yuama]
6. Omokage ni Koi wo Shite (面影に恋をして) [Chiruha Chinmi]
7. Sweet Morning Call (スイートモーニングコール) [Umehara Ume]
8. Yukidoke (ユキドケ) [Usui Shio]
synonyms: Childhood friends who definitely get together

title.native: 幼なじみが絶対に結ばれる百合アンソロジー
title.romaji: Osananajimi ga Zettai ni Musubareru Yuri Anthology

194123.description:
Akira is the son and heir of a yakuza family, living under the protection of two former assassins his late father employed. When a threat from within forces him into danger, the charged dynamic between Akira and his guardians turns into something far more complicated.

(Source: BluPetal)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

194124.description:
The introverted architect, Michishita, has a crush on his mysterious apartment neighbor, Kase. Kase always hides his face behind a mask, and rarely makes conversation with anyone, leaving Michishita with no intention of pursuing his unrequited love, content to just admire him from afar. One day, Michishita found himself in a near-fatal accident, only to be saved in the nick of time by Kase. However, Kase is seriously injured while shielding Michishita and is taken to the hospital in critical condition, unconscious. When Kase finally wakes up, to Michishita's surprise, he starts calling him "big brother" and begins acting adorably toward him…?

(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: A playful cat and a daydream.

title.native: 何の取り柄もない平凡な俺が美人双子姉妹を命懸けで助けた結果、実はヤンデレだった二人をガチ惚れさせてしまった件
title.romaji: Nani no Torie mo Nai Heibon na Ore ga Bijin Futago Shimai wo Inochigake de Tasuketa Kekka, Jitsu wa Yandere Datta Futari wo Gachi Horesasete Shimatta Ken

title.native: 最近雇った独占欲の強い美少女メイドが、実は王女様だった
title.romaji: Saikin Yatotta Dokusen Yoku no Tsuyoi Bishoujo Maid ga, Jitsu wa Ojou-sama Datta

title.native: イヴと偽りの天使たち　ロクでなし魔術講師と禁忌教典 [正典]
title.romaji: Eve to Itsuwari no Tenshitachi: Rokudenashi Majutsu Koushi to Akashic Records [Canon]

title.native: アオハルにもほどがある
title.romaji: Aoharu ni mo Hodo ga Aru

194129.description:
When transfer student Sakura Sakuraba arrives in Yuuyamichou, she discovers a place steeped in bizarre, ancient customs. The children there all have strange names and are bound by a curse that prevents them from leaving the city until they graduate high school. Caught in an escalating nightmare, Sakura must navigate curses, summonings, and betrayals. To break the curse and free the children, Sakura teams up with Uzu Andou, the mysterious president of the Paranormal Club. Their strange "club activities" are about to begin!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: Kaiibu ~ M-ken Y-shi no Kai Genshou ni Tsuite~

title.native: 怪異部～M県Y市の怪現象について～
title.romaji: Kaii-bu: M-ken Y-shi no Kaigenshou ni Tsuite

title.native: クソザコ早漏魔王は超長身のむっちむちデカ尻魔女にも負けっぱなし
title.romaji: Kusozako Sourou Maou wa Chou Choushin no Mucchi Muchi Dekashiri Majo ni mo Makeppanashi

194134.description:
A boy named Hotaru and a girl named Arista live happily together in an unnamed village. The children in the village turn into "monsters" by the age of 15 and are taken to the White Tower by the "Observers." One day, Arista turns into a monster. And Hotaru learns the truth about the hidden world.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: 怪獣デストラクション
おじおじの雑魚ち●ぽ、キャリーしてあげよっか?♡～姪っ子はゲーミングメスガキ～
title.romaji: Oji Oji no Zako Chinpo, Carry shite Ageyokka?: Meikko wa Gaming Mesugaki

194137.description:
University student Ishiko Yuzuki is dumped by his first girlfriend after she cheats on him. At home, his friend Tsuyoshi comforts him, but the heartbroken Yuzuki catches sight of an ad recruiting participants for the second season of the popular romance reality show "Eden of Destiny." Strongly encouraged by Tsuyoshi, the two apply without much hope, but they pass the application screening! However, when they board the luxury cruise ship, what awaits them is not a romance reality show, but an unreasonable death game!

(Source: Kurage Bunch, translated)

title.native: 殺戮のエデン -明日誰かが死ぬ恋愛リアリティショー-
title.romaji: Satsuriku no Eden: Ashita Dareka ga Shinu Renai Reality Show

194138.description:
His personality aside, Kiki, a medical student, is the perfect, most desirable bachelor. None of his relationships ever seem to last long, as he goes from one boyfriend to the next, but he's growing tired of this kind of life. Hikage, the waiter at Kiki's favorite café, openly shows disdain for him, unlike everyone else. But, one night, when Kiki returns to the café after closing to get his backpack, he catches Hikage pleasuring himself to Kiki at his usual table!

Hikage has always wanted to be with a man, and since Kiki's the only other gay man that he knows, he's been fantasizing about him. This unexpected naughty side of Hikage gets Kiki's engine going, so he gives Hikage one heck of a first-time experience, making him climax over and over again. To top it all off, he promises to meet Hikage there every Thursday and sleep with him...

A good-looking scumbag overtaken by his desires and an awkward beautiful man with a feisty personality. Are they both only into each other for their bodies!? This is a bittersweet love story that starts from being friends with benefits!

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.romaji: Ore ga Omae ni Koi Nante

194139.description: The son of a wealthy man, K, has died. The police, suspicious of the seemingly flawless life K had led, summon Akira Sakataki—the one who reported K’s apparent suicide—as a person of interest. During the investigation, the truth of their lewd and twisted relationship comes to light. Even if no one else could understand it, their bond was a blessing.

194140.description:
Soldo, a young boy, is reincarnated as a countryside noble in the world of a magic game. He is excited about the adventures he will be having in the game world he has played countless times in his previous life, but he is confronted with the shocking truth that he has no talent for magic...!

Unable to use magic, Soldo is destined to live as a worthless mob character with no impact on the story, but one day he discovers a book about "secret swordsmanship" hidden within the game!

He soon learns of the flags that will lead to his ruin, but he will slash them away with his strongest swordsmanship! The grand opening of a super-orthodox fantasy!

title.native: 魔法が使えないモブキャラに転生したけど、俺だけ使える【最強剣技】で成り上がる～推しの悪役令嬢の兄となった男は破滅フラグを叩き斬り、ゲーム世界で無双する～
title.romaji: Mahou ga Tsukaienai Mob Chara ni Tensei shita kedo, Ore dake Tsukaeru "Saikyou Kengi" de Nariagaru: Oshi no Akuyaku Reijou no Ani to Natta Otoko wa Hametsu Flag wo Tatakiri, Game Sekai de Musou suru

194141.description:

Sienna Bowman is stuck with the abusive Ian Wolfe. When the truth emerges and she wants out, he begs her to stay. What choice will she make?

He decides he wants to have a radically different life and even picks a small goal, which is to become the most powerful being. But... there seems to be something wrong with the system.

What was supposed to be a video game world filled with monsters and magical beings suddenly came true.
A huge tree more than ten thousand meters tall appeared near the beach with a portal inside its truck that churned out an endless horde of monsters and foul beings!

That was how the Great Calamity came to be.

194158.description:
In high school, Choi Sung-Jae confessed to his best friend Geon-Hu, but was firmly rejected. Despite staying friends and going to college, Sung-Jae is still ardently in love with Geon-Hu and makes a wish on a shooting star for just one chance to sleep with him. The next day he wakes up in the body of Lee Chung-Min, a fellow classmate and...Geon-Hu's lover?! Chung-Min is now in Sung-Jae's body and makes the wild suggestion that they have a threesome. Is Sung-Jae's wish coming true this easily?!

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

194159.description:
Love is a jungle, and only the fierce survive.

Kidnapped and held captive in the jungle, Tristan's only ally is Jia, a girl who was sold off to the cartel that killed his mother. She protects him—but as love grows, so does the danger. Can they escape together and make those who shattered their lives pay the price?

(Source: Manta)

194160.description:
1. Kanbyou ni Kitara Nifun de Onaho! Shokushu Bisshiri Onaho de Kaze mo Bacchiri (看病に来たら2分でオナホ！～触手びっしりオナホで風邪もばっちり～); COMIC Mugen Tensei 2024-02

194161.description:
The senpai that the ghostly Miou met was..!? The mysterious senpai makes her heart pound!

Mio, who has a ghostly presence, has been alone since entering high school, unable to make any friends. One day, when she goes to a classroom in the old school building where no one should be, Yanase-senpai, who attends the same school, suddenly appears. He offers to help Miou make friends, but in return he tells her to keep a promise. As she meets Yanase-senpai, Miou realizes she has feelings for him, but...

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

194162.description:
Nina Shinkai is a shy high school freshman. She has been frequenting the cafe Torigo ever since she was cheered up by the lovely smiling staff member Kurosu-san. One day, she is invited to work there part-time, and discovers the true face of her much-admired Kurosu-san...?

The bittersweet cafe story is about to begin!

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: ティータイムに魔法をかけて
スイートスイーツボーイ

194165.description:
"...Just hold me for a little longer."
Amao, a student at an art college, has had a ghost named Isola as his only friend since he was little. One day, he meets Banri, a classmate who is drawing a portrait that looks just like Isola, who is supposed to be invisible to everyone...

(Source: Akaneshinsha, translated)

194166.description:
Generative AI, self-driving cars, designer babies, etc. A news-style manga depicting a society where near-future technology has been implemented. Visit this slightly mysterious future depicted by Minami Kitagawa!

(Source: Chikuma Shobou, translated)

194168.description: Kisaragi Saya is a lonely, gloomy high school girl who is cursed to never be noticed by those around her, almost like a ghost. During her first summer in high school, Saya discovers the full-dive VRMMORPG "Shadow Assassin's World," changing her world forever. Even in the game, amidst a world monsters, demons, and other players, Saya finds that her presence is still nearly undetectable - so she decides to turn her curse into a blessing to become the top-class Ninja, "Kuro!" One day, an extroverted Ninja named "Hikari" crashes into her life and asks to be her apprentice! What lies ahead for this pair of polar opposites?

title.native: シャドウ・アサシンズ・ワールド ～影は薄いけど、最強忍者やってます～
title.romaji: Shadow Assassins World: Kage wa Usui kedo, Saikyou Ninja Yattemasu

194169.description:
The protagonist, Emma, ​​has no family and is left in the care of terrible relatives. One day, she gets a job at a novelist's mansion. She was told not to enter the workroom, but she accidentally reads the original manuscript and ends up pointing out a hole in the work. A spacious bathroom, a fluffy bed, and unlimited access to books! A relaxed life as a live-in maid in a big mansion!

(Source: Comic Days, translated)

title.native: 本好きの没落令嬢、小説家をお手伝いする。
title.romaji: Honzuki no Botsuraku Reijou, Shousetsuka wo Otetsudai Suru.

194172.description:
After the war broke out. The family of the young and south goes to the home of the host in the south. In the house of the aunt, a woman in a gloomy atmosphere first sees herself as a new aunt. The old lady lying in the body with a bandage all over her body is also strange. Aunt who takes blood consciousness alone in the middle of the night. Grandmother ghost unknown. Father and mother where the missing. Can Young-nam and young brother Young-soon, who are in chaos and fear, escape this house safely?

(Source: Naver Series translated)

194173.description:
Hyeon-Jin is a devil—literally. But not a very well-fed one. Without a proper source of spiritual energy, he’s constantly starving. At a broadcast station party, his luck finally seems to turn when two smoking-hot celebrities—top actor Seon-Wu and elite model Ha-Jun—start flirting with him. Jackpot, right? Desperate, Hyeon-Jin gives in, hoping to drain a little energy and dash. Except…

“You're a demon, aren't you?”

Uh-oh. Turns out Seon-Wu and Ha-Jun are actually angels. Sexy, powerful, and way too smug about it. Instead of smiting him, they offer Hyeon-Jin a deal he can't refuse—one that involves lots of close contact, a suspicious amount of cuddling, and... were those feathers?? Now stuck between two heavenly bodies with very unholy intentions, Hyeon-Jin wonders: Since when were angels this into corrupting demons?!

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

194174.description:
Se-Han wasn’t expecting to be turned on...but after catching a glimpse of Chan-Hyeong in bed with another man, he can’t shake the curiosity. As Se-Han begins to grow closer to Chan-Hyeong, Jin-Wu, who’s always had feelings for Se-Han, starts to suspect something. Fueled by jealousy and a few too many drinks, Jin-Wu confronts Se-Han one night. Se-Han’s response? He makes an unexpected proposition…one that blurs every line between friendship and desire.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

synonyms: I Want to Be the Director's Husband
I Want to Be the CEO's Husband

194176.description:
A young Taoist master descends the mountain to vanquish demons and subdue monsters. He battles fiercely against the Corpse King of Western Hunan and the Undying Evil God, strikes down the vengeful spirit of the Ouija and the ghostly bandits from all directions. Wielding the divine arts of Maoshan, he captures all the seductive demons of the world. Yet, he remains witty and charming, winning the heart of a wealthy heiress. Born with extraordinary courage, he dares to venture into the underworld itself.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

194177.description: In an era untouched by the advances of Western medicine, mysterious incidents plague the streets. To uncover the truth, one doctor turns to a forbidden practice feared and reviled by society — dissection, known as the “art of heresy". Armed with knowledge and a blade, he seeks answers hidden beneath the flesh, where others dare not look.

194178.description: Umenosuke lives in a university dorm for guys, where he spends his days doing muscle training as a hobby, amongst his valued male friends and fun-loving seniors. He should have been living a perfect life in the dorm, but one day, he suddenly turns into a girl!? What about the muscles he's built up over the years? What about the friendships he has cultivated with his best friends? How will he live in the male dormitory in the first place!?

title.native: 梅之助くんは男子寮の女の子

194180.description:
Echineacea Roaz is graceful, beautiful, and impeccably dressed, even on the dueling grounds. Yet beneath the lace gloves and silk hats is a deadly swordsman with a dark secret. As the Demon of the Cursed Sword, she once slaughtered all she loved, including Captain Eurien, the one man who believed in her. Granted one chance to rewrite fate, she turns back time and joins the knighthood to protect those she once failed. Can this elegant swordsman bloom anew, or will she cut everything down again?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: The Flower Who Bears the Sword

194181.description: A man is brutally dismembered and left for dead after witnessing his family’s murder. Stranded on a remote planet, he awakens psychic powers, rebuilds his body as a cyborg, and sets out on a path of revenge.

194182.description:
Hwa-An, who disguised herself as a man in her older brother's place and joined the army, becoming known as 'General Bi-hong'. However, when she lost her use value, she had to get married as if she had been sold to Heo Ji-hang, the family's fiancé, and was murdered soon after. However, the moment she was close to death, Hwa-An was reborn as a weak girl with the same name. Hwa-An, who dreams of a new life while training herself not to repeat the past, gets involved in a murder case and, as fate would have it, rejoins the army and lives as a soldier...

(Source: Naver, translated)

194183.description: Note: Originally included as a store-bonus supplemental for Mitaina! magazine vol. 2

title.native: ざしきわらしと二人きり

194184.description:
The Warring States Period, a time when only the strong survived. A fox-masked man lives alone in a shrine deep in the mountains Although the villagers shun him as a “fox spirit," but they don't know the reason why he is there…

The spirit of the samurai and the things he must protect.
The form may change, but duty never does.

(Source: Mitaina!, translated)

Note: Originally published in Mitaina! magazine vol. 1.

194185.description:
After completing his training as a descendent of the first Qimen sect, Chu Chen’s return to the big city was spoiled by a freak accident that left his True Spirit sealed deep within an unbreakable amulet for five years. In the aftermath of the tragedy, Chu Chen gained a beautiful wife – who vowed to help him recover from his injuries – but became the laughing stock of her prestigious family. Now that his True Spirit has been restored, those who belittled and bullied him over the past half-decade are about to learn that they messed with the wrong “fool”!

(Source: WebComics)

title.english: The Godly Son-in-Law of the Nation

194186.description:
Ren, who was reincarnated into another world after a truck accident, obtains a detection skill as a reincarnation bonus. He aims to enter the dungeon and make a fortune. With no combat skills, he uses his detection to live in another world full of danger... the life-risking adventure of the isekai merchant Ren begins now!

(Source: BK Comics, translated)

title.native: 探知できなきゃ死んでいた～異世界商人の冒険は危険でいっぱい～

194187.description:
She accidentally witnessed the president murdering his secretary. “Become my secretary, or die!” With one contract, he sealed her fate. She became his personal secretary and arranged everything from his appointments to ghosting lovers. In the past, her boyfriend had sold her virginity to the highest bidder, drugging her in the process so she could not resist. He’s an affluent boss, while she works multiple jobs... As nothing more than just a tool to him, how will she live out this contract relationship?!

(Source: Webnovel)

194188.description:

194189.description: The manga's story centers on Megumi, a high school girl who becomes the owner of an apartment complex, and she finds five handsome, quirky men as lodgers.

194190.description:
Entarou Mashiba, who earned a starting spot on his powerhouse high school baseball team and made it to Koshien, suddenly quits the team in the spring of his senior year. As those around him struggle to understand his abrupt departure, Konoka Tanabe from the drama club senses the drama in the emotions Entarou carries and decides to reach out to him.

(Source: MANGA Plus)

194191.description:
Princess Chengping, a spoiled seductress who was infamous for her bossiness and imperiousness, fell into a coma during an accident. Ten years later when she woke up, she found the world was the same no more. Her father, the former emperor who pampered her unconditionally, just passed away. The one who acceded the throne thereafter was her sworn enemy Noble Consort Xiao’s son. Though Xiao used to be at her mercy, she’s now become the Empress Dowager who possessed the real power. And the handsome principal graduate she once abducted as a kept man has also become a high-ranking, powerful official. A love story between an evil-natured princess and a priggish, scheming scholar.

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: She, Head Princess, All Wants to Rebel Every Day

I'll take on any challenge! ♥♥

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in COMIC BAVEL 2025-04

194193.description:
In a world where people are ranked by their trustworthiness, a young boy named Kiriya, who has had everything stolen from him by his rulers, embarks on a rebellion that will turn the world upside down. A forbidden sci-fi suspense story begins here.

(Cycomi, Translated)

title.native: ブレイクニューワールド

194194.description:
Sirius, an endlessly kind C-class adventurer, saves a helpless girl from a monster attack. Ever since then, his life has been filled with unexpected miracles! His wounds are healing all too quickly, and he even has the strength to drive away tyrannical noblemen! Thus begins a happy fantasy starring a kind adventurer and a newly reincarnated girl!

(Source: Manga UP!)

title.english: The Kind Adventurer and the Reincarnated Girl
title.native: お人好し冒険者、転生少女を拾いました
title.romaji: Ohitoyoshi Boukensha, Tensei Shoujo wo Hiroimashita

194195.description:
Sirius, a C-class adventurer with no special powers, saves Kukuru, a girl who was attacked by monsters in the forest. But her true identity is someone from another world who was reincarnated and given the "Blessing of the Great Sage"!? Sirius begins living with Kukuru, who has nowhere to go. The reincarnated girl loves the ordinary, kind-hearted adventurer. A free and happy fantasy where two people travel together.

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

title.native: お人好し冒険者、転生少女を拾いました 大賢者の加護付き少女とのんびり幸せに暮らします
title.romaji: Ohitoyoshi Boukensha, Tensei Shoujo wo Hiroimashita: Daikenja no Kago-tsuki Shoujo to Nonbiri Shiawase ni Kurashimasu

194196.description:
After a chance encounter at school, Tomoru falls in love with the senior girl Yaeko. It turns out that she's his friend Saki's older sister. Tomoru is drawn to the innocent-looking Yaeko, but one day he sees something surprising in the classroom...

(Source: Manga Park, translated)

194197.description:
When Yutaro woke up in the morning, he found his boyfriend Nao there waiting for him. He said he was worried about Yutaro, who has been absent from work for a few days. Yutaro recalls how they met when he saw Nao pouring soy sauce on a fried egg at breakfast.

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

Note: Originally published in Hana to Yume Trifle No. 9.

ムクカノ：無垢で無口な職人彼女と、静かでにぎやかなふたり暮らし

Inevitable pussy insertion. ❤

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic Kairakuten 2017-03

194204.description:
Modern people are all tired. The life of Inukai Douhua, an office lady who is at her wit's end, is driven by work every day. Wanting some "healing", Douhua gets drunk and orders a cute dog demon, but what arrives is actually a fierce-looking demon... The demon that arrives by mistake. But the inside seems to be healing...! A comedy about the daily life of a fierce-looking demon that will heal your tired heart.

(Source: Manga Park, translated)

194205.description: Note: Published in COMIC HOTMiLK Koime Vol. 40

194206.description:
Moo-Gyum Kim, soccer superstar and troublemaker, takes a pay cut to join K-League's City Seoul, repaying a debt to his middle school teacher. There, he meets Ha-Joon Lee, a rookie coach who avoids him despite their shared past. Moo-Gyum soon uncovers Ha-Joon's strange secret.

(Source: Manta)

194210.description:
Fu Xin, a powerful president of her company in the modern age, finds that she had travelled to the past and transmigrated into the body of the village girl Fu Qibao along with her Merit System. Now, not only did she have to suffer the consequences of the original host’s cruelty to other people, but she had also earned herself a betrothed. No one had foreseen this exceptional teen who the original host had brutally beaten up to one day become a merciless tyrant of an emperor that ruled the world. He was going to kill everyone who hurt him before… Hold on, why does this sickly tyrant have two sets of personalities? Wait, is he acting innocent in front of Fu Qibao to gain her affections?!

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: The Sickly Loveable Tyrant Changed to Take the Green Tea Script
