194211.description:
Ever wondered what it would be like if your cat had to get a job? The cats in this book do every kind of occupation you can imagine, and they do it just the way they like. Feline chefs, dentists, wrestlers, detectives, opera singers and much more await in this hilarious full-color collection!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

194212.description: Adaptation of the essay novel by Princess Akiko of Mikasa, the first member of the Imperial Family to receive a PhD overseas.

194214.description:
One rainy day when I was 22, I realized the name of my feelings for my sister.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Note: Part of the 2024 Post Type GL Summer Anthology ([GL] 2024 포스타입 앤솔로지 | 여름).

title.native: 愛を食べて生きている

194216.description:
Two weeks after the disaster at the Global Science Base in Antarctica. The US national research icebreaker 'Pontus' carried eight survivors of the science base disaster: Donghwan Cha, Sayaka, Nozomi, Ri Meirin, Wang Gaochang, Lee Sang-hyun, Kim Kyung-han, and Jeong Se- in, along with the only surviving infected person, Cheon Ki-wook, while heading for the Pacific Ocean while heading for the New York Harbor. Another terrible tragedy begins in the middle.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

194217.description:
Our reader is reincarnated as Serena, a saintess in a novel who's destined to be treated like a villainess, give birth to a tyrant, and get executed for it. When the royal family accuses her of being an imposter, she must demonstrate her power as a saintess to survive. But once she does, she's trapped by the manipulative king and becomes a political prize for the two princes fighting for the throne. Although they were both responsible for Serena's death in the novel, the new Serena must choose one of them as an ally if she wishes to live...

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: I Became a Fallen Saint Pregnant With a Tyrant

title.english: I Became the Dark Saintess Fated to Bear the Tyrant!
title.native: 暴君を身ごもる闇堕ち聖女になりました
title.romaji: Boukun wo Migomoru Yami Ochi Seijo ni Narimashita

194220.description:
Alicia, daughter of a count, was told that her fiance wants to call off their engagement. One year later, she was killed by his new fiancee...and next moment, found herself inside the ex-fiance!?

Alicia thought she died after being pushed and fell off the long stairs. However, when she woke up...she was "inside" her ex-fiance, Gilbert's body. It turned out that her soul went back time before her engagement was called off, and found a place inside Gilbert, along with his own soul. Gilbert was the one who suddenly dumped her and engaged to Cordelia shortly after. Knowing that "Alicia (past)" is still living, Alicia decides to find evidence that Gilbert was having affair and make "Alicia (past)" call off the engagement herself before he tries to. She starts her investigation...but why does it seem that Gilbert is in love with Alicia!? And why did Codelia try to kill her?

An awkward, unique love story with two souls in one body!

(Source: Kadokawa)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.
synonyms: マイソウルファウンドアニューホームインマイエックスフィアンセズボディ
Gyakkousakiga moto Konyakushano Nakatte Douiu Kotodesuka?

title.english: My Soul Found a New Home in My Ex-Fiance's Body?!
title.native: 逆行先が（元）婚約者の中ってどういうことですか？ 婚約破棄されたのに『体の中』で同棲することになりました
title.romaji: Gyakkousaki ga (Moto) Konyakusha no Naka tte Douiukoto desu ka? Konyaku Haki Sareta noni "Karada no Naka" de Dousei suru Koto ni Narimashita

194221.description: An ero-guro one-shot collection by Jun Hayami with some of they worst works.

title.native: 純にもぬかりはある - 早見純自選最低作品集
title.romaji: Jun ni Monukari wa Aru: Hayami Jun Jisen Saitei Sakuhinshuu

194222.description: Note: Published in COMIC Magnum Vol. 164

title.native: マリッジピンク 〜ブライダルエステで新妻は悶え狂う〜
title.romaji: Marriage Pink: Bridal Esute de Niizuma wa Moe Kuruu

194223.description:
Yoshio was just an average shut-in until he inherited an entire apartment complex from his uncle. But when a few naughty tenants aren't paying rent on time, they’ll do anything to keep him from evicting them. And we mean anything…

(Source: Project-H)
synonyms: If You Can't Make Rent, Can I Have You Pay With Your Body?

title.native: 家賃がムリならお前の身体で払ってもらおうか?
title.romaji: Yachin ga Muri nara Omae no Karada de Haratte Moraou ka?

title.native: チュー坊ですよ! ~大阪やんちゃメモリー~
title.romaji: Chubou Desu yo! Osaka Yancha Memory

194225.description:
I've known Ta-kun ever since we were 10 years old. Even though we are now in high school, we still spend our days in his room, talking about nothing in particular. We are close, but our relationship is not quite as sweet as lovers…

Why won't you notice me? I'm trying so hard to get closer to you!

I am Hikari Shirasaka, 16 years old… It might be a little late for me to tell you this, but I think I've fallen in love with you, my childhood friend.
synonyms: It's Quite Late, but I've Fallen in Love with my Childhood Friend
It's a Little Late, but I've Fallen in Love with My Childhood Friend

title.native: 今さらですが、幼なじみを好きになってしまいました
title.romaji: Imasara desu ga, Osananajimi wo Suki ni Natte Shimaimashita

194226.description:
Ye Lingjun, on the verge of death, awakened the Strength Through Adversity System, which marked the start of his unlimited cultivation ascension. Immortals, saints, and Taoist masters? They all better stand aside! To build a following, he picked up a few disciples. The eldest disciple was once the leader of the demonic sect. He may seem vicious and rebellious, but he soon becomes tamed. The second disciple is a white-haired loli, blessed with the perfect saintly constitution. She could become the strongest of them all, but she loves to cook, and she'd rather serve her master a fancy meal instead!

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: Strength Through Adversity, My Cultivation Knows No Limits
As I Become Stronger When I Meet a Strong Opponent, My Cultivation Has No Upper Limit

title.native: 遇强则强，我的修为无上限
title.romaji: Yu Qiang Ze Qiang, Wo De Xiu Wei Wu Shang Xian

synonyms: A Slice of Mystery for Tea

title.native: お茶には謎のひときれ
title.romaji: Ocha ni wa Nazo no Hito Kire

194228.description:
“Money? Beauty? Power? It’s all for the taking!”

A magical app turns an underachiever’s life around! Money? Beauty? Power? It’s all for the taking! Ning Xiaofan was an unremarkable teenager from a poor family who was often bullied by his classmates, until one day, when a magical app called the “Three Realms Online Shop” suddenly appeared on his phone. Ever since then, Ning Xiaofan’s life has been thrust onto a completely different path, taking him from zero to hero.

(Source: Comikey)

194231.description:
A gentle but timid demon, Kijima Chiyoda, struggles to find a job in Hell, where there are only hardcore sportsmen. Meanwhile, he finds a job in the present world as a driver for the "afterlife," taking the souls of the dead to the Sanzu River. Kijima is happily hired on a provisional basis. Drivers are basically demons from Hell and celestial maidens from Paradise who welcome the dead. Kijima meets his partner, the celestial maiden, Amou Botan, but she is a girl who loves ramen with a strange flavor... This is the start of a comedy about a rough celestial maiden and a gentle demon working as drivers for the "afterlife"!!

(Source: Sunday Webry, translated)

194232.description:
The Miss Campus Contest is held as the highlight of the university festival. Sayama, who is a member of the beauty pageant executive committee at Senkyodo University, puts a certain idea into action in the face of criticism that "beauty pageants should be abolished because they promote lookism." Amidst the swirling of various intentions, the story is about the heroine Meme, who has an overwhelming sense of self-affirmation, beginning to shine on the beauty pageant stage.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: グランプリは私ですけど何か？～自己肯定モンスターのミスコン無双～
title.romaji: Grand Prix wa Watashi Desu Kedo Nani ka? Jiko Koutei Monster no Misukon Musou

194233.description:
When our hero awakens a mysterious system, he gains ten incredibly powerful beast girls as companions! This former loser teams up with his adorable yet fierce beast girl partners, climbing step by step toward the pinnacle of global power. An epic adventure filled with heart-pounding action and unbreakable bonds is about to begin! When our hero awakens a mysterious system, he gains ten incredibly powerful beast girls as companions! This former loser teams up with his adorable yet fierce beast girl partners, climbing step by step toward the pinnacle of global power. An epic adventure filled with heart-pounding action and unbreakable bonds is about to begin!

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: Primordial Ten Fiends: Others Tame Beasts, I Tame Beast Girls
全民觉醒：让你退学，你培养太古十凶

title.native: 太古十凶：别人御兽我御兽娘
title.romaji: Tai Gu Shi Xiong: Bie Ren Yu Shou Wo Yu Shouniang

194234.description:
Takao, an Edo courtesan, was killed for talking back to her favorite samurai. When she wakes up, she has become Takigawa Kasen, a high school girl who is being bullied in the Reiwa era. Thanks to her experience as a courtesan, Takao unconsciously fights back against the bullies. Meanwhile, Kasen's consciousness seems to remain in her body...

(Source: Natalie, translated)

194235.description:
Wi-Jeong left his hometown in agony after falling in love with his older brother’s fiancée, a secret he could never confess. Seven years later, he returns to Seorabeol and unexpectedly reunites with Jin-Hui, a boy he once knew but had long forgotten. As memories resurface, so does a promise from the past that Jin-Hui has never let go of.

"You said you would reward me if I waited patiently."

"Wi-Jeong, now...let’s become a real couple."

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: At the End of This Night

194236.description:
Woo-Un is a member of an unsuccessful idol group about to end their contract for good. As a final bid to save their careers, the group resorts to enacting gay fanservice to boost their popularity. When Woo-Un is paired with fellow group member Jae-Sam to play-act as a couple, he’s secretly delighted. He has a crush on Jae-Sam, and this is the perfect opportunity to sneak in some justified physical affection. However, Jae-Sam seems reluctant to play along. Will they be able to save their careers this way? And is there more at stake than Woo-Un is aware of?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Part of RIDI's Sengmotjung Danpyeonseon (섹못죽 단편선) Collection.
synonyms: [Sex or Die Anthology] Stop the BGP!
xxできないと死ぬ＜ビゲパを止めてください＞

title.english: Do or Die: Play to be Gay

194237.description:
Ahn Si-Young has waited for years for the day he becomes old enough to ask out his crush, Seo Do-Hyun. That day finally comes when Si-Young starts interning at Do-Hyun’s company, albeit with a strange mission: “Have sex with your crush in the office, or you will die.” Even though this is Si-Young’s long-awaited chance at love, is this really the right way to go about it...?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Part of RIDI's Sengmotjung Danpyeonseon (섹못죽 단편선) Collection.
synonyms: [Sex or Die Anthology] The Delay of Success
xxできないと死ぬ＜成立遅延中＞

title.english: Do or Die: Work On Hold

194238.description:
Kim Gyo-Joo is a cult leader, a scammer, and a man who likes his money easy and his work easier. But one day, a bizarre quest is dropped on him by the heavens: get ravaged by ten of his own believers in three days or die. He has no interest in men, but he has even less interest in dying. Now he’s bargaining, scheming, and gritting his teeth for the most humiliating survival mission of his life.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Part of RIDI's Sengmotjung Danpyeonseon (섹못죽 단편선) Collection.
synonyms: [Sex or Die Anthology] Holy Cult Leader
xxできないと死ぬ＜聖なる教祖様＞

title.english: Do or Die: A Holey Mission

194239.description:
Plagued with splitting headaches, Ji-Min finds a doctor who diagnoses him with terrible news: he will die in three days unless he consumes someone else’s load. Ji-Min dismisses this as a quack doctor’s perverted scheme… until he wakes up to a mysterious screen counting down to his death. Seeing that the screen also states the same cure as the doctor did, Ji-Min decides to swallow the truth and the cure. Thus begins a series of steamy encounters that will save and change Ji-Min’s life entirely.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Part of RIDI's Sengmotjung Danpyeonseon (섹못죽 단편선) Collection.
synonyms: xxできないと死ぬ＜Sトキシン＞

194240.description:
Jeong Ji-Ho is a low-ranking gangster faced with a life-threatening dilemma. He must have public sex with Choi Hee-Seong within three days, or he will die. But how is he supposed to get it on with a man, much less the underboss of a rival gang? He’ll have to find a way, even if it means opening himself up to new options...

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Part of RIDI's Sengmotjung Danpyeonseon (섹못죽 단편선) Collection.

194241.description:
From afar, it looks like Seren Lubave's set for a fairytale ending. Not only was she saved by the emperor from certain death, but it turns out she’s also his fated partner, the only one who can suppress his dragon blood. But Seren never asked for this, and now she can’t shake off the sense that something’s wrong. What is the emperor keeping from her, and why can’t she remember the attack that brought her here in the first place? She's about to discover fairytales should never be built on lies...

(Source: Tapas)

194242.description:
Shiono, a tsundere junior detective, and Takoi, a humanistic detective in his 40s, are now united both physically and emotionally. Shiono's transfer has made their relationship long-distance, but they are still in love, thanks to the efforts of Shiono, who is a doting man who is always in love with the person he falls in love with! But Takoi's frustration is heightened by the arrival of a high-spec handsome man named Date, who calls Shiono “Shu”!

(Source: J-Publishing, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: love is too far away, kissing is too close, again!!!

title.native: キスは捜査のあとで アゲイン
title.romaji: Kiss wa Sousa no Ato de: Again

194243.description:
Unlike her name, Chan-Ran has been living a life of poverty and dreary life. She meets a theater club on the verge of closing down and becomes the main character.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes 15 side story chapters.

194244.description:
The Snack Festival is being asked to move locations due to the development of a large-scale commercial facility. The members of the Snack Festival plan to set up a honey trap for Ayase, the man in charge of the development plan, but Mari, who is firmly opposed to this, has a secret. She was caught in a honey trap in her previous life and died...

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: 生まれ変わってやり直させて

194246.description:
The year is 20XX. An evil organization suddenly appears in Tokyo, plotting to take over the world. Only the invincible magical girl can defeat and purify them! This magical girl is immensely popular among the people, but her true identity is... an ordinary male high school student, Ryou! Ryou has feelings for his childhood friend Kana, but it turns out that Kana likes Kise, the most popular boy in school. Moreover, when Ryou helps Kise during magical girl activities, Kise is captivated by his magical girl form. What will become of this love that begins without the knowledge that the magical girl is actually a boy?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: 僕は魔法少女（♂）に恋をした。
title.romaji: Boku wa Mahou Shoujo (♂) ni Koi wo Shita

194247.description:
Kohaku attended the wedding of her childhood crush. After drinking too much out of frustration, a medical student named Haruaki came to look after her. Kohaku made an important promise with him.

(Source: Flower Comics, translated)

synonyms: 部族オメガバース -黎明の花嫁-

194249.description:
Rira, the daughter of the Tachibana family, is on the verge of ruin, oppressed by her family and not allowed to walk in the sunlight. The only way to escape from her household is to get married, but her potential spouse is a perverted old man who admires Western dolls at night. Just when she thought she had no choice but to endure it, Rira finds out a weakness of Azumi, the eldest son of the famous Nishioka family, and proposes to him.

Without realizing that this marriage would be troublesome, the story of a marriage between a strong-willed daughter of ruin and a reclusive son of a duke begins!

(Source: Flower Comics, translated)

title.native: 花妻と宵闇〜没落令嬢は純血を捧ぐ〜
title.romaji: Hanazuma to Yoiyami: Botsuraku Reijou wa Junketsu wo Sasagu

194250.description:
Hotaru is a sheltered young lady who doesn't know what love is... What is the ultimate item that Hotaru, who is looking for "true love," has obtained? The quest to find love begins with her childhood friend Tora!

(Source: Flower Comics, translated)

title.native: 虎くんは今日もお嬢様に試される
title.romaji: Tora-kun wa Kyou mo Oujosama ni Tamesa Reru

194251.description:
Daigo Murayama feels burdened by the expectations of others, so he quits his job as a hairdresser and repeatedly changes salons. When his mother calls him back to his hometown, he meets an elementary school student named Miku, who becomes his "boyfriend." Miku has a secret...!?

(Source: Flower Comics, translated)

title.native: ちいさな空にさんかくの太陽
title.romaji: Chiisana Sora ni Sankaku no Taiyou

194252.description:
Hinako has lived a smooth sailing life. She became a teacher, which was her dream, but contrary to the expectations of those around her, her days were not going well. Feeling that her students were scary, she was feeling down alone in the park with no one to talk to, when a mysterious handsome 20-year-old man called out to her. For the first time, she was able to share her wounds and feel healed, but in fact, his true identity is...!?

A legal but forbidden love begins with this 20-year-old boyfriend...!

(Source: Flower Comics, translated)

title.native: 禁断は二十歳になってから
title.romaji: Kindan wa Hatachi ni Natte Kara

194253.description:
A Mikoto Bird Master is a professional who controls birds and exorcises the "impurity" that comes from the negative energy of humans. Ichika is a girl who lives alone in a rural town, inheriting this secret business and fighting against impurity every day. While studying at university and looking for a fiancé in order to produce an heir, she meets Amane, who is also a Mikoto Bird Master. However, he is incredibly flashy...

(Source: Flower Comics, translated)

title.native: サディスティックオープンマインド

194255.description:
Yang Long, the heir of a wealthy family, has started living alone, but he is too naive and ends up in a lot of trouble. Then, a woman named Song Yun appears, saying that she came to become a bride at the request of her family...!? The strange married life of the two begins!

(Source: Flower Comics, translated)

title.native: ふたりぐらし奇譚〜中華的浪漫物語〜
バニーナイト・トリートメント

194257.description: A special side-story collection compiling various short stories originally created for birthday fairs, mail-in bonus booklets, and more!

title.native: 「寄宿舎の黒猫は夜をしらない」番外編集
title.romaji: "Kishukusha no Kuroneko wa Yoru wo Shiranai" Bangai-henshuu

194258.description:
Kang-To Lee, a company employee thirsty for success, keeps getting interrupted when he is about to embark on an important project that could lead to his promotion. The cause turns out to be...a fortune teller?! 'You can change reality by dreaming?' Kang-To's desire grows uncontrollably after learning the cheat key to turning his life around.

(Source: Naver, translated)

194259.hashtag: #まだ捨てられないでいる #まだ捨て

title.native: まだ捨てられないでいる

194260.description:
An ordinary girl is reincarnated as Diana, the heroine of a third-rate novel who marries the male lead and ends up dying from being overworked as a healer. Earning a spot at the Academy of Magic is just the beginning — can she sidestep the male lead and find a happy ending with Rozen, the man of her dreams?

(Source: Manta)
synonyms: I Refuse This Kind of Reliance

title.english: The Healer Will Not See You Now
title.native: こんな憑依、お断りします

194261.description:
Thirty-year-old manicurist Toshi Agawa is a devoted fan of the idol group FLAT. For the first time in two years, he’s finally going to see them live, together with his new friend “Kazusa,” a fellow fan he met online who managed to snag them tickets to the upcoming concert. It’s the perfect match — not only does Kazusa share the same intense love for FLAT, but they both stan the same idol! However, when Toshi arrives, the man waiting to meet him looks less like a fan and more like a yakuza thug! Will he still survive the night and have fun?

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: コワモテくんと推し活

194262.description:
A world where conflict between humans and demons has continued since ancient times. Codenamed , who has been raised as a spy since childhood, is entrusted with the important mission of infiltrating the Demon King's castle. However, due to a certain person's scheme, the mission fails early on and she is imprisoned in the Demon King's castle. There, she witnesses the end of a brutal war caused by the Demon King's son, Prince Aries, going out of control with his magical powers. If only she could redo this entire mission and stop the prince from going out of control... Coral, who fervently wishes this, obtains the "Book of Time Travel", which allows her to go back in time just once. During the redo of the mission, she discovers a new side of Prince Aries that she cannot reveal to anyone!?

(Source: Dbook, translated)

title.native: 殿下、甘えていいから闇堕ちしないで?

194263.description:
"It has to be you and no one else."

(Source: Pixiv, translated)

title.native: お飾り妻は冷酷旦那様と離縁したい！～実は溺愛されていたなんて知りません～ アンソロジーコミック
title.romaji: Okazari Tsuma wa Reikoku Danna-sama to Rien Shitai!: Jitsu wa Dekiai Sareteita Nante Shirimasen Anthology Comic

194264.description:
"Official Sex" In the corporate underworld lies the Secretary Association, an organization that holds lowlife people as paws known as "secretaries". These secretaries fight in sex battles with corporate funds and assets wagered. Amidst all of this, there is one ranked number one: Ryuga. After his most recent victory and payout, Ryuga was enjoying a walk and a cigarette when suddenly he bumped into some hot shot in a suit. After some arguing and money changing hands the two hoped to never meet each other again... until the following day when Ryuga learns his new patron is the very same man, CEO of a big company. Onizuka is a ruthless businessman in the corporate world, and although he's not fond of the fact that he has to get his hands dirty with the Secretary Association, he's willing to do whatever it takes. "Are you sure you can keep winning?" Those words set off Ryuga to prove himself to Onizuka, but it seems Onizuka is different from anyone else up until this point...?!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Notes:

Park Soo-Yeon has been in a long-term crush. And that's someone who isn't interested in love or romance. All he can do is become a 'slightly special person' who is different from others. He doesn't like this relationship, but he thinks it's the best he can have. Until he hears, 'Let's have a go.'

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

I like stars. They say that if you see a shooting star, your wish will come true. Although my wish of having the same feelings as the person I like has never been granted... ..But this wish has never been granted?! I didn't mean to bring a sex-crazed alien into my house!!

194271.description:
Anna Shepherd’s life as a school teacher is up-ended in a single day when she’s fired after a drunk, steamy night with her school’s sponsor, Max Harpman. However, her unemployment ends as abruptly as it started when she’s invited to work as a child’s private tutor. Which is great, except for the fact that her student’s guardian is her handsome one-night stand, Max. Things are further complicated when Max requests her to give him private lessons on high society etiquette. As a series of sensual encounters ensues, Max learns as much as he can about Anna… including her mysterious past.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Furuya-kun is a popular boy who is known as the most flirtatious in school. One day, he falls in love with Shinaharu-san, the most narcissistic person in school! However, it seems difficult to get in Shinaharu-san's eye...? With unique characters, there's laughter, tears, and a frustrating romance! A youthful romantic comedy.

(Source, Hakusensha translated)

194273.description:
In a world where humans and supernatural beings have begun to coexist, the Special Operations Squad deals with ongoing incidents between the two races. One night, Rin, a sword-wielding squad member, rushes to a crime scene only to find—a blood-soaked vampire princess, Lavia, standing beside a headless corpse of a fellow squad member. Though evidence at the scene suggests Lavia couldn’t have done it, she remains the sole suspect as a high-ranking vampire. To convince her commander who insists on detaining Lavia, Rin forms a contract with her: “A pledge to drink no human blood except Rin’s”! With nowhere else to go, Lavia is invited to Rin’s home, beginning their cohabitation in search of the true culprit. As they unravel the mystery behind the incident, their daily life of shared blood and emotions gradually deepens into a bond that transcends species…

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

28 years old, single, and without a boyfriend, Kanae Yano’s life changes forever when she is suddenly summoned to another world! There, she’s greeted by Duke Zach Skrein and his daughter Rita, a noblewoman who looks just like her. They plead with Kanae to take Rita’s place as her body double and marry King Eugene Eistalotte, a cruel dictator feared as the “Cold-Hearted Wolf.” Since the summoning magic is unable to send her home, Kanae has no choice but to accept. But when she finally meets the King, she discovers his true identity…

A fantasy romance about reuniting with a first love begins!

(Source: Manga UP!)

But as her boyfriend becomes increasingly distracted with work and his coworker keeps poking her nose into their relationship, Sae-Yi fears the worst. Feeling lonely even when they’re together, Sae-Yi starts to wonder “what if?” as her heart wanders toward Zi-Ho.

194304.description:
Ju In-Cheol had it all...sharp suits, political connections, and a rising career as the trusted aide to Assemblywoman Lee Myeong-Seon, a ministerial candidate destined for power. But politics is a knife's edge, and one wrong move can send even the best men tumbling.

When In-Cheol loses footing in the ruthless hierarchy of the office, he's handed a near-impossible task: resolve the explosive redevelopment dispute in Songmun City's Jungang District. Failure means exile. He's ready to do whatever it takes – until he meets An Pyeong-Hwa, the quiet gym owner next door and the key to the problem. Pyeong-Hwa's price for cooperation?

"Hit me. That's all I want."

Behind that strange request lies something darker than bruises. And as In-Cheol sinks deeper into the deal, he realizes every favor, every blow, is pulling him into a world where politics and pleasure share the same shadow.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

194306.description:
This was originally a relaxing island trip, but she accidentally fell into the situation of being hunted down with a mysterious handsome man, and even was framed into the police station by him. How will this unhappy encounter turn out?

“It's commonly believed that I'm arrogant and aggressive. Let's teach them what arrogance really is! Anyone who dares to provoke me is doomed!”

When she wakes up, she finds she's inhabited the body of the Prime Minister's eldest daughter, a long long time ago. And as it turns out, this girl has just had two engagements annulled one right after the other—one to the crown prince, and then one to his younger brother after that! 194308.description: Shun is part of Free Thinkers, a company that assists people with animal trouble. With his dog Rokko, and trained hawk Ina, he teaches humans way to respect and co-exist with animals.

194309.description:

As it turns out this foreigner was none other than crown prince Harold of the kingdom Cerulean! And now his handler claims the ring means that Miya has become his betrothed. Now Miya must head to Cerulean and clear up this misunderstanding. But there are dark forces after Harold's life and his right to the throne!! Will Miya safely make it back to Japan, or will she become a victim in the nefarious plot to take Harold's life?

“Are you after some ransom money? Just call my wife, she’ll pay whatever you ask.”

“To the rest of the world, you’re already dead. I can do whatever I want with you.”

Li Jian raised his hands and struck Min Zhao. Wincing in pain, Min Zhao retaliated by slapping Li Jian across the face.

“Do you really hate me this much? I saved your life, and this is how you thank me?”

“Do you expect me to be grateful, you psycho?!” Li Jian fires back.

“No matter what, you’re not leaving me. You’re safer here.”

(Source : Bilibili, translated)

194313.description:
Manae works as a companion, and has done for some time. Her younger coworkers call her "Mana the Devil" because of her strict, haughty, domineering attitude at work. But the truth is, she's still not over being told, "You're strong, so you don't really need me, right?" by her ex-boyfriend. Since then, Manae has stayed away from love and been committed to work, but one evening she meets Rinya Shinozaki, secretary to a congressman, at a party. He's quite taken with her, and while acting like a gentleman, Rinya beautifully and cunningly tries to steal a kiss from her lips. Although it feels dangerous, Manae thinks that giving herself over to this man and the pleasure he has to offer could finally release her from her fears...

With Joo-Hyuk's help, Eun-Beom gets a job as an intern at a pharmaceutical company, but through the existence of 'Carbo', he learns that the company was created by the vampire Lord. Minazou, an eight-year-old boy living in Tokyo during the times of scorching heat, is saddened by his parents' divorce and family separation. He seeks comfort in the popular manga Mokumoku Man. Its author, Shishio, much like Minazou, is unable to fulfill that certain hole in his heart. Together, where will the chaotic world woven by their thoughts and prayers lead?

(Source: East Press, translated)

title.native: 調教豪華客船　女子大生陵辱クルーズ
母子交姦　恋人は幼馴染みの母
title.romaji: Boshi Koukan: Koibito wa Osananajimi no Haha

title.native: 艶巫女の棲家 ~僕と母娘の極甘研修~
title.romaji: Tsuyamiko no Sumika: Boku to Oyako no Gokuama Kenshuu

194331.description:
“Don’t you want to sleep with me just once?”

“I guess you forgot that this is a business marriage. Or do I look cheap?”

Seol-Young was the one who brought up the subject as soon as the meeting was over. She knew that this was a political marriage. Marriage was an escape for her, and she wanted to get pregnant and see her biological mother. Beom-Hyeon, who was smoking a cigarette in the smoking room and clicking his Zippo lighter, took the cigarette out of his mouth and said, “Can’t you see this as an extension of business?”

“What kind of business do you do with sperm?”

(Source: Naver Series, translated)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

194332.description:
The adventurer Soyuz accepts a certain request from the guild and meets Rena, a girl whose body is covered in severe scars.

Using a mysterious healing power known as “Life Sharing,” Soyuz heals her wounds and gives hope to a girl who has long suffered abuse as a slave. However, Soyuz belongs to the guild for a specific reason—he is searching for someone, and the journey ahead carries the risk of death.

Because of that danger, he believes Rena should choose to live freely on her own. Yet her feelings for him turn out to be far deeper than he expected…

Endowed with miraculous power, what choice will Soyuz ultimately make?

(Sorce: Kimicomi)

title.native: 命分けの冒険者 ～不幸少女を救ったら全力で崇拝されたので責任取らざるを得ない～
title.romaji: Inochiwake no Boukensha: Fukou Shoujo wo Sukuttara Zenryoku de Suuhai Sareta node Sekinin Torazaru wo Enai

194333.description:
Blair, known for being promiscuous, is cursed to suffer from a fever if he does not have sex on the day of the full moon. The curse started when he was young and was captured by wolves in the forest and returned, and Blair believes it was the young wolf he met at that time who did it. While searching for someone to relieve his fever as usual, but coming up empty-handed, Blair is hugged from behind by a strange man. With his shirt off, his long hair, and his obvious suspiciousness, this man claims to be Blair's companion...?

"I found you, my companion."

(Source: Lezhin, translated)
synonyms: Hug Me When the Full Moon Rises

title.native: タイトル：みんなちがって、みんなイイ～年下の義弟を妄愛する3姉妹～
title.romaji: Minna Chigatte, Minna Ii: Toshishita no Gitei wo Mouai Suru 3-shimai

194335.description:
In-Woo has been liking Ha-Jun Kwak, who lives next door, since he was little. However, Ha-jun Kwak has a different vibe from In-Woo and is more popular, so they even play in different groups at school. The only connection between In-Woo and Ha-Jun is that they live next door. They were able to become friends because they lived next door, and their relationship continued, but once the college entrance exam is over and they become independent, this relationship will naturally end—In-Woo thinks so.

“I wish I could be a senior in high school my whole life.”

“That crazy kid.”

“Really… ”

However, on the day of the college entrance exam, a sudden scream and the sound of someone running away echo through the previously quiet hallway…

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

title.native: 田舎の親戚とHをする話 夏海編
title.romaji: Inaka no Shinseki to H wo suru Hanashi: Natsumi-Hen

title.native: 田舎の親戚とHをする話 -小冬編-
title.romaji: Inaka no Shinseki to H wo suru Hanashi: Kofuyu-Hen

194338.description:
Cha In-Woo, who is timid and has no presence, becomes partners with Kwak Ha-Jun, who looks exactly like his favorite student, among his new friends. While Cha In-Woo is excited to become friends with Kwak Ha-Jun while doing homework together given by his teacher, he suddenly gets caught up in a mean bet by Kwak Ha-Jun...

A fresh and bashful romantic comedy between two high school students!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

194339.description:
This is a world where beast-taming is the norm. Animals, plants, elements, spectres, robots… the nine-tailed flame fox, tree of life, thunder cloud fairy, skeleton lord, robotic fleet maiden, and even antique blades that cultivated spirits can be kept as pet beasts. The humans who form a contract with, nurture, and tame them are known as tamers. Shi Yu, a mythologist and archaeologist, found himself transmigrated to this world. In search of a missing past and a forgotten legend, he embarks on a journey of unconventional taming…

(Source: Webnovel)

194340.description:
The sorehead lady who lost her memory was sold to a rich merchant to become an ordinary rough servant girl. The handsome but sickly old master, the cheerful but careless young master and the piano player who is both enemy and friend with her... When she is entangled with them by fate, how will the story develop?

(Source: WebComics)

194341.description: The story will focus on the untold past of Tsukuyomi Momoka and Ousuke Momokado.

title.native: 桃源暗鬼外伝 ～月と桜の狂争曲～
title.romaji: Tougen Anki Gaiden: Tsuki to Sakura no Kyousou Kyoku

194342.description:
Drifted girl gets fucked in an obedient manner!! Suddenly, Carla is asked to become a magical girl named MagiGal and protect the world. But MagiGal's true identity is a Majiiki Girl (Seriously Excited Girl)...!? Karla is forced to have sex with a stranger after being surrounded by obstacles, and she just lets them do what they want!? A big-breasted high school girl gives a deep throat blowjob, squirts, and urinates while getting creampied!

(Source: Fanza, translated)

Note: Published in COMIC BAVEL 2023-06

194343.description:
Bu Weizhen, a 18-year-old college student, suddenly was told that there is a 5-year-old biological daughter Zhang Xinyi, which Bu Weizhen's life become a mess because of the appearance of Zhang Xinyi...

(Source: WebComics)

194344.description:
Minori, who has entered a university in the city, seems wary of meeting her senior, who she didn't like in high school. There's no way he'll leave the ignorant, sexy-bodied Minori alone, so she's lured into a love hotel and they get carried away and start having sex. She's seduced by the senior's words, and even though she denies it, her body is drowning in pleasure as she engages in erotic acts...

(Source: Fanza, translated)

Note: Published in COMIC BAVEL 2023-10, 2024-06

194345.description:
All Yun Je-Jin wanted was to succeed in life by climbing his way out of misery and misfortune - but his life takes a nosedive when he ends up a debt collector’s target, all because he co-signed a loan for a friend. With nothing to his name and revenge on his mind, Je-Jin decides to pay it off the hard way...by becoming a gangster himself. But unbeknownst to him, someone’s been watching his back: Choi Taek-Mu, a thug with a heart as big as his muscles, and a not-so-secret crush on the rookie mobster. As the two work together toward Je-Jin’s goal, vengeance might not be the only thing that’s coming in red hot…

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: Un plat qui se mange froid
แค้นนี้ขอทุ่มสุดตัว

194346.description:
The comic tells a series of strange and scary stories that Zhang Xiaonian and his classmates experience in high school. One night, Zhang Xiaonian suddenly met the revenge of the hanged ghost in the Internet cafe, and resolved the crisis by accident. Thus, Zhang Xiaonian's strange story wonderfully unfolded.

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: I Am for the Common People
Those Years I Lived for the People

194347.description:
Late at night, a woman runs into a girl standing alone in a convenience store parking lot. The girl, carrying a swimming bag, has a gloomy expression on her face. When she offers the girl a ride home, the girl shakes her head, so the woman invites her to go for a drive instead.

(Source: Aokishi, translated)

Note: Originally published in Aokishi Magazine vol. 8A

title.native: 息継ぎの正しいタイミング

194348.description:
Ye Ziling is a gifted girl who inherited her family's supernatural power of the Yingyang Eye, but she thought she would also inherit the family curse, doomed to die at the age of 18. Until a suspicious man suddenly appeared, claiming to be her fiancee and treating her with doting devotion. It turns out that he's no ordinary man, but the King of the Underworld himself. As unbelievable events unfold, a love that spanned three lifetimes will be consummated, and a conspiracy across the three realms of heaven, earth and hell must be defeated. How will they come together to find a way through?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Guiwang de San Shi Chong Fei

title.native: 巨乳連れ子の性欲が強すぎる話
title.romaji: Kyonyuu Tsurego no Seiyoku ga Tsuyosugiru Hanashi

title.native: 会社帰りにコンビニでコンドーム落としてしまった話
title.romaji: Kaishagaeri ni Konbini de Condom Otoshiteshimatta Hanashi

194351.description: In order to save the 5th year students taken into the world of ghost stories, Nube sensei has to travel beyond time and space to bring his students back

194352.description:
In the 1930s, a new student enters the Shichisei Dorm at Taiwan's most prestigious high school which flies the banner of freedom and independence. Yeh Hsing-Chiao successfully passes through the "narrowest of narrow gates" to get admitted into Taihoku High School. He muddles his way through life and moves to Taipei to fulfill his family's expectations of him to become a doctor.

His roommate Nanjou Yuntarou is widely known at the school to be a problem figure for his unruliness and love of reading, but he is in danger of being kicked out of school because he has skipped too many classes. These two young men with completely different personalities become good friends. In this cradle of freedom and intellectualism, they share the same feeling of youthful confusion and longing. One day, Nanjō Yuntarō suddenly says to Yeh Hsing-Chiao with great excitement, "The style of the Syohfu Magazine is so rigid, let's create our magazine!"

Comic artist Zuo Hsuan did a lot of research to vividly depict student life inside and outside the gates of Taiwan's most prestigious high school during the Japanese colonial period. This comic not only presents the unrestrained spirit of high school students, but also provides a detailed illustration of the history, architecture, and clothing of Taihoku High School. Through the adventure of these two young students, this work also reconstructs a charming and beautiful story about high school in the 1930s.

(Source: Taiwan Comic City)

Note: Winner of the the Silver Prize at the 18th Japan International Manga Awards.

title.native: 僕の大切な彼女が従兄弟の巨根ショタに寝取られちゃう！？
title.romaji: Boku no Taisetsu na Kanojo ga Itoko no Kyokon Shota ni Netorarechau!?

title.native: 姉ちゃんは、おねショタ同人作家

194356.description:
The legendary horror manga returns with treasured stories to add to the collection! This spin-off series follows Nube, Hiroshi, Kyoko, and the others as they experience untold stories in Domori. A short serialization to celebrate the new anime adaptation!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.english: Hell Teacher: Jigoku Sensei Nube PLUS

194357.description:
The goal is to marry a voice actor!? For Hikari, who lives a happy single life devoting everything to her idol, the news of her otaku friend's marriage came to her like a meteorite. "I want to get married too... If possible, I want to marry my idol! (Serious) Come on, otaku, stand up!"

(Source: Comic Fuz, translated)

title.native: え？ 結婚って３次元でもできるんですか？
title.romaji: E? Kekkon tte 3-jigen Demo Dekirun desu ka?

194358.description:
"Nekokaburi Encore!" is the story of Hirose Otoko, a girl who wears a cat costume outside and plays the role of a good "heroine". Her brother, who knows her rough nature, can't bear to see his sister forcing herself and begs her to stop because it's disgusting, but Otoko doesn't listen. Her senior, Matsuki Makina, notices Otoko's true nature and scouts her to join the drama club, asking her to use her acting skills in something other than wearing a cat costume. Believing her senior's advice that even if her rough nature is revealed, she can get away with it by saying it's "preparing for a role in a play", Otoko decides to go on stage.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: ネコかぶりアンコール！

194359.description:
Azusa, a new idol, is worried that when she gets on stage, she turns into a cold-hearted idol due to extreme nervousness. One day, she picks up a one-horned demon beast called Pechimo... Will Azusa be able to become a full-fledged idol with Pechimo's help?

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

194360.description:
A love comedy about a yandere assassin and a totally innocent girl who avoids danger! The main character, Sumika, has always been unable to read the mood of a situation, and people have always kept their distance from her. One day, when she handed a handkerchief to someone she was fighting with on the street, the next day that person transferred to her school...? "I quit being an assassin for you. Please fall in love with me." Her first confession was a terrifying signal that her life was being targeted by an assassin organization.

(Source: Manga Park, translated)

title.native: 病まずに恋して、殺し屋さん！
ごいっしょに男の娘はいかがですか？
title.romaji: Goissho ni Otokonoko wa Ikaga desu ka?

title.native: 勉強会のハズだったのに…
もう全部俺一人でいいんじゃないか？奴隷殺しの聖杯使い
title.romaji: Mou Zenbu Ore Hitori de Iin ja Nai ka? Dorei Goroshi no Seihai Tsukai

194365.description:
During the war, Tama married and moved to Hokkaido from Tokyo. She was lonely and met a stray cat, Chape, who saved her. However, in Hokkaido, plans were being made to "donate" cats to the government for their fur...

(Source: Comic Trail, translated)

194366.description:
The innocent bud has finally blossomed...

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic X-Eros #111

194367.description:
I want to confront that old regret... ❤

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic Bavel 2024-02.

194368.description:
Laviange, the first daughter of House Robur, is known for being disagreeable, irresponsible, talentless in magic, and utterly uneducated. Everyone believes she’s completely incompetent—but is she really as useless as they say? The truth is far stranger. This is Laviange’s third life. In her first, she was a legendary villainess and genius mage. In her second, she was an ordinary woman who lived to the age of 86—in Japan?! For her third life, she’s decided to take it easy. Hiding her magical talent, she happily plays the part of an inept young noblewoman, enjoying the freedom it brings.

But her carefree days come to an abrupt end when an outdoor training exercise goes horribly wrong. With the sense of an old lady and the power of an unstoppable mage, her accidental rampage turns her reputation on its head. The most hated girl in high society is about to become its most beloved?! The strongest villainess’s riotous comedy begins!

(Source: J-Novel Club)
synonyms: A Notorious Villainess Enjoying a Life of "Talentlessness and Incompetence" in Her Third Life

title.english: Notorious No More: The Villainess Enjoys Feigning Incompetence
title.native: 稀代の悪女、三度目の人生で【無才無能】を楽しむ
title.romaji: Kitai no Akujo, Sandome no Jinsei de [Musai Munou] wo Tanoshimu

194370.description:
A supernatural force traps four students in a dilapidated school building on their second day at school. If they don’t solve seven different mysteries before the sun rises the next morning, they’ll be stuck there forever?!

Takuma Sakai, author of Butareba -The Story of a Man Turned into a Pig-, delivers a suspenseful supernatural boy-meets-girl mystery!

(Source: Manga UP!)

title.native: 君の眠れる怪異の校舎
title.romaji: Kimi no Nemureru Kaii no Kousha

194371.description:
1. Akogare Iro no Canvas... (あこがれ色のキャンバスに･･･)
2. Koujichuu Desu yo!! (工事中ですよ!!)
3. Mushiba Darake no Love Song (虫歯だらけのラブソング)
4. Short Cut (ショート♡カット)
5. Kiss no Daishou!? (キッスの代償!?)

title.native: あこがれ色のキャンバスに…

194372.description: Note: Published in 5 parts on Kanabun's PixivFANBOX account.

194373.description:
A love contract romance between a seemingly cool wolf prince and an oppressed poison witch! A turning point arrives to the daily life of Mabel, who spends her days oppressed as a "Poison Witch." After she helps Jude, a wolf tribe prince, he proposes a contract marriage to her. With nowhere else to go, Mabel accepted Jude's offer and began a new life. At first, Mabel was afraid of Jude, but as they spend time together, she gradually realizes his kindness and hidden affection—?

(Source: LINE Manga, translated)
synonyms: The Unhappy Poison Witch’s Happy Marriage

title.native: 不幸せな毒魔女の幸せな嫁入り
title.romaji: Fushiawase na Doku Majo no Shiawase na Yomeiri

194374.description:
The super popular VTuber group ReGLOSS has been made into a manga for the first time! This work depicts the everyday lives of these girls, who are the talk of the town for their streaming activities and singing covers, that you don't usually get to see!

(Source: Flower Comics, translated)

title.romaji: ReGLOSS: Bad de Good na Nichijou

194375.description:
1. Koube Ijinkan (神戸異人館)
2. Kaze no Hoozuki (風のほおずき)
3. Kazehikaru Asa (風光る朝)
4. Teramachi Kyoumachi Kouyamachi (寺町・京町・紺屋町)
5. Spade no Joou (スペードの女王)
6. Akai Peter Pan (赤いピーターパン)

194376.description:
Orcas are the rulers of the sea, hunting everything from penguins to whales several times their size with their intelligence and organizational skills! This is a youthful love story about the student council, featuring an orca-like student council president who tries to rule a closed-off, listless school, and Nae, a penguin-like girl who is excited about Shachi and struggles to change the school!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: シャチくんとラヴな服従

194377.description:
In a post-apocalyptic world where civilization has fallen into decline, two girls go on a journey together. Mekuri, a girl who believes that "manga" is a history book of civilization, and Kiyoshi, a girl who doesn't believe in manga but can do manga-like things because of her superhuman strength, set out to decipher all the manga that exists.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

194378.description:
Shinobu attends the private Eikai Academy where the elite gather. Shinobu works part-time to support her sick mother and five siblings, but one day she is scouted to be a tutor for Kazuma, the heir to the Amano family, a large conglomerate. This is a romantic comedy about a poor high school girl and a spoiled heir.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: 坊っちゃま、おもしれー女でございます

194379.description:
Tenma, a maid who serves the Tsukishiro family, a family famous for their roses, has a crush on their handsome and mysterious heir, Aoi. Due to her position, she has lived her life hiding her feelings, but one day, when she accidentally touches Aoi, she feels a shock as if she has been pricked by a rose's thorn...! "The curse of the rose draws out the true feelings of those who touch it..." Tenma finds out that Aoi has been cursed with the "rose curse", but...

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)
synonyms: The Secret of the Blue Rose

title.native: 青薔薇様にはヒミツがある
title.romaji: Ao Bara-sama ni wa Himitsu ga Aru

194380.description:
Mitia, a girl reincarnated as a noble, dreams of living a free life as a gorgeous, elegant villainess. However, in a world where magical ability reigns supreme, her lack of aptitude for advanced magic relegates her to being the lord of a faraway frontier land. Yet with a domain to do whatever she pleases and subjects who grow fond of her, this underhanded banishment might be the key to fulfilling her dreams! Now this little girl will fight up the ladder to become the ultimate villainess!

(Source: Manga UP!)

title.native: 華麗なる悪女になりたいわ！～愛され転生少女は、楽しい二度目の人生を送ります～
title.romaji: Kareinaru Akujo ni Naritai wa! Aisare Tensei Shoujo wa, Tanoshii Nidome no Jinsei wo Okurimasu

194381.description:
In 2020, when the coronavirus started to spread, Ruri, an ordinary high school girl, realizes that her previous environment was not normal at all. After seeing the news that a celebrity had lost their life to coronavirus, she becomes afraid to go outside.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: 私たちは学校に行くのをやめた
title.romaji: Watashitachi wa Gakkou ni Ikuno wo Yameta

194382.description:
Mitia Lumiol is set to be another selfish jerk of a noble, one among many who elevate only those with pure bloodlines and great magic. Then, suddenly, she remembers her past life—a lonely, stifled one where her only solace was books and the characters who broke ground where the corrupt stood. Resolving to become just like her favorite villainess, Mitia targets the nobility who rule the land of Elmia with an iron fist. She'll meet kindness with mercy and meet cruelty with ruthlessness. And she isn't going to let anything get in her way—not nobles, not rioters, and certainly not the fact that she can only perform “worthless” household magic. Mitia will show them all what true evil is. And who knows? A cool, elegant villainess might be just what Elmia needs.

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title.english: I'll Become an Elegant Villainess! Time to Enjoy My Second Life to the Fullest
title.native: 華麗なる悪女になりたいわ！～愛され転生少女は、楽しい二度目の人生を送ります～
title.romaji: Kareinaru Akujo ni Naritai wa! Aisare Tensei Shoujo wa, Tanoshii Nidome no Jinsei wo Okurimasu

194383.description:
Juri is a big fan of Ryuusei, a member of W1. She decides to pursue her love of idols and become an idol manager. Juri becomes interested in Reo of Stormy, when she becomes his manager, but before she knows it, Reo is approaching her! A romantic relationship between a manager and an idol is bound to cause a stir!

(Source: Flower Comics, translated)

title.native: マネがアイドルに推されて炎上不可避です!?

title.romaji: Aruhi Totsuzen, Otto ga Aijin wo Tsurete Kuru Mono desu kara…

194385.description:
Ako Oomine is 16 years old. She is a high school girl who is a little taller than most people. On her first day at a rural high school, she meets the man of her dreams. He is Sato-kun, who is a little shorter than most people. Sato-kun is honest and cool, and Ako falls in love with him in an instant, but...

(Source: Flower Comics, translated)

title.native: 私の彼氏は、かわいいけど世界でいちばんかっこいい

title.native: ある日突然、夫が愛人を連れてくるものですから…
title.romaji: Aruhi Totsuzen, Otto ga Aijin wo Tsurete Kuru Mono desu kara…

194387.description:
In order to save her idol, a super idol otaku girl is reincarnated into a super handsome guy!!
Kai Suga is a girl who loves K-POP idol Jinnan with all her heart. Jinnan is her reason for living, her sustenance, and her daily healing. But one day, Kai receives unbelievable news. Jinnan has committed suicide.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: アイドル転生－推し死にたまふことなかれ－
title.romaji: Idol Tensei: Oshi Shi ni Tamafu Koto Nakare

title.native: 同じ夢みた君はアイドル

194391.description:
After moving to big city, small town high school girl Tano-San finds the culture shock immense and only wishes to go back to the countryside.

That is until she meets the beautiful yet mysterious Rurika Towa, a girl who is super popular with boys and yet has no female friends.

Will an unlikely friendship begin between the two girls or will it turn into something more?

(Source: Galette, translated)

Note: includes one extra chapter.

title.english: I Want You to Show It Only to Me
title.native: 私だけに見せて欲しい

194392.description:
An "unknown boy" has defeated the Demon King and saved the world. The whole world waits to learn of who he is, but it turns out the boy himself has forgotten everything. Then two people appear before him, both claiming to be his "family".

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)
synonyms: Nobody Knows About the Hero Sonata

title.native: ソナタはいったい誰なんだ

194394.description:
A light novel series adapting the events and routes of the Steins;Gate My Darling's Embrace visual novel.

Note: Includes 7 extra chapters.

194395.description:
"In exchange for me talking dirty...let me live here?"

Mebuku is an office lady who loves BL and has never had a boyfriend. On Christmas Eve, when searching for fap material at a manga cafe, a gay man named Aoi, who she had never met, proposes that they live together on the condition that she "listen to his sexy stories"!? Aoi's exquisite dirty talk will satisfy her mind and body...!

They're neither friends with benefits nor lovers. 100% pure "I just want to tell/listen to dirty talk," a gay man and a fujoshi's shared sex life begins!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

194397.description:
In a world where swords and demons clash, Hana is a samurai who has lost all reason to live. One day, in the heat of battle, he comes face to face with a god—Amanogawa Josui, a vessel-god who can control water. With no other purpose in sight, Hana forms a pact with the deity, who seeks to return to the capital of heaven, and embarks on a journey that will change his fate forever…

(Source: Yen Press)

194398.description:
Original manga based on the Sonic the Hedgehog video game franchise.

Follow the Blue Blur, known for being the fastest thing alive, as he teams up with Yuta, known for being a slowpoke. Together, they'll travel through the jungle, encounter many formidable foes, and hopefully save the world!

(Source: IDW Publishing)
synonyms: Sonic and the Blade of Courage

title.english: Sonic the Hedgehog: The Blade of Courage
title.native: ソニックと勇気のつるぎ

194399.description:
Chikamori, an office worker, was a sugar daddy, paying two girls money in exchange for having them call him "daddy" and having sex with him. When Chikamori received his appointment, the girls threw a moving-in party for him because he was moving out. Then Chikamori noticed a third girl, Yume, who was not there as usual. Yume had a certain relationship with Chikamori.

(Source: Mujin Comics, translated)

Note: Published in Comic Mugen Tensei 2025-05

title.native: お父さんとまたいっしょ!!

194401.description:
He left, and this lipstick was his final gift. She must lose it if she wants to lose this stupid love... She needs companionship, redemption -- someone to end this awful loneliness. Lipstick and cats are her saviors. A stick of expensive lipstick with no owner plays the role of the God of Fate, connecting the lives of two different people. Seductive colors, taboo colors, colors for singletons... Every girl has her own style of lipstick, and every color tells a story. Perhaps your story could be here as well?

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: The Wonderful Colors of the Lipsticks

194404.description:
When Meng Hao—Tianshui City’s most powerful tycoon—lay dying, a penniless stranger appeared out of nowhere. With miraculous medical skills, the young man pulled him back from the brink.But the real shock came after.Meng Xiner, his gorgeous, wealthy granddaughter, never expected her grandfather’s first decree upon waking: "Marry him."And if that wasn’t humiliating enough? The old man insisted the "country bumpkin" become her "personal" secretary—stick to him like glue. Now, this ice-cold heiress must tolerate her new "fiancé" shadowing her every move... while hiding the secret that he’s anything but ordinary.

(Source: Mangatoon)
synonyms: Da Lao Xia Shan: Kaiju Chengwei Nan Mi
The Big Boss Comes Down the Mountain: Starting as a Male Secretary
The Boss Goes Down the Mountain: Starting as a Male Secretary
Urban Divine Doctor Descends the Mountain

title.english: BOSS SECRETARY: The Mountain Master's Office Game
title.native: 大佬下山：开局成为男秘
title.romaji: Dalao Xiashan: Kaiju Chengwei Nan Mi

194405.description:
A movie queen from the modern world accidentally traveled to be the unwelcome young lady in an noble mansion. They wanted her to sacrifice as a pawn in the court fight, but she was no longer a cowardly young lady who would take bullies without fighting back! For those who bullied her and insulted her, she would make them pay tenfold! Let's see how she made the tables turn after being reborn!

(Source: WebComics)

194406.description:
High schooler Gyu-Bin Ji, a psychic who can read minds, meets Byeol Yu, a mysterious new classmate. The twist? Byeol is actually a human-hating alien in disguise, sent to decide humanity’s fate! As unexpected sparks fly between them, Gyu-Bin must win Byeol's heart—and save Earth! Will he make it?

(Source: Manta)

194407.description:
Kyung-Jin Min, a cheerful new hire, expected a normal office life—until she was assigned to Jun-Woo Jung, the ruthless workaholic known as Hades. No one lasts under him, but Kyung-Jin won’t back down. When unstoppable optimism meets immovable perfectionism, sparks fly in this fiery office romance!

(Source: Manta)

194408.description:
I can't escape his piercing blue eyes...

Soon to be wed, Princess Rosetta embarks on the final journey of her freedom. During the trip the party are saved by a strange woman. But when it turns out her injured savior is also due to be wed, Rosetta volunteers to help the ceremony proceed. Little does she know her world is about to change.

(Source: Manta)
synonyms: 花嫁の代役をしたらさらわれました

194409.description:
I transmigrated into my favorite novel — as the doomed villainess Ione! To survive, I must protect my beloved stepson Edwin and play the perfect duchess in a contract marriage. But when it’s time to break the marriage contract, my newfound family won’t let me go. What happens when the villainess is no longer the villain?

(Source: Manta)
synonyms: I Can't Get a Divorce Because the Duke Is Too Fond of Me!

title.english: The Dukedom's Men Interfere with the Divorce
title.native: 公爵家の男たちに溺愛されて離婚できません!
title.romaji: Koushakuka no Otokotachi ni Dekiai Sarete Rikon Dekimasen!

194412.description:
Riko Kohinata has never been particularly interested in romance. However, she doesn't make a big deal about it, unwilling to admit it to herself or others. One day, while studying at her classmate Tomoka's house, a young girl wearing a school backpack comes in! It turned out that Tomoka has a younger sister who's an elementary school student. Riko is so captivated by the cute little girl that time seems to stand still, but the younger sister reacts to Riko with hostility instead…

A heartwarming story of a high school girl who loves children and an elementary school girl who wants to grow up. This age-gap girls' love comedy is about to begin!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 咲きそめコンプレックス
無頼 実録・藤田五郎

194414.description:
In the secluded town of Riverwort, Jade and Oje grow up relying on each other as family. But when Jade is suddenly consumed by an uncontrollable rut, he loses control and hurts the person he loves most. Consumed by guilt, Jade chooses to disappear, leaving Oje behind with nothing but unanswered feelings, until news arrives that the ship Jade boarded has sunk, forcing the truth of their bond to surface in the most devastating way.

(Source: Lezhin US)

194415.description:
Notes:
-Originally published on Mar 12, 2021
-It was later released as a one-shot in Comic Penguin Club 2023-03 on Jan 30, 2023

194416.description:
Jiseok hardly does any work, playing hooky and sleeping with the whole office. That is, until the new intern arrives...

(Source: Toomics)

194417.description:
Ji-Han Yoo played Hero of Legends but always lost to pro-gamer, Gamgak. Fed up, he jumps ship to a new game, but the guild master, Yoo-Chae, picks a fight over his gamer ID. But when Yoo-Chae finds out Ji-Han used to play HoL, he becomes obsessed. Can Ji-Han withstand Yoo-Chae's relentless pursuit?

(Source: Manta)

194418.description:
When a failing web novelist drops dead at his desk, he's granted a wish in the underworld... and uses it to enter a novel. But instead of becoming the main character, he possesses Kang Shin-Hyuk, a total extra! Now set to be the protagonist's future teacher, Shin-Hyuk's out to use what he knows of the original plot to borrow the hero's power-ups for an easy, carefree life. But in a world of monsters and danger, can Shin-Hyuk really rest easy? Or will he be made to buckle down and hustle once more?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: The Swordsmanship Instructor at the Academy
I Became a Swordsmanship Instructor at the Academy

title.english: I Became a Swordsmanship Instructor at the Academy
title.native: アカデミーの剣術指南になった
title.romaji: Akademii no Kenjutsu Shinan ni Natta

194419.description:
A heartwarming comedy about a dog and its family! He wants to be with his beloved master forever and ever! Saburou the dog adores his owner, Fumi-chan. After learning that dogs have a short lifespan, Saburou makes a wish to God...

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: わんこのボクとふみちゃんと
title.romaji: Wanko no Boku to Fumi-chan to

194420.description:
Saya admires Ao-kun, who is in the same class as her. The two attend the same figure skating club. They were both active in singles, but they decided to form an ice dancing pair...!?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: 絶対に手を離してはいけない!
title.romaji: Zettai ni Te wo Hanashite wa Ikenai!

194421.description:
Roselyn, who was exiled due to a minor(?) incident involving her witch clan, opens a public bathhouse called the 'Men's Bathhouse' in the capital of the empire. While she was busy managing the business, dreaming of killing two birds with one stone by using her specialty of potion making while seeing handsome men, one day, the magician Michael Winterman, who was suspicious of the bath's efficacy, comes to visit. Roselyn ends up spending a night with Michael due to an accident. After that, she meets Michael repeatedly, who keeps coming to her, and Jibril comes to find her in the desert. Michael and Jibril meet at the men's bathhouse! For some reason, the two men seem to be engaged in a war of nerves over Roselyn... ?

(Source: Naver Series, translated)

194422.description:
In the middle of the South Pacific, on a remote island, there is an impregnable nursing home from which no elderly person can escape. 73-year-old Noh Gu-Sik, who is preparing for the end of his life after losing his wife, is greeted by the elderly people as soon as he enters the home. In an unfamiliar environment, Noh Gu-Sik becomes the subject of conversation by displaying his characteristic forcefulness instead of his characteristic adaptability, and at the same time, he meets and develops feelings for Mrs. Kang, who looks exactly like his wife. However, in the meantime, he becomes the target of the dark force that rules the nursing home, the 'Long-lived Elderly Association', and Noh Gu-Sik engages in a fierce battle with the seniors' association executives and develops his love for Mrs. Kang. Having found hope in life again, Noh Gu-Sik tries to escape the nursing home with Mrs. Kang and start a new life, but Jo Bang-Cheol, the chairman of the seniors' association and the hidden director of the nursing home, interferes.

How will Noh Gu-Sik survive in the face of an unstoppable, enormous power?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

194423.description:
Yui has been transferred to other schools many times, and is always trying to fit in with the people around her. However, she is unable to read the mood well, and often ends up spinning her wheels. One day, a boy in her class, Minato, mistakes her for extorting his sister ...!?　When she approaches him to clear up the misunderstanding, the fate of the two of them begins to change dramatically. What is in Yui's past? What are the problems facing Minato's family?

A youthful love story about growing up while facing others despite the emotional scars.

(Source: Manga Mee, translated)

194426.description:
Capella Axinon is the only daughter of Corvus Axinon, the man known as the "Grim Reaper Duke." When Capella is framed for the murder of her fiancé Oberon, the second prince of the kingdom, her father abandons his daughter to the guillotine. Capella swears revenge on her father and, as she is killed, wakes up in the past as a baby. Now she has years in his shadow to enact her revenge! But what’s that voice...? It can’t be that she can hear her father’s thoughts?!

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: The Villainess Can't Take Revenge on Her Reaper Father

title.english: The Villainess Wants Revenge on Her Grim Reaper Father!
title.native: 悪役令嬢は死神パパに復讐がしたいのに！ ～人生2周目、パパの心の声が可愛すぎてまさかの愛され物語！？～
title.romaji: Akuyaku Reijou wa Shinigami Papa ni Fukushuu ga Shitainoni! Jinsei 2 Shuume, Papa no Kokoro no Koe ga Kawaisugite Masakano Aisare Monogatari!?

194427.description:
Fed up with his life of shallow relationships, 26-year-old Shin fills the void in his heart by hooking up with other men. One day, he meets a gangster-like man in front of a flower shop. Turns out the man, Maki, actually works there! His smile lights up the room, and his rough demeanor suits his broad frame. He even seems a little flirty with Shin.. The more Shin learns of Maki's powerful charm, the harder he falls. What can he do to make a straight guy look at him in that way...? This is a story of unconditional love between a former delinquent and a lonely man who yearns for human touch!

(Source: Brite Publishing)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: パラノイア・エスケープ
元貴族の四兄弟はくじけない！～ちびっ子だけどおっきなもふもふと一緒に大切な家族をまもるのら！～
title.romaji: Moto Kizoku no Shi Kyoudai wa Kujikenai!: Chibikko Dakedo Okkina Mofumofu to Issho ni Taisetsu na Kazoku wo Mamoru nora!

title.native: 元貴族の四兄弟はくじけない！～ちびっ子だけどおっきなもふもふと一緒に大切な家族をまもるのら！～
title.romaji: Moto Kizoku no Shi Kyoudai wa Kujikenai!: Chibikko Dakedo Okkina Mofumofu to Issho ni Taisetsu na Kazoku wo Mamoru nora!

194430.description: Set in a world where euthanasia is legal, this story follows a protagonist whose husband is scheduled to be euthanized in a year.

194431.description:
Hugo, the grandson of Adan, struggled to reopen the bakery left by his late grandfather. However, he was not good at baking. Meanwhile, Adan's former apprentice, Sumino Mitsuyuki, comes by the store. Hugo decides to ask Sumino, who is not very good at baking, if he can help reopen the bakery, but it turns out that Sumino hasn't made bread for three years! Hugo is at a loss, but... how does the bread made by Sumino taste?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: コマンドレッスン ご主人様は執事に支配されたい
title.romaji: Command Lesson: Goshujin-sama wa Shitsuji ni Shihai Saretai

title.native: ポンコツ悪霊 闇子ちゃん

194435.description:
Kaoru is studying hard for an entrance exam. Until one day, when a strange girl suddenly starts showing up in his room…!

(Source: Tonari no Young Jump, translated)

Note: Published in Weekly Young Jump 2024 No.24.
