194438.description:
The manga is about Koala who writes about daily life, whether it's good or bad, happy or sad, Koala treats every day as a precious day. Koala believes that today is a good day, and tomorrow will be a good day too.

(Source: Anime News Network)

It initially began serialization on the author's Twitter account on June 11, 2021. It was later acquired by Kadokawa who released the first volume on March 17, 2022.

title.native: ROAD59-新時代任侠特区-　少女と血のサカズキ
title.romaji: ROAD59: Shin Jidai Ninkyou Tokku - Shoujo to Chi no Sakazuki

194444.description: A historical drama set in 1882 Meiji Period Japan. A young man who wants to become a general in the imperial army arrives in Tokyo... he will later be known as Shiro Saigo, one of the earliest disciples of Judo and the second student of Judo founder Jigoro Kano.

194445.description:
Hotokeda and Makami work the night shift at a convenience store. The two have a lot of free time and have had casual conversations, but after a certain lie that Hotokeda told as a joke, he unexpectedly opens the door to a whole other world. It's a supernatural comedy about a wolf boy and a young man pretending to be a vampire.

(Source: Natalie, translated)
synonyms: The Wolf Boy Cries at Night

title.romaji: Ookami Shounen wa Yoru ni Naku

194446.description:
Why is the school auditorium so chilly? Who is that hand in the river waving to? The lady ghost who has never felt love transmigrates into the physical world after falling in love at first sight? What's the mysterious one-eyed substitute teacher up to? For the "Ghost Bus" Qiudong, born with the power to converse with lost souls, along with Fengji, the ghost of a man who has lost his memories, and Jingjing, a classmate who is similarly sensitive to the supernatural, how will they help all the lost, longing, vengeful, and regretful people and spirits they meet along the way?

Will Fengji be able to solve the mystery of where he came from? What impact will the truth create? Can the cool and stoic Qiudong ever fill the emotional black hole in his heart? Will his friendly relationship with Jingjing ever develop into something more? In the end, their lives will be determined by much more than just destiny…

(Source: YLib, translated)
synonyms: 幽霊はどこへ？愛の訣別

title.romaji: Gui Yao Qu Na Li?: Ai De Dao Bie

194448.description:
College student Qilin has a habit of releasing "IT" when she holds back too much. She meets Koza, a fellow student from the same college who can't help but speak his mind without restraint. As they gradually become attracted to each other, Qilin tries to confess to him about "IT," but...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.native: チーリンは溜め込むタイプ

194449.description:
Manaka ends up marrying her childhood crush, Koh, who is cool and handsome. But the only reason they got married is because their parents made a promise, as a joke, to marry them and the two of them went along with it. The main problem is, Koh's feelings remain a mystery.

Koh is nice, but whenever Manaka gets close to him, he avoids her and won't even kiss her even though they're married... But, suddenly she wakes up and he is on top of her! (She's too cute... He can't stop himself...) Koh's love for her explodes and he can't stop touching her. Koh's has very strong urges and a hidden fetish!? A cherry boy totally in love, will he be able to save his pride...!?

(Source: Renta!)
194449.hashtag: #俺はキミに欲情しまくる変態です

title.english: You Turn Me On Non-Stop... -My Appetite for My Wife Is Incredible!
title.native: 俺はキミに欲情しまくる変態です…～嫁への性欲が半端ない！
title.romaji: Ore wa Kimi ni Yokujou shimakuru Hentai desu...: Yome e no Seiyoku ga Hanpa Nai!

194450.description:
He said "There's only one thing to do at night in the countryside" but what does that mean? We're living under the same roof, and he continues to come onto me... but I won't lose to a young guy like him!

(Source: Coolmic)

title.english: Weekend Rendezvous at the Second House of Love
title.native: 週末、恋愛付きセカンドハウスで会いましょう
title.romaji: Shuumatsu, Renai Tsuki Second House de Aimashou

194452.description:
“Cross-dressing is the manliest act that only men can do—” Such is the unusual teaching of the sect known as the Cross-dressing School.

Chiharu, a novice monk who just can’t get used to wearing women’s clothes, spends his days constantly being scolded. But one day, he falls in love at first sight with Komari, a real girl who visits the temple. To make things even more complicated, she calls his cross-dressed appearance “cute”…!?

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

Note: Originally self-published, was then licensed by Square Enix for serialization.

title.native: ちはるくんは女装をしたくない！

194455.description: Note: Chapter count includes four special chapter.

194457.description: This compilation includes a short after-story of the Hana wa Sakuka live-action film (originally released as a DVD bonus), as well as the short story included in the release of the second drama CD. Also features a complete collection of previously unreleased short works originally published as bonus booklets.

title.native: 花は咲くか　番外編収録集
title.romaji: Hana wa Saku ka: Bangai-hen Shuurokushuu

194458.description: Special booklet originally bundled with the limited first edition of Boku wa Subete wo Shitteiru Volume 2, which was later digitally released on June 14, 2024.
synonyms: 「僕はすべてを知っている」2巻特装版小冊子
Boku wa Subete wo Shitteiru: 2-kan Tokusouban Shousasshi
「僕はすべてを知っている(2)」特装版小冊子
Boku wa Subete wo Shitteiru Special Booklet

title.native: 僕はすべてを知っている

194459.description:
Flower shop owner Xia Lan takes on Qin Mo, a guy who claims to have money to burn, as an employee. As a smooth talker, he's helped attract many customers to the business. Soon afterwards, more cute guys show up out of nowhere, offering to work for free. And it's all because of Qin Mo?

(Source: WebComics)

194460.description:
The Righteous and Evil male protagonists' souls enter each other's bodies? Both of them keep stirring up trouble in the enemy's camps? Welcome to this world of superpower!

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: The New Leader Wants to Be Good

194461.description:
"After one year, we'll divorce and never speak again."

Ji Yi agreed to He Jichen's fake marriage proposal because she was certain he would never truly love her. From pretending to be married to the real thing, a year later, separation wasn't even an option—they couldn't even bear to be apart in bed. Unable to handle the situation, why not just run away??

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: A Billion Stars Can't Amount to You
Billions of Stars Are Not as Good as You

194462.description:
When Lan Jin went back to her own world three years later, she found that her reputation was ruined. What's more, she had five fiancés and five sons who came from five time-travel worlds. She was not a loser anymore. And all the heroes loved her.

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: The Madam Has Become Big Shots' Favorite One
悪女は今日も汚名返上を頑張っている

title.native: 夫人她成了大佬们的团宠
title.romaji: Furen Ta Chengle Dalao Men De Tuan Chong

194463.description:
The Mist Summit is rumored to be inhabited by an ancient sect that practices magic. The clan is made up of a group of uncontacted people related by the ties of blood. When a boy coincidentally skis his way into the Mist Summit, his wonderful journey begins.

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: Snake Essence Is a Kind of Disease

194464.description:
To cure her mother's illness, Yu Qianqian entrusts herself to Lu Li, who is consumed by a desire for revenge, all stemming from past events. Can these childhood sweethearts return to the joyful times of their youth? Can the lovers, lost on their paths, find their way back to each other?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

194465.description:
Ji-Soo, who was strangely rejected by men, starts dating Tae-Joon, her brother's friend, but hides this fact from her brother Ji-Sung. Ji-Sung, Ji-Soo, and Tae-Joon end up drinking together at home. The two, who have been dating for a month, feel hot just by making eye contact, and eventually, even in the house with Ji-Sung, they are busy exploring each other.

Will their risky sex be able to stay hidden until the very end?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

194466.description:
One rainy night, a middle-aged male driver, Yamato Takemoto, drives a truck with Ruri Umegawa, a female student with attractive long black hair. When she is sheltering from the rain alone after being late from club activities, Takemoto calls out to her. Ruri is offered a ride home because it is a route through the area. Though she is a little worried, she accepts the offer and the truck with the two of them drives towards their destination. However, the place where the truck stops is on the side of a deserted road...

(Source: Fanza, translated)

Note: Released at Comic Market 103

194467.description: A dark suspense story based on the alternate reality game (ARG) by the creator group Daiyon Kyoukai, depicting the boys who committed crimes.

title.native: かがみの特殊少年更生施設 The Escape Begins
title.romaji: Kagami no Tokushu Shounen Kousei Shisetsu: The Escape Begins

194468.description:
One day, after being pushed by a colleague at work and hovering between life and death, Inukai Masayoshi arrives at a strange, enormous mansion called Ne no Kuni. He is about to be eliminated by a clan whose job it is to hunt aggregates of human impurity known as "rats" as they see him as the source of rats, but he is saved by a young man named Haishiro, one of the candidates to become head of Ne no Kuni. Haishiro offers to help Masayoshi, who is about to be disposed of due to a certain clan "rule"...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

194469.description:
Akebono Town, where a huge black memorial monument stands. This town, which suffered extensive damage from a meteorite that fell in the past, boasts the worst public safety in Japan. Unami Haru, who is assigned to the "Akebono Town Criminal Investigation Department Special Investigation Unit 2", begins investigating a certain case. At the scene of a gruesome crime where the victim's body is cut in half, Haru encounters a mysterious life form called "Yobito"... a dark action story presented with beautiful brushwork!

(Source: Comic Days, translated)

title.native: 婚約破棄は自業自得 ～裏表がありすぎる妹はボロを出して自滅し、私に幸運が舞い込みました～
title.romaji: Konyaku Haki wa Jigoujitoku: Uraomote ga Ari Sugiru Imouto wa Boro wo Dashite Jimetsu shi, Watashi ni Kouun ga Maikomimashita

title.native: 婚約破棄は自業自得 ～裏表がありすぎる妹はボロを出して自滅し、私に幸運が舞い込みました～
title.romaji: Konyaku Haki wa Jigoujitoku: Uraomote ga Ari Sugiru Imouto wa Boro wo Dashite Jimetsu shi, Watashi ni Kouun ga Maikomimashita

title.native: 妃殿下の微笑 身代わり花嫁は、引きこもり殿下と幸せに暮らしたい
title.romaji: Hidenka no Bishou Migawari Hanayome wa, Hikikomori Denka to Shiawase ni Kurashitai

194473.description:
Is It Wrong To Seek The Happiness Someone Else Denied You?

Sara, a royal maid in the Kingdom of Saleilles, is ordered by the king to enter a political marriage with the eldest prince of their rival kingdom, Ferrier—but as the body-double of the real princess! But then Sara's boyfriend cheats on her with the princess she considered a friend and turns on Sara completely! Utterly betrayed by those she trusted most, Sara hits rock bottom, heart shattered...

Farewell, Princess I used to love and respect. Farewell, my once-beloved boyfriend.

So Sara makes a decision—she will find happiness in Ferrier no matter what! But that all hinges on her husband-to-be...a reclusive, misanthropic prince who has a slightly difficult personality and is constantly wearing a mask. To make matters worse, rumors are spreading in Ferrier of a terrifying black beast on the prowl...

Can Sara ever hope to find happiness in these conditions?!

(Source: Cross Infinite World)

Note: Began as a web novel on Shousetsuka ni Narou on February 17, 2020. The first official volume was published on September 15, 2020 by Ichijinsha under the M Novels f label.

title.english: The Princess' Smile: The Body-Double Bride Searches for Happiness with the Reclusive Prince
title.native: 妃殿下の微笑　身代わり花嫁は、引きこもり殿下と幸せに暮らしたい
title.romaji: Hidenka no Bishou: Migawari Hanayome wa, Hikikomori Denka to Shiawase ni Kurashitai

title.native: きやすく触れるな黒薔薇に

194475.description:
Matataburris is a girl who retrieves requested items from a polluted sea. People who have extended their lifespans through body mechanization seek her out to recover mementos left behind on the ocean floor.

(Source: Harta, translated)

title.native: 海底清掃人マタタビュリス

194476.description:
Takuma and his childhood friend Natsuko made a promise to have a child when they turn 17. Having spent years together as friends, Takuma's 17th birthday is approaching...

(Source: Harta, translated)

194477.description:
In a remote corner of Japan, the king of a certain country starts living alone. The question is, can he manage without knowing the customs and ways of the world?

194478.description:
When Sankichi sneaks into a samurai residence to rob them, he finds that the family treasure has already been stolen by someone else! To clear his name of the false accusation, the man vows "I'll find the treasure" and begins his investigation with the daughter.

(Source: Harta, translated)

194479.description:
Teru loves playing with a mermaid who is good at imitating people. The mermaid always learns tricks perfectly, but she also demands a reward afterwards...

194480.description:
Shin Eun-Yul loves his brother, but he has been hiding his feelings because he is his family. One day, when he accidentally gets him resident registration certificate, he finds out that his brother Ji-Yul is actually adopted! While his parents are asleep, Eun-Yul can't suppress his desires and ends up laying hands on his brother...

"You don't know how I've been watching over you."

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

194481.description:
On paper, Seong-Baek is the perfect partner. He's sweet, good-looking, and successful. Unfortunately, Min-Chae just can't seem to open up about the fact that she wants more in bed. She finally resolves to tell Seong-Baek after his surprise proposal, half-expecting a breakup. To her surprise, Seong-Baek reveals he too has been holding back in bed.

(Source: Tapas)

194482.description:
"You're mine, so of course the baby is mine too."

I wrapped my arms around my smooth belly, which didn’t yet show any signs of pregnancy. A maternity booklet had fallen to the floor, and an ultrasound photo showing a tiny gestational sac smaller than a fingernail was visible. After seeing it, I turned my gaze to him.

"Why should I give you the child I’m going to give birth to in pain?"

"Hong Si-Ho, you’re mine so of course the baby is mine too."

No matter how much I pretended to be confident, I was afraid of this man. Someone I was born never able to defeat. No matter what I did, Jin Do-Heon was someone I could never surpass.

194483.description:
Mei dreams of spending her after-school time with her boyfriend. However, she lacks the communication skills and courage to interact with boys, so she can't find a boyfriend, let alone someone she likes. Meanwhile, at a family restaurant, she meets a kind boy who lends her some pencil lead...

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

It takes two hours to get to high school. She has only two classmates. Hana lives deep in the countryside, and her first neighbor is a handsome guy from Tokyo, but actually...

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

Aki broke up with his first girlfriend, Yume, just before they had their first sexual experience. After that, they both started dating different people, but it seems that Yume's current boyfriend is married...!?

194487.description:
Mashiro was living the sparkling life of a high school girl in Tokyo. However, her parents are transferred and she has to transfer to an agricultural high school in the countryside! She's excited to be sitting next to a handsome guy, but for some reason he's cold towards her, taking care of cows is hard work, and her days are completely unphotogenic...

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

194488.description:
Teru, who lost her sister at a young age, decides to enjoy his youth to the fullest for her sister. Then he meets the man of her destiny, Soutarou. But he claims that he was the one who killed Teru's sister, Hotaru!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

194489.description:
Morikawa Ringo is summoned to another world and is suddenly surrounded by beasts and in big trouble! The Vampire Marquis proposes to Ringo, "Give birth to my child." Ringo is imprisoned in a castle to increase the number of vampire descendants. Her partner is a ruthless and heartless vampire! She desperately tries to escape, but her sex with him is just too good...!?

A dark fantasy about the strongest ruthless vampire x doting x child-making!? begins!

194490.description:
Nagi wanted to enjoy her youth to the fullest, so she ran for student council president, but her position was taken by a handsome boy named Hairi. Frustrated at losing to a man who only had looks, Nagi decided to see what he could do as vice president. But then she saw a completely different side of him...!?

(Source: Manga Mee, translated)

194491.description:
Nae, who had been dreaming of a fun high school life, is confronted with the fact that she is ugly on the first day of school...!?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

194492.description:
Maekawa-san, who grew up in a single-father household, is a perfect girl who is serious and reliable. However, she doesn't attend class enough and after meeting her upperclassman, Hinata Nagao, who always gets failing grades, an unexpected world opens up before her...!?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.romaji: Kimi to Aoi Yane no Shita

194493.description:
At the age of 7, I saw my father brutally murdered right before my eyes. At the age of 14, the person I considered my second father was murdered! And at the age of 20, I set out on a journey to the world of martial arts to avenge my bloody grudge!

194494.description:
Ren is a man who lives for the moment and according to his desires. After being kicked out of his house by the woman he was living with, he is at a loss when he discovers an extraordinary part-time job...!?

Rikkun, the youngest member of the super popular idol group that I support, has become my real brother after my parents remarried...!?

194497.description:
The story of a possessed person in a book who will not hesitate to kill for her goal. Brinny, who lived in obedience to her stepfather, thought it had nothing to do with her. Until she got involved in an incident with the sickly second prince, Lucian. At a moment of crisis, Brinny used her supernatural powers to save Lucian, and was relieved that everything was resolved when she saw that the possessed person, 'Aridna', was captured. However, for some reason, her beloved sister and the first prince died in a carriage accident, and even Lucian, who became her fiancé, began to act strangely. Wasn't the possessed person executed in the past? Is 'Aridna' still alive? Brinny decides to reclaim the empty space left by the disappearance of her precious people. She will fight the possessed person.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

title.native: 城下町は今日も魔法事件であふれている

194499.description:
Noa Zuiho, a second-year high schooler with amazing tactical analysis skils, is brought to another world!

In order to save this other world from monsters, the goddess gives him the Power of Wisdom, which increases his tactical insight through... erotic actions?!

In an epic war between humanity and monsters, who will prevail? A brilliant strategist rises — with unorthodox methods and adult incentives to motivate his all-female army!

Koma, a high school girl, is a big fan of the idol group IBEE. She enthusiastically promotes their activities on social media, and is so famous that fellow fans call her a "goddess." Meanwhile, she becomes classmates with a boy who looks just like her favorite member of IBEE...!?

194503.description:
Yamato Koichi, a member of the Earth Defense Force, a secret organization that protects Japan from extraterrestrial lifeforms, believes that capturing the extraterrestrial lifeforms will lead to peace in the country. One day, Koichi meets a woman from the Extraterrestrial Life Force. She says that her homeland was destroyed and she came to Earth, and asks Koichi, "What do you want to protect Japan from?" This encounter leads Koichi to face the existence of unreasonable "evil" that nests within this country and cannot be punished by law.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

194504.description:
Ran Eku, who loves athletic boys, dreams of becoming the manager of the soccer club and becoming the girlfriend of a cool player. However, she is dejected when Otaka, a male manager who is one year older than her, scolds her, saying, "You can't even do your job properly, so you've been dating someone in the club for 100 years." However, she gradually begins to see the unexpected gap between Otaka's cool outward personality and his true personality...

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

194505.description:
Lee Gun-Ak, a herbalist and mercenary, lost his head on the battlefield, but that head... was reattached to the body of the Twelve Princes of the Sacheon Dangmun? The palace infighting over the emperor's throne, the Demonic Cult's reinvasion of the Central Plains, the grand plan of the bloodline that the leader of the martial arts world is trying to lead, and the world's best merchant shaking the martial arts world with the power of money. The martial arts world is in a truly chaotic time!! A small typhoon that started in Sacheon, a rural corner of the Central Plains, covers the world. Until a mere herbalist who only knew the names of herbs becomes the king of poison who melts tens of thousands of people with poison!

"Come! I will show you the majesty of a true one-man army!"

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

194506.description:
Ju-In Jeon, a depressed 17-year-old, is offered a ticket to heaven in exchange for her body. But, 13 years later, she wakes up—not in paradise, but in her 30-year-old body… and in the middle of a scam. Stuck for 108 days while heaven's agent searches for the fraudster, Ju-In crosses paths with Do-Gwon Ju, another soul-scam victim in the same situation. But what happens when the souls who bought their bodies come back? Will they return to their miserable teenage lives, or find a way to reclaim their futures?

Editor's Note: This series contains themes and depictions of suicidal ideation that may be upsetting to some readers. Viewer discretion is advised.

(Source: WEBTOONS)
synonyms: ชีวิตที่ให้ไปฉันขอใช้เอง

194507.description:
General surgery resident Yoon Hae-Soo has always focused on paying off her father's debt and becoming a great surgeon. But after CEO Chae Ji-Seok enters the ER as a VIP patient, her world is completely turned upside down. Not only does he want her to be his only doctor, Ji-Seok wants to spend every second with her. Hae-Soo can't understand why a stranger would be so interested in her, but she also feels strangely attracted to him. Little does she know that this isn't their first time meeting...

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: 狂おしいほど求め合う

Watanuki-kun is a problem child who is always late. Wano-san, the student council president, is a serious girl who takes care of all the trouble in the class. The two of them don't have much in common, but Watanuki-kun finds out that Wano-san has a crush on their teacher Tsuji!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

194509.description:
Asuka Shirayama has a crush on her childhood friend and new teacher at her high school. She's always liked him, but just when she was about to give up, thinking that love between a teacher and a student can't come to fruition, she begins to hear his inner voice!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

194510.description:
Mi-Na's world crumbles when her boyfriend of 9 years dumps her a month before their wedding. His shocking confession? He's been cheating on her with her best friend, who's now pregnant with his child. Mina's revenge plan quickly unfolds: hold a fake wedding with Ryeohwi, her childhood friend, as her stand-in groom. As their fake marriage gains momentum, Mina begins to see Ryeohwi as more than just a little brother. Will this charade lead to unexpected love? Or is Mina just playing with fire?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: วิวาห์ลวงสามีจำเป็น

194511.description:
Two agents with nothing in common will have to trust in their skepticism and each other to solve a string of unbelievable cases. A supernatural crime drama featuring an unlikely pair and the bizarre cases they must solve!

Something phenomenal is happening and one mismatched duo will have to find the truth beneath the bizarre. Fires without cause, a mummy roaming a quiet neighborhood, and even sunflowers blooming in the dead of winter—odd occurrences with seemingly no explanation. Yet, beneath the unexplained is something much more dangerous. Anan, a cat-eared demi-human cop is constantly buried in normal, everyday cases until she’s suddenly paired with Kanai. A federal agent with spiked hair, dark shades, and secrets of his own. Together, they’re drawn into a series of investigations that blur the line between the criminal and the supernatural! But they can’t afford to believe in the impossible—not when there’s more serious crimes lurking in the shadows.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title.native: 現象X 超常現象捜査録

194512.description:
When the gang leader is reincarnated in another world, he somehow becomes a young lady!? What's more, his fiance is his reincarnated rival gang leader, so this is sure to result in the engagement being called off... right? A romantic comedy about the pompadour gang leader's struggle to avoid falling in love with a rival gang leader!!

(Source: Nemuki, translated)

Note: Originally a one-shot published in Nemuki+ 2025 July issue. It was picked up for serialization on 2026-10-13.

I dropped out of college and couldn't find a job, so I interviewed at what looked like an ordinary pet salon. The hourly wage is really good... but why is that?

194516.description:
Hinata faces the biggest crisis of his life after his crush at work invites him to a hotel where he fails to perform due to first-time nerves and his prized possession stops working. When his best friend Daichi finds out what he's been searching on his phone, Hinata fears he'll ridicule him, but is taken aback at his offer to help him...!

Hinata can't believe how gently and carefully the coolest guy on the soccer team trains him...! Before he knows it, Hinata's prize begins to react to his touch...!! Daichi's got no soccer on Wednesdays, so he offers to continue their secret trainings every Wednesday...

(Source: Renta!)

title.romaji: Suiyoubi, Kimi ni Sareru ga Mama

194517.description:
"…Sorry, but I don’t want to be friends anymore."

Shinomiya, who gave up on his dream of becoming a pâtissier, is currently lost in life and unsure of his path. One day, he unexpectedly reunites with Nanao, a former classmate from culinary school. Nanao, who never treated him differently even when Shinomiya was at his most defensive, still shines just as brightly as ever. Their reunion leads to occasional meetups, and Nanao continues to believe in Shinomiya’s talent, encouraging him without hesitation. Though Shinomiya feels guilty for being stuck in place while Nanao remains so genuine, he can’t suppress his growing desire—to see him, to touch him. Before he realizes it, he kisses him.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

These heats forced Haruto to give up friends, work, dreams, and aspirations. One day Haruto abruptly reunites with his best friend from junior high school, Akira. Akira was the first person he encountered during his first heat, resulting in a passionate kiss. The passion was overwritten by embarrassment and anxiety, as Haruto felt there was no turning back on the friendship. Soon after, Haruto drops out of school and disappears from every social scene. However, now reunited as an adult, Akira asks him to share a partner contract...?!

There are three beautiful girls at the prestigious and distinguished Lux ​​Boys Boarding School. They are training hard every day in preparation for the upcoming day of competition, the "Social Day" exchange event with the Abyuta Girls Boarding School.

Wuseong Dan, the man who ruled over the martial world with his fists alone. After unexpectedly losing a duel against two practitioners of the Demonic Way, he’s reborn into the body of the wild child heir apparent of the affluent Silver River Merchants. Not one to leave debts unpaid, be they to his benefit or detriment, Wuseong sets out on his path of revenge in the body of Jineon Lee. Using his knowledge of martial arts from his past life and the wealth of his current life, he only has one goal: get stronger and kill those who killed him.

(Source: WEBTOON)

拳王転生～最強の拳王がろくでなし公子に転生したら～

194524.description:
Fuyune, Akioto, and Natsune. Three sisters involved in horse racing and their beloved horses aim for the dream of the "Japan Derby"!! Horse racing can be so "exciting"!!

A new racehorse is born at the ranch of the three sisters who love horse racing and racehorses. They name the racehorse "Shikio", and the three sisters dream of winning the Japan Derby. Time passes, and Fuyune becomes a trainer. Akioto becomes a ranch manager. And Natsune becomes a jockey, and they work hard to pursue the dream they entrusted to their beloved horse. However, Shikio, the important one, lives a simmering day after day as a "racehorse that has given up on winning". A horse racing story about three sisters chasing their dreams begins!!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

194526.description:
Sotaro Shiomi is the ace of the baseball team who can no longer play baseball due to an injury. With his dreams and goals all but gone, he was about to jump off the roof when someone called out to him - Lucy Komatsubara from the brass band. "Do you want to join the brass band?" Moved by this simple question, Shiomi decides to join, but when he joins, he finds out that it's full of troubles that only a brass band can offer! A crazy youth comedy filled with "brass band cliches"!

(Source: Sunday Webry, translated)

194527.description:
As a successful courtesan, Hwayoung believes she’s seen every kind of man the world has to offer. That is, until a nameless new servant arrives at the house. Hwayoung can’t help her curiosity about him, and her flirtations seem to turn him into putty in her hands. But pretty soon, Hwayoung will be the one unable to resist the seductions of this not-so-innocent beast. Just who is the one getting tamed here?!

(Source: Tapas)

What if the ideal type from your dirty dreams appears in real life? And... as a nude model?!

Ryu Kwon, a freshman in the painting department and a genius painter who only knows how to draw, receives public attention for a piece he created that captures the person from his secret dreams. Kwon, who was completely infatuated with a man with a healthy body and a cheerful personality, meets a model who looks exactly like him, Michelle, in a nude painting class, and erotic events begin to unfold between the two...

A man in his 20s with a healthy body, a handsome face, and everything he lacks. He is said to be at an age where he can do anything, but the reality is quite harsh. He lacks the qualifications to get a job, and he can't do a difficult part-time job, so he chose this. A top part-time job where he gets paid to fuck men.

"I thought, 'I can make money while having sex, isn't that so cool?'"

Until I met this customer.

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

Teacher Takeda is giving guidance to his busty half-Japanese student Luna, who is a sugar baby, but she shows no sign of remorse. Far from being remorseful, she unexpectedly says, "I'm okay with being your teacher...!?" Thus, Takeda, who has given in to his desire to have sex with his student, begins "suikatsu," where he pays her to let him suck on her breasts...!

title.romaji: Suikatsu: Houshuu wo Haratte JK no Oppai wo Suu Katsudou

Albert Blake has lived with just one purpose: to avenge his father by killing the master of the cursed Valdez mansion. But when Albert infiltrates the mansion as a new servant, he begins to see through his father’s lies. Master Asha Valdez is nothing like the hideous monster his father portrayed him to be, but rather an immortal vampire whose beauty captivates Albert at first glance, just like it had for his father. As Albert soon finds out, he is far from the first Blake to come to Asha, as his blood has been drawn to the master for generations...

(Source: Tappytoon)

194534.description:
Seong-Yoon, a true otaku who only enjoys Dating Sims, falls for the beautiful Dalsa who looks just like his favorite and ends up entering a motel while drunk...

Why... does my behind hurt like it's been stabbed in the back?

"You were the one who got stabbed. I'm also a man who's into it...^^"

That Dalsa is actually a man...? This cross-dressing man is the most popular kid in our department, Woo Soo-Hee...?! A sweet and cute love story between the scheming master Woo Soo-Hee, who will cross-dress to win over Sung-Yoon, and the nerdy, otaku Sung-Yoon,

Tsuyako always comes off as cold and harsh, and nobody wants to be around her. Except for her junior colleague Mitsuya, who likes being around her and would also like being inside her.

194536.description: Two years ago, Ha Eun-Woo had a one-night stand at a school festival. And it was with actor Han Ji-Woon, who had been his goal and dream, all while dressed up as a woman…! The experience that day remained as an unpleasant memory for Eun-Woo, and Ji-Woon, who had declared temporary retirement due to drunk driving, appeared in front of Eun-Woo, saying that he was his junior. Eun-Woo slapped Ji-Woon in the ear when he greeted him… (Source: Lezhin, translated)

194537.description:
Princess Sistina is demoted to a barren frontier territory due to a certain conspiracy… However, for the ever-curious and studious Sistina, it’s the perfect chance to put her knowledge into practice…!? Thus begins the “Frontier Reform” led by a curious and ambitious princess!

(Source: Tonari no Young Jump, translated)
synonyms: The Demoted Third Princess Begins the Frontier Reform!!

194539.description:
When Detective I-Hwa goes undercover to dismantle a drug syndicate, his mission clear: get close to its cold-blooded boss, Tae-Gon. At first, the plan runs smoothly, until Tae-Gon sees through the disguise. But instead of handing I-Hwa over, he traps him with threats and twisted control, forcing him to stay at his side. As I-Hwa searches for a way out, fragments of a past he thought forgotten begin to surface, revealing that his connection to Tae-Gon runs far deeper than he ever imagined...

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: Even the Trash Was Originally New

194540.description:
Sanho suddenly finds herself as the academy’s only commoner after her school transforms into the world of a romance fantasy novel. Armed with memories of reality, she’s thrown into chaos when a strange mission appears: win over three potential male leads and uncover the truth behind this altered world. Amid dazzling nobles and hidden dangers, can Sanho complete her mission and face the secrets waiting for her?

(Source: WEBTOON)

194541.description:
A guesthouse that 'must' provide delicious meals every day. College student Ha-Ri suddenly has to run the place all by herself. But the only thing Ha-Ri can't do is cook?! There are zero applicants for kitchen staff.. at the awkward moment, a suspicious applicant appears!

(Source: Naver, translated)

194542.description:
Online, Yuni is a glamorous influencer. In reality, she lives in poverty with her timid, overworked mother, Deulre. After a horrific family tragedy leaves Yuni orphaned, she’s suddenly thrust back in time and finds her mother a teenager again. Determined to rewrite the future, Yuni enrolls in her mother's high school to protect her teen mom from her toxic friends and the choices that led to heartbreak, abuse, and death. But changing the past isn't easy—especially when your own mother sees you as the enemy. Can Yuni save her mother… and heal their broken bond in the process?

After spending his childhood in the countryside with his grandmother, Ji-Ho finally moves to the city to attend his dream university. Just one month into campus life, he accidentally walks back into a lecture hall to grab his forgotten wallet - only to stumble upon two men in the middle of a heated encounter. Hoping to slip away unnoticed, Ji-Ho is caught by one of them: the enigmatic upperclassman Yeong-Won. Ji-Ho tries to brush it off and return to normal, but Yeong-Won seems to have other plans…

Hee-Won Jang, a once-revered film director, watched her reputation shatter as disturbing details of her abusive behavior surfaced. As the heir to a beast kingdom, Ayres fell in love with her childhood friend Aunrae, a half-beast. One day, her parents arranged a spouse selection meeting for her. Ayres eagerly anticipated Aunrae's arrival to propose marriage. But little did she know, behind the bouquet presented by the man she loved, lay a violent blood feud... 194572.description:
In a world populated by beastmen, the down-and-out actress, Shen Youqing, happens to be a chinchilla-girl. During an audition, she was nearly sexually assaulted by the assistant director. But she's saved in the nick of time by someone she hadn’t seen in years: Shi Ruolin, who was her first love, arranged marriage partner, fiancée, and mortal enemy. Shen Youqing was looking for a chance to escape, not even bothering to thank her savior, but Shi Ruolin makes her an unexpected offer. Facing dire straits, Shen Youqing gives in to temptation and agrees to endure the humiliation of becoming the pet of the cold-blooded snake, in exchange for a large sum of money. As they spend more time together, they manage to resolve their long-standing misunderstandings, and their mutual feelings grow until they finally agree to spend the rest of their lives together.

"My father is retiring soon, so I need to give back the wedding money he gave me before."

In the world to which he's been transmigrated, those with a vampire pedigree use their special powers to protect humans, while humans survive by offering them food: their blood. Ando Mineo was worried. He and his wife are unable to have children. He realized that the cause lies within him and that there was no medicine that worked on male infertility. In the midst of all this, he made a decision. He would create an infertility drug with his own hands. However, this "dream drug" that would allow anyone to have children would greatly change the fate of Mineo, his family, and their yet-to-be-born child. There is only one saint per generation, but Hestia and Astrea were born as twins. However, only the older sister, Hestia, can perform miracles, while the younger Astrea is looked down upon as incompetent. Her arrogant older sister forces her to take her place for marriage proposals, but the man she meets there is Silvert, the second prince of a neighboring country, and they end up getting engaged...!?

(Source: Gaugau, translated)

title.native: 身代わりで縁談に参加した愚妹の私、隣国の王子様に見初められました
title.romaji: Migawari de Endan ni Sanka Shita Gumai no Watashi, Ringoku no Ouji-sama ni Misomeraremashita

title.native: 爆乳母を本気で口説いたら母乳妻になった
title.romaji: Bakunyuu Haha wo Honki de Kudoitara Bonyuu Tsuma ni Natta

194601.description:
There is only one saint in a generation. The twins Hestia and Astrea overturned this rule. However, the only one who can make miracles is Hestia, the older sister. Astrea is looked down upon as incompetent, and is forced to take part in marriage instead of her arrogant sibling; but by chance she meets Silvert, the second prince of the neighboring country, and she ends up getting engaged!? A Cinderella love story between an incompetent saint who dreams of average happiness and a prince who sees through to the truth!

(Source: M Novels f, translated)

title.native: 身代わりで縁談に参加した愚妹の私、隣国の王子様に見初められました
title.romaji: Migawari de Endan ni Sanka Shita Gumai no Watashi, Ringoku no Ouji-sama ni Misomeraremashita

synonyms: Untied in Dusk: Collected Works of Tsuruji Ohmine

title.native: 宵にほころぶ 大峯鶴次作品集
title.romaji: Yoi ni Hokorobu: Oomine Tsuruji Sakuhin-shuu

synonyms: Spill in Dawn: Collected Works of Tsuruji Ohmine

title.native: 暁にこぼれる 大峯鶴次作品集
title.romaji: Akatsuki ni Koboreru: Oomine Tsuruji Sakuhin-shuu

title.native: 異世界TVヤラセていただきます！

194605.description:
"Those who encounter this hearse will die within 3 days." While working on a yakuza's request, Sho, a private investigator, encounters a duo in a hearse, claiming to be an insurance company. They tell him he will die in 3 days, and if he takes out insurance now, they'll guarantee his "afterlife"...!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.native: 死後保険ネクロマンシング

194606.description:
Yori, a 2nd year high school student suddenly finds herself living with her mother's new husband's son, Seki, a 2nd year university student. When she visits Seki's apartment, a half-naked, scary-looking man comes out... but for some reason, he immediately starts doting on her!? He's frivolous and overly affectionate... but she just can't hate him.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

194607.description:
The joy and loneliness of living by yourself in Tokyo.

If you go around to the back of the building, look for a sign with unreadable characters, there you will find a person surrounded by a cloud of exotic fragrance.

This is another side of Tokyo - a city full of unfamiliar flavors.

Foreigners in Tokyo live hopeful but anxious lives.
This new series vividly captures their "food landscape."
An immigrant's gourmet experience, living life at his own pace.

(Source: to-t.in, translated)
synonyms: Ni Hao, Delicious Days in Tokyo.

title.native: ニーハオ、おいしい東京日和。

194608.description:
1. Natsu no Imouto (夏の妹) [Original title: Kingyo no Onegai 金魚のおねがい]
2. Rockwell ga Waratteru (ロックウェルが笑ってる)
3. Amaoto ni Waltz wo Odorou (雨音にワルツを踊ろう)

title.native: 吉田まゆみ傑作集　夏の妹
title.romaji: Yoshida Mayumi Kessakushuu: Natsu no Imouto

194609.description:
Yuto Hatano has replayed his favorite dating sim, After School Flare Star, more times than he can count. Surely, his real school life would be way more fun if it were more like that game…but after the thought casually enters his mind one night, he wakes up inside Flare Star’s world—not as the protagonist Shun Ogasawara, but as the villain, Kanji Aku! With every heroine’s affection starting at rock bottom, his dream of romancing them all is already in shambles. Worse yet, one wrong choice means instant death. Armed with his expert game knowledge but hindered by his low stats and the heroines’ lower affection scores, Kanji must survive the game’s deadly routes to win over the girls and return to the real world!

(Source: Manga UP!)
synonyms: I Reincarnated as the Villain in a Romance Game I Mastered, So I'll Conquer the Heroine Using My Knowledge of the Original Work.

title.english: Trapped as the Villain in My Favorite Dating SIM: But I Know How to Win over All the Heroines!
title.native: やり込んだ恋愛ゲームの悪役に転生したので、原作知識でヒロインを攻略します
title.romaji: Yarikonda Renai Game no Akuyaku ni Tensei Shita node, Gensaku Chishiki de Heroine wo Kouryaku Shimasu

194612.description:
The science-fiction romantic comedy manga centers on Yukito Takiguchi, an unpopular science college student, who has developed the ultimate matching system. A woman who claims to be his future wife then appears before him.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: 百合神さまの言うとおり!

194614.description:
She throws out the jokes, and I can’t help but be the straight man. An after-school rom-com filled with emotion and laughs!

“Machino-san from the swim team always drops by the Domino Club's room, where I’m the only member, before her practice starts. She constantly fires off jokes in a sketch-style conversation, and I can’t help but fire back. Back-and-forth banter, teasing words. Conversations full of nonsense... and maybe something more. Every day passed in a flash, yet those summer days felt like they could last forever in that clubroom. But when this summer ends, the dominoes between us will all begin to fall, at once.”

“Why did you suddenly start narrating a light-novel-style summary, Machino-san?”

title.native: ツッコミ待ちの町野さん

194615.description:
A world where dungeons have appeared and humans have acquired magical powers... here, the amount of magical power one is born with is an indicator of one's strength. Kai Amachi, the weakest adventurer with little magical power, is braving the dungeons to earn money for the medical expenses of his sick sister, Nagi. However, Nagi's condition suddenly takes a turn for the worse. A huge amount of money is urgently needed for her treatment...!? In dire straits, Kai recklessly participates in the survey of an unknown dungeon with a large reward at stake...

(Source: Overlap, translated)
synonyms: The Gray World is Colored by The Eyes of God: From weakest to strongest with status that only I can see

title.native: 灰の世界は神の眼で彩づく～俺だけ見えるステータスで、最弱から最強へ駆け上がる～
title.romaji: Hai no Sekai wa Kami no Me de Irozuku: Ore dake Mieru Status de, Saijaku kara Saikyou e Kakeagaru

194616.description:
Justin is the domineering, ruthless, and arrogant commander of the Order of the Knights whose very presence strikes fear in those around him. But he wasn't always like this—he actually used to be a college student in the real world who worked tirelessly to care for his 7 little brothers. Now, trapped in this light novel world, he must change his storyline, or he'll be destined to end in ruin due to his villainous deeds.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title.english: I Reincarnated as the “Villain” Commander of an Order of Knights
title.native: 俺、悪役騎士団長に転生する。
title.romaji: Ore, Akuyaku Kishi Danchou ni Tensei Suru.

194617.description:
Narita, a family restaurant employee in his late twenties who is always busy with work, is feeling down about the results of his job interview, while he is having dinner, he is absentmindedly watching a video recommended to him on a video site.

The video shows Sasa Yoruzaki, an artist with an overwhelming sense of fashion and singing ability, despite her cool and slightly cheeky responses.

Later, when he goes to an old laundromat to deal with some laundry problems, he suddenly notices a woman and feels something is off about her. The woman seems familiar, but it is Sasa herself, the one he had just seen in the video.
synonyms: See you at the laundromat tonight

title.native: 今夜コインランドリーで逢いましょう

194618.description:
A disastrous beginning—god-tier progression! The protagonist, a jobless man barely scraping by with part-time work, drifts around like a wandering orphan. His only joy in an otherwise dull and unchanging life is the online game God-Forsaken World. To him, it’s more than just entertainment—it’s an escape from reality. Then one day, while immersed in the game, he hears a mysterious voice from nowhere. When he comes to... he finds himself inside the world of the game! You’d think that after being transported into a game, he would become a cool, powerful protagonist... but no. He wakes up as the Empire’s disgrace and failure of a third prince: Gilroshan Elro de Valt. And if things couldn’t get any worse, the moment he opens his eyes, someone tries to kill him! Trapped in the body of an overweight, pathetic prince scorned by all, the protagonist has one secret weapon—a strategy guide, the key to survival that only a veteran player like him possesses! With the stumbling prince, his loyal knight Carls, and his fearsome yet reliable mage mentor Tirvaen, a new adventure begins—one more intense than reality itself!

“Survive in the body of a good-for-nothing prince? It’s not going to be as easy as playing the game.”

This is an unpredictable fantasy full of laughs, battles, and non-stop survival action!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

194619.description:
Blanc, the most powerful Grade-0 adventurer, known across the world as the Black Emperor. After slaying the Black Dragon that plunged the world into despair, he became a legendary hero. And then, he made a shocking declaration: "I'm retiring from being a Grade-0 adventurer."

Now walking a new path, Blanc—once hailed as the strongest—takes on humble odd jobs as he begins a quiet journey of self-discovery. From Miku, the creator of The Fruit of Evolution, comes a bold new fantasy brought to life on an epic scale!

(Source: Futabasha, translated)
synonyms: Hero Blanc's Plan. He Would Like to Start a Second Life as a Scullery Maid.
The Former Strongest Hero Lives as a Side Character

title.native: 英雄ブランの人生計画 第二の人生は雑用係でお願いします
title.romaji: Eiyuu Blanc no Jinsei Keikaku: Daini no Jinsei wa Zatsuyougakari de Onegaishimasu

194620.description: Suddenly, dungeons have appeared all over the world in modern Japan. Omomo Rei is a genuine loner in the real world, but in the dungeon, he is the only person in the world who has reached the maximum level. Rei, who has cut off all ties with society and is completely absorbed in the dungeon, one day saves a beautiful and famous streamer, Yuria, who has 10 million subscribers, from a crisis. Rei unintentionally goes viral with her dungeon stream, and contrary to her desire for a peaceful daily life, she is drawn into the further secrets of the dungeon, which involve the underworld and even the country!

title.native: 世界最強の陰キャ、ダンジョン配信で億バズる 配信切り忘れのせいで、うっかりレベルカンストしていることがバレてしまった
title.romaji: Sekai Saikyou Inkya, Dungeon Haishin de Oku Bazuru: Haishin Kiriwasure no Sei de, Ukkari Level Counter Stop shiteiru Koto ga Bareteshimatta

194621.description:
Kotoyorozu Kotoha, a boy with an underground past as a former mafia underling, had given up on youth. However, his life changes completely after meeting certain girls.
With massive guns, they fight against mysterious beings threatening to destroy humanity!
This is their school life — full of chaos, action, and unexpected twists. Behind the facade of the world lies a wild and outrageous youth like no other!
A mega-serialized story packed with sci-fi, romance, action, and more — let the fun begin!
synonyms: This Is the End Stagnation Committee.

title.native: こちら、終末停滞委員会。

194622.description:
This world is filthy… Nakayama, a high school boy with an extreme case of germophobia, avoids all social interaction and tries to enjoy his private time alone in a perfectly clean space. But his peaceful days are constantly disrupted by Nishino-san, the cheerful and unpredictable girl who ends up sitting next to him. "Don’t pollute my sanctuary! Don’t intrude on my time!" Contrary to his wishes, day after day, Nakayama is at Nishino's mercy in this chatty rom-com about a germophobe and an unsophisticated high school girl!!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: What Was I Meant to Call This Mess That Wouldn't Go Away?

title.native: 落ちない汚れを僕は何と呼べばよかったのか
title.romaji: Ochinai Yogore wo Boku wa Nanto Yobeba Yokatta noka

194623.description:
It's a story about a man who, for some reason, comes to a farm to experience milking cows, and is made to undergo TS, and then stays that way... Although it's not long on the pages, it is very well-expressed, and I enjoyed it, as it shows the TS protagonist being made to feel good, having his huge breasts squeezed, and being inseminated. There is, however, a bit more that happens afterwards, so that's also something to look forward to.

Note: Released at Comiket 99
synonyms: 1-Day Ranch Experience: Let's Get Some Delicious Milk!
1-day dairy cow experience: How delicious milk is produced

title.native: 1日乳牛体験 ～美味しいミルクができるまで～
title.romaji: 1-nichi Nyuugyuu Taiken: Oishii Milk ga Dekiru made

194625.description:
Rui, a mediocre college student, was shocked as he looked at his reflection in the mirror. The reason being that he had transformed into "Ludwig," the depraved crown prince of a grotesque, hardcore indie erotic game, whose appearance resembled a bloated orc, dedicated to subjecting the heroines to humiliation and training. While he instantly comprehended that he had been reincarnated into the world of an erotic game, unfortunately, this game only offered bad endings.

Above all, in his previous life, Rui was a socially awkward guy, with minimal opportunities to interact with girls, limited to receiving change at a convenience store. Trying to fulfill the game's scenario of humiliating and training the heroines was an impossible feat for him. The only salvation was his knowledge from thoroughly playing erotic games in his previous life and the fact that he had been transported five years before the main story began.

Rui... no, Ludwig made up his mind. He would do everything he could to slim down and present himself in a more favorable light to the heroines, in order to modestly survive and avoid triggering any destruction flags. However, Ludwig was unaware. Little did he know that by shattering these flags, he would end up significantly raising the heroines' favorability in a different way, leading him to encounter a future fraught with turmoil.

(Source: Novel Updates)

title.native: 醜いオークの逆襲 ～同人エロゲの鬼畜皇太子に転生した喪男の受難～
title.romaji: Minikui Orc no Gyakushuu: Doujin Eroge no Kichiku Koutaishi ni Tensei shita Moo no Junan

194626.description:
Shima Yuki, 15, attends a junior high school attached to a music college. His life, which had been all about piano, takes a dark turn, and he runs away from home on his bicycle on a winter night. He gets lost and is chased by a delinquent, where he encounters Miroku, a 25-year-old host who shines as brightly as the night sky. He clings to the drunk Miroku and tumbles into his room, where he finds himself.

A heartwarming story woven by two people with their own problems and nowhere to go.

(Source: Comic Seasons, translated)

title.native: あれは閃光、ぼくらの心中
title.romaji: Are wa Senkou, Bokura no Shinjuu

194627.description:
The story centers on Sachi Amano, a temp worker. At 31 years old, Sachi has no deep romantic experiences, but in her private life, she's a popular "blogger." One day, as she worries about wanting to move forward, she meets a handsome young man who has no experience with women... This is a romantic comedy about a clumsy, love-shy woman in her 30s and a surprisingly pushy and honest man.

(Source: Natalie, translated)
synonyms: Magyaku na 2-ri wa Dou ni mo Dekinai.

title.native: 真逆な２人はどうにもデキない。
title.romaji: Mangyaku na Futari wa Dou ni mo Dekinai.

194628.description:
A demon who has forgotten about himself and his past memories meets Koma, a fluffy guardian dog. It is said that demons are born from the grudges of humans, but the protagonist has no memory of his time as a human. The protagonist, who has been given the name "Oniyasa" is a gentle demon, and goes on a journey with Koma to find his parents.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

194629.description:
My childhood friend, a girl who practices archery, is my rival, an angel, and a Cupid.

(Source: Yanmaga, translated)

194632.description:
The only worry for Ikuma Nagori, an elementary school student who's about perfect at everything he does, is that he has no rivals to compete with. What changed this was his encounter with baseball and Yurimoto Genji, a transfer student from Ehime. In order to "meet at the Koshien finals in eight years", the two genius boys put everything they have onto the field.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.
synonyms: Waiting For You Under the Flow Blue

title.native: フロウ・ブルーで待ってる

194635.description:
A new neighbor moved in next door—7 years younger, polite to the point of formality, yet with a gaze that was anything but innocent. From the very first day, his eyes lingered too long, too boldly. “Did you sleep well after kissing me yesterday, noona?” A casual fling for one month couldn't harm, right?

(Source: Manta)

194638.description:
Ha-Na runs into a suspicious saleswoman on the street who hands her a bath gel sample, saying it'll give her what she truly needs. Intrigued by this cryptic message, Ha-Na goes home and tries out the bath gel, only to be seized by tentacles that suddenly pop out of the water! Thankfully, her childhood friend, Won-Hoo, walks in and saves her, but Hana wants to die of embarrassment. Even so, she can't help accepting more weird "self-care" products from the mysterious saleswoman. Will her questionable samples be the key to helping Hana relax and get closer to Won-Hoo?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

194640.description:
For his high school debut, Minto Shishidou pretended to be an outgoing playboy, spinning lies about the girlfriends he goes through. This corner he backed himself into weighs heavily on his mind when he joins a school trip, and he’s determined to use the occasion to get a girlfriend for real.
But then an unimaginable incident strikes him and his classmates, setting the stage for a locked-room love comedy centered around the wishes of these boys and girls.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: きみの願いが叶うまで
title.romaji: Kimi no Negai ga Kanau Made

194641.description:
1. Youji Taikou (妖児胎肛); ANGEL Club 2023-06
2. Wakaokami wa Companion (若女将はコンパニオン); ANGEL Club 2023-09
3. Zoku Youji Taikou (続・妖児胎肛); ANGEL Club 2023-12
4. Wakaokami wa Companion; in Chuuka Fair (若女将はコンパニオン～in中華フェア～); ANGEL Club 2024-04
5. Rakujitsu no Haha (落日の母); ANGEL Club 2024-07
6. Kazoku no Wa (家族の環); ANGEL Club 2025-01
7. Akume Tantei (悪牝探偵); ANGEL Club 2024-10
8. Coach no Shigoki (コーチのしごき); ANGEL Club 2025-04
9. Extra chapter
synonyms: 若女将はコンパニオン

194642.description:
“You’ve came quite a lot. But sorry... I’m still craving more of you.”

A large body and a strong piston that could hollow you out! My womb is being painted with his divine energy... I’m gonna cum... Ngh! I’m making lewd sexual noises now that I’ve never made before...! Due to the village’s rule that has continued up until present day, a young girl named Saki is given up to a God as a sacrifice. Thinking that her fate was to be killed—The God named Gaira, says he won’t kill Saki. Saki decides she will hide from the villagers and live there with Gaira, but in order to do so, she must absorb his “divine energy” into her “womb.” “Feel me. Tell me you want my hot, hard penis to pierce you, that deep inside of you yearns for my seed...” The strong splashing sound; the slushing of penetrating deep inside. A virgin devouring God, and a sacrificial virgin’s sweet but lewd life together begins...

(Source: Manga Planet)
synonyms: 인간을 싫어하는 신령님은 제물 처녀를 총애한다
บรรณาการรักแด่เทพเจ้า

title.english: Human Hating God Favors The Sacrificial Virgin - His Seeds Deep Inside Her
title.native: 人嫌い神様は生贄処女を寵愛する～オクにいっぱい淫らな種
title.romaji: Hitogirai Kamisama wa Ikenie Shoujo wo Chouai Suru: Oku ni Ippai Midara na Tane

194643.description:
"Won't you have any regrets about breaking off our engagement?" Lady Daisy, the Marquess' daughter, is engaged to Prince Freddie and works hard to become the future queen. One day, Freddie catches an unknown disease. Aside of Daisy's desperate nursing and praying, a saint named Lula comes and saves Freddie. Freddie falls in love with the saint and starts saying that he has found "true love"! He easily dumps Daisy and becomes engaged to Lula. Once her engagement is broken, Daisy's story of fate begins...! This is a story of reclaiming one's life and destiny triggered by a broken engagement.

(Source: Coolmic)

title.english: If You Regret It, So Be It I Wish You The Best With The Saint You've Chosen
title.native: 後悔するならご勝手に～あなたの選んだ聖女様とどうぞお幸せに～
title.romaji: Koukai suru nara Gokatte ni: Anata no Eranda Seijo-sama to Douzo Oshiawase ni

194644.description:
In a world that brands Espers as monsters, B-class Esper Seung-Won keeps his head down, until a false accusation from a chaebol heir ruins him. Suspended from duty and desperate to support his family, he accepts a job guarding Cha Jin-Ho, an untouchable S-class Guide from the same privileged world he hates. Cold and dismissive, Jin-Ho refuses even the slightest touch - until a clash between them triggers an unexpected contact guidance, a resonance that leaves them both shaken. Bound by a reluctant contract, the two are forced together, and Seung-Won begins to dream of a man who looks just like Jin-Ho, calling his name from another lifetime ago…

(Source: Lezhin US)

synonyms: JOKER ブラッディ・フォーエバー

194647.description:
When Banya, the Leaguemaster of the Thousand Malice League, chose Youngso Baekli of the righteous path as his bride, it was supposed to buy ten years of peace. But while his death at her hands risked that peace, the greatest threat proved to be his return to life three years later. Desperate to convince Banya that she didn’t curse him, the couple soon ends up entering a bargain with the Queen Mother herself. With her soul on the line, all that remains is the question: Is redemption possible?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.
synonyms: Lady Yeonju: The Villain Husband I Killed Has Returned
The Consort of the Demon Sect Leader: The Infamous Husband I Killed Has Returned

title.english: The Leaguemaster's Wife: My Villainous Husband Came Back to Life
title.native: 련주부인: 내가 죽인 악당 남편이 돌아왔다
title.romaji: Ryeonjubuin: Naega Jugin Akdang Nampyeoni Dorawatda

title.native: 神童ともてはやされていますが実は化物です
title.romaji: Shindou to Mote Hayasarete Imasu ga Jitsu wa Bakemono desu

194650.description: Mir, born into a wealthy family, abandons all his wealth and fame after a fight with his father three years ago and becomes a psychic! One rainy night, a powerful ghost appears to take revenge on a vengeful spirit. Mir meets a woman who resembles his dead lover and tries to help her...

194651.description: The city is grotesque. Strange incidents that occur in the darkness that no one knows about, countless people who fall victim to those incidents.The souls of countless deaths wander the city. They grow their sorrow and curses by feeding on the decay of the rotten city. Supernatural thriller incidents that occur in the dark and gloomy city hidden in the dazzling neon...

194652.description:
A Taiwanese ink-washed manga based on The Classic of Mountains and Seas. Demons are abroad in search of a legendary treasure – and so the strongest of the demon-slaying gods returns in feline form to defeat the demons and protect the prize.

(Source: Books From Taiwan)

Notes:
- Bronze Award of the 2018 International Manga Award in Japan
- Shortlisted for 2018 Golden Comic Award
- 2015 LINE Webtoon Best Longform Original Work

194653.description:
Cao Xiaoman thinks he's just a guy with a pretty face until the two mysterious guys show up and tell him that he's the reincarnation of Cao Cao – the famous Chinese statesman and warlord in history. Much against his will, he seeks out loyal followers from his past life.

(Source: WebComics)

194654.description: The city of Salsu! The desperate adventures of a lonely man like a lion begin!

194655.description:
...Raw live show. ♥

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic Kairakuten BEAST 2025-01

194656.description:
After discovering the nature of the sexes...

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic Kairakuten BEAST 2025-03

194657.description:
Katelyn Grint has spent her whole life pining for a man who's in love with her best friend. But a chance encounter with Terius Hert, the no-nonsense and infuriatingly attractive commander of her brother's order of knights, turns her world upside down. What was supposed to be a one-time mistake quickly becomes something much more complicated... and permanent. Katelyn is about to discover that not everyone is who they appear to be—and that some firsts lead to the most unexpected beginnings.

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: It's My First Time Being a Mother Again

194658.description:
Deepening their physical and emotional bond. ♥ A faptastic tale of indecent friendship!!

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic X-Eros #121

194659.description:
It is the Sengoku period. Tadaoki Nagaoka lives only to ensure the survival of his family. He never doubts that this is the natural order of things. As a sign of his loyalty as a vassal, he is suddenly ordered to marry. His partner is unexpectedly a girl with an unusual appearance...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: これは我々夫婦のことで、
title.romaji: Kore wa Wareware Fuufu no Koto de,

194661.description: Office worker Kanna Kurisa struggles to achieve results at work. One night meets a woman who seems to embody her own longings...

194662.description:
Uta is in the middle of sex with his younger lover, Shinnosuke. Just as they have finally reached the point of insertion, Shinnosuke's stomach growls and interrupts the moment! Uta can't believe he would stop in the middle of sex because he is hungry! But seeing Shinnosuke's depressed state, he ends up forgiving him.

(Source: Media Soft, translated)
