194666.description:
When Ma Yu locks eyes with the handsome transfer student, she immediately falls head over heels in love. Later that night, she runs into a middle-aged man who bears an uncanny resemblance to Qu Xin. Shortly afterward, she stumbles upon his secret.

(Source: WebComics)

194667.description:
In a brutal battle against the demons to reclaim their territory, humanity’s strongest warrior, Arthur King, is killed at the final moment when he is caught in the Demon King’s blast, only to be reborn as one of them through a mysterious system. Due to a system error, he has no choice but to die again to return to the human world. He throws himself into deadly situations, but fate twists against him, and every attempt at self-destruction pulls him deeper into the demon world.

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: カリオンに死は訪れない
If I Don’t Die Soon, I’ll Become The Ruler Of The Demon Realm!

title.english: Demon Realm: Can't Wait to Quit!
title.native: 再不死我就统治魔界了
title.romaji: Zai Bu Si Wo Jiu Tongzhi Mojie Le

194668.description: A manga essay about Sakae Kusama's work mixed with a classical BL office romance.

194669.description:
He's a bit of a fool, but he's a hard worker. Motohisa is a high school sophomore and the new student council president. He's in love with the reliable vice-president, Ririka, but for some reason they always end up fighting. One day, he finally decides to confess his feelings to Ririka, but at that moment he falls into a loop. Every time he confesses, the loop starts again! He'll never be able to date Ririka. What's going on? A youthful school story in the mix of romantic comedy and science fiction!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title.native: わたしにアイを教えて
異世界転生したけど、七合目モブだったので普通に生きる。
title.romaji: Isekai Tensei shita kedo, Nanagoume Mob datta node Futsuu ni Ikiru.

synonyms: The 7th Station: A Well-Blessed Extra in Another World.

title.native: 異世界転生したけど、七合目モブだったので普通に生きる。
title.romaji: Isekai Tensei shita kedo, Nanagoume Mob datta node Futsuu ni Ikiru.

194672.description:
Between looming war, fighting nobles, and an overbearing father, Prince Yuri Briol has a lot on his shoulders. He's also carrying knowledge of his past life while trying to change the course of history. This cast of characters includes a famed assassin, a powerful mage, a loyal maid, and a lazy knight among the character-filled kingdom of Briol. Yuri may be the third-born prince, but he could also be the most important factor in his family and kingdom's survival.

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: The Third Prince of the Fallen Kingdom has Regressed
Rise of the Fallen Kingdom's Third Prince

194673.description:
In her childhood, Min-Ju was naturally talented, receiving praise for her abilities. However, her confidence takes a hit when she meets young Han-Sol. Feeling a twinge of jealousy and a sense of inferiority towards Han-Sol's talent, Min-Ju tries to keep her distance, but Han-Sol continues to approach her...

(Source: Naver, translated)

194674.description:
Three years ago, a poisoning murder occurred in a luxury apartment. Hwa-Young, who lost her mother in this incident, begins collecting a large sum of money to find the culprit. Believed to make a fortune, she engages in a crime known as "fishing," but soon realizes she's the target of human trafficking... As she struggles to escape, "If you're going to run, take me with you." "Smile Bear," filled with memories of her mother, appears, wielding a blood-dripping hatchet.

(Source: Naver, translated)

194675.description:
Jeonghwan, once a legendary mercenary, returns under an identity no one expected— a prosecutor. His mission is to uncover the truth behind his mother’s mysterious death, the tragedy that robbed him of his peace and future. To take his revenge, Jeonghwan must wield two weapons: violence for those who stand in his way, and the law for those who must be judged.

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: The Prosecutor’s Blade: A Former Mercenary’s Revenge
The Former Mercenary's Life As A Prosecutor

194676.description:
The emperor must be gradually destroyed from within.

Assassin So-Hwa enters the palace to use a beauty trick on the tyrant Yu Ge-On. However, Yu Ge-On suffers from obsessive-compulsive disorder and madness, which makes him absolutely unwilling to approach women.

"If you touch me, you will become dirty too."

One night, when the emperor's madness is at its peak, So-Hwa stands guard in Yu Ge-On's bedroom and tries to take him down, and Yu Ge-On, who has fallen for So-Hwa, begins to become increasingly obsessed with her.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

194677.description:
Eugene receives a wedding invitation from her long-time crush. While drinking to relieve his disappointment, he happens to see an ad for a 'rental boyfriend' - and he becomes entranced by a man with a style similar to his crush and signs up to be his rental boyfriend...

"You signed up, rental boyfriend?"

But what's this? A man with a completely different, fierce appearance than the one in the ad shows up!

"It was originally only available to women... but I'll make it special just this once, rental boyfriend." There's no way... he can't tell him that someone completely different showed up! What should he do...?

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

Note: Includes eight extra chapters.

194678.description:
The master of the mountain who had been sealed for 300 years was awakened.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

194679.description:
Luck has only been on Yeon-Woo's side twice in his life: when he and his brother were saved by an esper named Seo-Joon, and when he reunites with Seo-Joon as a 20-year-old guide. Unfortunately, Seo-Joon doesn't seem to remember saving Yeon-Woo. Not only does the older man see Yeon-Woo as a kid, but he also makes it clear that he doesn't want to get attached to any guide. However, there's no telling what'll happen when their sync rate is so high and Yeon-Woo has had a crush on Seo-Joon for years...

(Source: Tappytoon)

194680.description:
Yeon-Ho Kang is a veterinary student with a strange ability: communicating with animals. Ironically kicked out of his residency program because of this, Yeon-Ho is imposed to figure out how to get back on track, until he is offered a chance to work as a school nurse.There, he meets a strange and mysterious girl named Yeoul, a "feral child," unlike anyone he has ever seen before. A girl so different, yet in the most unexpected way, so similar.

(Source: POCKETCOMICS)

194681.description:
One day, my bias suddenly appeared in front of my eyes. I thought I was finally getting rid of my title as the 'unlucky fangirl". Little did I know, the first thing my bias said to me was, "Stop bullying her." My bias was as cold as ice, and next to him was the tragic heroine, 'Rahee'. When there's a heroine, there's always a viallaness. But that villaness is.... me? I ended up as a villain in a fan ficition overnight.

This is not what I asked for! I want to go back!

(Source: POCKETCOMICS)

title.english: Trapped in a Fan Fiction With My Bias
title.native: 夢小説の悪役になりました
title.romaji: Yume Shousetsu no Akuyaku ni Narimashita

194682.description:
Setia accepts the marriage contract offer from Miere Lunaria, a rich but dim-witted bachelor, only because she needs the money to get out of her family's debt. Only a month into their marriage, Miere goes missing and is presumed dead. Three years later, Setia is shocked when her "dead" husband returns as a hero. Their marriage contract is about to expire, but Miere has no intention of letting Setia go. You see. there's more to Miere than meets the eye... and he's not the half-wit that everyone thinks he is.

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Note: First released in English, with the initial eligible release in Japanese followed by Korean, making it a manga by our standards.
synonyms: Mon mari pas si angélique que ça

title.english: My Angelic Husband is actually a Devil in Disguise
title.native: 溺愛公爵様には二つの顔がある
title.romaji: Dekiai Koushaku-sama ni wa Futatsu no Kao ga Aru

194683.description:
The notorious Empress Belita, famed for her myriad romantic entanglements!

Just when Belita is on the verge of being killed by her tyrant husband while attempting to elope with a prince from a neighboring kingdom, "I" becomes Belita. "I"-now Belita-narrowly escapes death and vows to cease her unfaithful behavior to dispel the emperor's suspicions.

Amidst a palace rife with numerous paramours, a distrustful emperor, and the looming specter of war, can Belita survive?

(Source: POCKETCOMICS)

Note: First released in English, with the initial eligible release in Japanese followed by Korean, making it a manga by our standards.

title.english: How to Make My Tyrant Husband Love Me
title.native: 恋愛初心者ですが不倫皇后に転生しました
title.romaji: Renai Shoshinsha desu ga Furin Kougou ni Tensei Shimashita

194684.description:
Please fulfill your end of our bargain, my Grace! Liscia, abused day and night by her stepmother, wishes for nothing but freedom. One day, she receives a shocking proposal for marriage from none other than a well-known, handsome noble, Duke Lindberd. Upon discussing his intentions, Liscia realizes that he's planning to have a fake wedding with someone who will not interfere with his privacy, just to get people off his back. Liscia agrees to marry him under one condition: Promise her a life with bare necessities, including three meals daily and a nap time! And now, let this be the first page of the duchess' diary of struggles, fighting for a life where she just wants to eat and sleep!

(Source: POCKET COMICS)
synonyms: 삼시 세끼 낮잠이 보장된 생활을 약속해 주세요, 공작님.

title.english: Please Fulfill Your End of the Bargain, My Grace!
title.native: 三食昼寝付き生活を約束してください、公爵様
title.romaji: Sanshoku Hirunetsuki Seikatsu wo Yakusoku Shitekudasai, Koushaku-sama

194685.description: Years ago, the gods fought against each other before being sealed away. However their artifacts remained in the souls of the HuaXia clan as part of a contract and hope that someday in the future, they will awaken once more using those artifacts...
synonyms: The Legend of the Ancient Soul

194686.description:
Gods can only love one god in their lifetime. This is the golden rule, and Artes has already lost his sole love by the time he meets a young Liam. The short interaction plants a seed in Liam’s heart, and his love blooms when he meets Artes once again years down the line. However, Artes cannot love Liam back because of the gods’ golden rule…which will bring death to those who defy it. However, Liam is a temptation that Artes has difficulty resisting. In the end, which will Artes choose: his love or his life?

(Source: Tappytoon)

194687.description:
College student Jae-Yeon gets hit by a delivery bike. She dies and reincarnates with her memories from past life. As a nanny of a little princess, she somewhat gets used to her new life… Except that she suspects the five-year-old daughter of the tyrant emperor is also a reincarnated soul from modern time–just like her! A complete mismatch, the princess and the nanny must collaborate in order to survive in the new world under the tyrant’s rule.

(Source: POCKETCOMICS)
synonyms: À nous de lutter contre le tyran !
穿越者们，如何搞定黑化父皇？

title.english: It's Up to Us to Fight the Tyrant
title.native: 転生した私たちで暴君皇帝を止めるしか
title.romaji: Tensei shita Watashitachi de Boukun Koutei wo Tomeru shika

194688.description:
Ha-Jin was just an ordinary girl who was excited about starting her college life. But her dream is shattered when she gets into a car accident. The next thing she knew, she was Matilda Howard living in a fantasy world! Not only that, but she also realizes she has a secret ability; she can turn people's memories into a book! Although she never intended to reveal her ability to anyone, she decides to help beloved King Daden, who suffers from insomnia. That is when Hajin finds out about the dark past Daden has been hiding from everyone...

(Source: POCKETCOMICS)
synonyms: 本を読むたび男主人公が増えるんです
Les secrets entre les mains de Mathilda
หนังสือที่นำมาซึ่งชายหนุ่ม
我靠读书蛊来好多男主

title.english: Get a Male Lead for Every Book

194689.description:
Yamato is a 16-year-old boy and lives with his cat Kurume, who is estimated to be 11 months old. One night, while looking through a telescope on the roof of his school, Yamato sees his homeroom teacher, Shiina-sensei, crying and yelling at someone. At that moment, Yamato is overcome with emotions he doesn't understand, but Kurume is quick to notice Yamato's state... This is the story of Kurume, a cat depicted as a young girl, jumping into a new world.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

194690.description:
Two high school girls, one an introvert and the other with a phobia of eating together, are on their lunch break!

Igarashi Tama, a gloomy high school girl, has a daily routine of eating lunch alone in the toilet at school. One day, Tama witnesses Tsuda Arisa, who is at the top of the school caste system, eating in the toilet and learns that Arisa has a social phobia. In order to help Arisa overcome her social phobia and to eliminate her own habit of eating alone, she begins a secret lunch break!!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: 会って食べると書きまして。

synonyms: Internal Orgasm Lesson: The Housewife Took a Real, Bareback Sex Lesson with a Another man for her Husband

title.native: 膣中イキレッスン 〜人妻は旦那のためにオスと生ガチ交尾レッスン〜
title.romaji: Chitsu Naka Iki Lesson: Hitozuma wa Danna no Tame ni Osu to Nama Gachi Koubi Lesson

194692.description:
Banished into the Cold Palace, robbed of her newborn daughter, stripped of her status... She wants to avenge her husband now that she’s lost everything. She is his Queen, but she is also the one person that he wants to get rid of the most. She’s his disgrace and he’s her grudge. She rises like a phoenix from the ashes, renounces herself from love and returns full of hatred. After a few battles she says with a smile: “Only one more step. Sadly, you’ve fallen in love with me!” After several showdowns he says in an angered tone: “Even in hell I want you to stay with me!”

(Source: WebComics)

title.native: 蛇蝎不好惹：弃后也妖娆
title.romaji: Shexie Buhaore: Qi Hou Ye Yaorao

194693.description:
After winning the lottery, Na-Hyeon achieves her dream of buying a spacious home. But there’s one other thing she’s always longed for: to be at the center of a devoted reverse harem! It starts small when Na-Hyeon offers a spare room to her childhood friend, Jae-On. Then another man takes a room, and another, and soon enough, she’s surrounded by men who want to please her in their own unique ways! Can Na-Hyeon keep her lovers in check, or will she be smothered by the affection she’s always desired?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: The Four Of Us Have A 0 Chon Relationship
No Friendship Between Four of Us

title.english: The Four of Us, Zero Degrees Apart

194694.description: The news of the destruction of the Earth, which had been circulating as nothing but nonsense, came out on the convenience store TV. At that moment, he lost consciousness with sound of a bang. He woke up a few days later and the city had already turned into ruin. "Where am I...? And who am I?" An old man who had died and a tattoo shaped like an eye appears in the male protagonist’s lost memories. In search of his memories, he heads to the shelter with the female protagonist, but will the two protagonists be able to survive the 465 days before the Earth is supposed to be destroyed?

194695.description:
Sang-Nam lives by one unshakable dating philosophy: “before you commit to it, you must hit it.” If the chemistry isn’t right, he won’t even consider a relationship. The problem is, finding someone who actually meets his standards is harder than it sounds. That’s when he notices Da-Ol, a potential hottie with a not-so-sexy body. Sang-Nam casually suggests that he might consider dating Da-Ol if he can “fix” him to suit his tastes, and a nervous but determined Da-Ol agrees. What Sang-Nam doesn’t know is that Da-Ol has a secret preference of his own…and one he definitely hasn’t told anyone yet.

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: 尊重～それも含めて、君が好き～

194696.description:
Soyeon ranks top of the liberal arts track at her school and is at war with a single, agonizing flaw that is Junsu, the STEM prodigy, and his effortless streak of top scores. Desperate to break him, she crosses enemy lines to unravel him. But as academic rivalry blurs into unpredictable chemistry, Soyeon discovers that the hardest formulas in life are the ones involving the heart.

(Source: WEBTOON)

194697.description:
Byeolha wakes up as Rose, the female lead of a novel who is doomed to be betrayed by her unfaithful husband, Eric. The nightmare deepens when she discovers that her best friend, who stole her husband in their past life, has also transmigrated and is now targeting her husband again. However, Rose refuses to be the victim this time. She’ll gladly let her friend have her worthless husband while she plans her escape to a peaceful life. But fate has other plans when she keeps crossing paths with Arteum, the powerful Grand Duke…

(Source: Tappytoon)

title.native: 甥っ子のガールフレンドをわからせた件
title.romaji: Oikko no Girlfriend wo Wakaraseta Ken

194699.description:
Orla, an orphan raised in the arena. When she discovers that her companion beast, Dragan, has been captured by the king with plans to strip it away, she sets out on a daring escape with Dragan. Through a series of adventures, Orla steadily grows stronger and seeks vengeance for herself.

(Source: POCKETCOMICS)
synonyms: 奴隷だった私は復讐に帰ってきた

title.native: 成为团宠后，我大杀四方
title.romaji: Chengwei Tuan Chong Hou, Wo Da Sha Sifang

194700.description:
The Lu family, a wealthy and powerful household, has become the laughingstock of town, after discovering their pampered and cherished daughter, they'd raised for over a decade, was an imposter! The new arrival, Huo Yao, swiftly packed her things to part ways with the real heiress - each returning to their rightful homes. However, when she saw the unlimited-amount black card her biological father handed her, not to mention those influential brothers, she remained silent. What happened to being impoverished and her brothers being the freeloaders they were described as? Even their neighbor who used to drive a junk car... The all-around Huo Yao chose not to speak.

(source: MangaToon)
synonyms: Bao Jin Wo De Xiao Majia
Giữ Kín Thân Phận Giả Của Tôi
Sau Khi Mãn Cấp Lão Đại Lật Xe
Ôm Chặt Áo Gile Nhỏ Của Tôi
お嬢様がしくじった後
カンスト令嬢が没落した後

title.native: セフレがいても彼女にしてくれますか?
title.romaji: Sefure ga Ite mo Kanojo ni Shite Kuremasu ka?

194702.description:
W Electronics, where everyone turns into zombies while working overtime! Trapped in the office, Park Hee-Woon decides to light a last spark with his rival colleague who is turning into a zombie in a situation where he can either starve to death or die. But when he turns around, his handsome colleague's zombie penis resembles a B.X.Big...?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

194703.description:
Ace soldier Jeong Ji-No is assigned a top-secret mission to save the world - only to find out it involves becoming a magical middle-aged man. Things go from bad to worse when the transformation makes his fellow soldiers suddenly claim he smells amazing and start chasing after him. Just as Ji-No is about to lose his mind, a - ahem - "helping hand" arrives in the form of Eliah, his longtime rival and the army’s other ace. Saving the world was never supposed to be this embarrassing…or this complicated.

(Source: Lezhin US)

194704.description:
Gong Jin became horny all of the time just because he took the wrong herbal medicine. His unrequited love and childhood friend, Cha Seung-Hyuk, caught him doing it?! Unlike Gong Jin, who is worried that their relationship with Cha Seung-Hyuk will become awkward, Cha Seung-Hyuk keeps provoking Gong Jin as if he got a fun toy...

"Hyung, I can't stand it anymore..."

"What can't you stand?"

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

synonyms: 1:2 Kousai wa Love Comedy ni Hairimasu ka?

title.native: １：２交際はラブコメに入りますか？
title.romaji: 1:2 Kousai wa Love Kome ni Hairimasu ka?

194709.description:
A short story depicting the past of Tamamo Cross and Trainer Komiyama.

Source: Official Account, translated.

title.native: ウマ娘 シンデレラグレイ 外伝 "遠雷"

194710.description:
How do you get over a guy you've been in love with forever? Yun Sehee decides the answer is asking him to date her, even if it's just for three months. The only problem? The guy is the cold, confident Kang Taewook, Sehee's boss! Unwilling to lose his top secretary, Taewook agrees to Sehee's unorthodox offer—with a plan to show her just how unlovable he is. Can Taewook make Sehee realize he isn't such a good catch? Or will he find himself falling for a girl who just wants to give him up for good?

(Source: Tapas)

194711.description:
In an age where love and marriage are 'calculated' and you don't want to lose, a fresh love comes to two men and women living in the smoke of modern society. Hyun Da-Young, a 35-year-old career woman who has followed the elite course but is anxious because marriage is not going as planned. Choi Woo-Jin, a 35-year-old single man who thinks his older sister's failed marriage is due to their age difference. Will they, who are past the ideal age for marriage and are impatient, be able to overcome the 10-year age difference under the pressure of reality and become pure in the face of provocative love?

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

194713.description:
Ga-Jun and Sun-Woo, students with supernatural abilities, are trapped in a time loop during their school trip. After witnessing their friends’ deaths, Ga-Jun realizes Sun-Woo’s death triggers the loop. He becomes fiercely protective, while Sun-Woo, confused, tries to protect Ga-Jun in return.

(Source: Manta)

194714.description:
Romance rekindles amidst urban crisis.

"Team Zero"" is a covert investigation unit unrecorded in any documents. During her pursuit of a monster terrorizing Seoul, Captain Yeo-Heun Jeong encounters her estranged first love, Ji-An Kang. Forced to work together, they uncover unsettling truths about the city's mysteries and their own pasts.

(Source: Manta)

194715.description:
The last surviving member of the Yurendal clan, Ufemia has the ability to connect with spirits. After running away from the family who has forsaken her, she is employed by the Duchy of Peredite as a caregiver and develops a special bond with Sirius, the duke's aide. But she learns of his true identity—Cassius Peredite, the heir to the dukedom that had an ill-fated relationship with her clan. With their relationship hanging by a thread, what fateful choice will Ufemia make?

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: โปรดอย่าตามหาฉัน

194716.description:
In the realm of martial arts, you’re either strong or dead. Ilyong Kim learned this the hard way after spending seven years training, only to die at the hands of a master. Resurrected in his home dimension, Ilyong’s experiences have granted him the power he’s sought all along. As an Awakened with no mana, Ilyong struggles getting a guild to accept him, but his fighting prowess quickly sets him apart from other new adventurers. But can he keep up with the monsters he must now face?

(Source: Tapas)

194717.description:
A society where humans and demi-humans coexist.

The protagonist, Yuika, a human, was childhood friends with Yukimi, a demi-human girl. A youthful school drama about a girl who grows up through interactions with various demi-humans.

(Source: Ultra Jump, translated)

194718.description:
I was a runaway orphan working three jobs to survive. I was always exhausted, but at least I had money. One day, I overheard some girls talking about Crown Princess Heine, a novel known for its risqué scenes. But before I could read it, I died! Soon, I transmigrated into the book as the villainess, Annette Ethelred. Annette is hated by everyone because she tried to kill Heine, but I'm not going down that route. I'm going to keep my head down, make money, and check out all the hot guys!

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: 悪女様が変わりました

194719.description:
When Duchess Delga Le Siegfried finds an abandoned boy named Asher, she takes him in so he can recover—but no good deed goes unpunished. As memories from her past life rush back to her, Delga realizes that Asher is destined to become a bloodthirsty killer. Between running the duchy and keeping her secret abilities in check, Delga has no patience for any of Asher’s mischievous schemes.

Can Delga find a way to stop him from going down the wrong path? Or will she be swallowed by his obsessive love?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: 私を殺すヤンデレ王子を力で調教します

title.english: I Tamed the Angsty Male Lead with My Fists

194725.description:
Originally released as a booklet bundled with the first limited edition release of Kimi wa Natsu no Naka. Contains two bonus stories:

1. Kimi to Natsu no Ato (君と夏のあと, After My Summer of You)
2. Kimi to Kimi (君と君, You and You)
synonyms: 君は夏のなか 小冊子
Kimi wa Natsu no Naka Shousasshi
Kimi wa Natsu no Naka Booklet
君は夏のなか 番外編
Kimi wa Natsu no Naka Bangaihen

194726.description:
Sea, an entertainment company employee who is always tired from overwork and social life, has fishing as her only hobby.

"I want to get stranded on a deserted island and spend the rest of my life fishing alone!"

She thinks as she picks up her fishing rod today... and words become seeds! She panics for a moment, but thinking that her companions will report her, she starts fishing on the deserted island with a complacent mind... The heavy taste of the catch makes her excited, thinking it's a big catch, but what Sea has caught is a person... no, a mermaid?! Suddenly, she ends up uncomfortably cohabitating with a mermaid on a deserted island, but this mermaid seems to have a deep story...?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

194727.description:
Is infinite regression a blessing– or a curse? For Eunhyeon, it is a fate that he desperately wishes to escape. Seven beings fall into the world of cultivators. Each has rare talents, but Eunhyeon appears to have none and struggles to survive in this strange world. Yet after his death, he finds himself back at the start of it all, realizing that his talent is the ability of infinite regression. Here begins Eunhyeon’s relentless struggle to break free.

(Source: WEBTOON)

194728.description:
One day, demons began to move into the human world due to overpopulation of their realm. Humans and demons chose the path of coexistence. It’s been years since then…

- Honeybee (ミツバチ)
Kashima, a distant relative of the incubus, works for a pharmaceutical company as a “honeybee” collecting human energy (semen). When he is unable to meet his quota and wanders around the entertainment district, he finds a former junior colleague, Marumura, and forcibly takes him to a hotel, but...?

- Mutou-kun no Oishii Akuma (無灯くんのおいしい 悪魔, Mutou-kun's Delicious Nightmare)
Student Council President x Dream-Eater.

- Narisokonai no Kemono-tachi (なりそこないのけものたち, Failure of Beasts)
Half-blood vampire x Goblin.

A compilation of 3 stories featuring demon BL...!!

(Source: Gentosha, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title.native: スイート・ナイトメア

194729.description:
To Oh Yeon-Ah, money means everything. Her top priority is money, and her only interest is managing that money. Her life seems to go perfectly well until she loses her entire asset to her boyfriend who turns out to be a conman. During the process, she crosses paths with the goblin, Ban-Suk, and, being completely broke, she signs a contract with the Goblin Queen to live in their house and receive wages in exchange for maintaining the secrecy and helping Ban-Suk complete his mission. The mission is to kiss ten humans that the Queen chooses and obtain ten human emotions to ultimately become human.

Will Oh Yeon-Ah be able to help Ban-Suk successfully accomplish his mission?

(Source: POCKETCOMICS)

title.native: とある事情があるのでキスしますね
title.romaji: Toaru Jijou ga Arunode Kiss Shimasune

194730.description:
All of his classmates, including his best friend and his crush, have been reduced to nothing more than brains. An alien who calls herself A-sensei informs the protagonist, Satoki Tsutsuno, that to protect the earth, they must use their collective brains.With Tsutsuno being the only one left in his class, what trials await him and his classmates...? A shocking and suspenseful story of collective brain warfare brought to you by JUMP’S most creative genius!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

194731.description:
I want to be hated by my love... if it means preventing this unfortunate future...!

One day, Luise, the 16-year-old daughter of the Marquess, regained memories from her past life. She discovered she had reincarnated as the villainess from a video game she once adored. Remembering she faced only two dismal futures. enduring each day miserably as an unloved queen or facing exile after a broken engagement, she was devastated by the tragic prospects ahead. Determined to take action herself, can she avoid this unfortunate future? Can she successfully make her lover hate her?

(Source: POCKETCOMICS)
synonyms: Kirawaretai no: Koushokuou no Kisaki wo Zenryoku de Kaihi Shimasu (2023)

title.english: Oh, Lustful King! Please Reject Me!
title.native: 嫌われたいの~好色王の妃を全力で回避します〜
title.romaji: Kirawaretai no: Koushokuou no Kisaki wo Zenryoku de Kaihi Shimasu

194732.description:
Lady Isla Allandis, a noble lady on the brink of her social debut, is desperate to escape a contractual marriage. She encounters a handsome nobleman, Martin, seemingly the answer to her prayers. Eager for their first kiss to be flawless, Isla seeks guidance from Jade, her trusted butler. As they embark on 'practice kiss,' Isla and Jade feel the tension rising between them. Little does Isla know, Jade harbors secrets of revenge and a past shrouded in shadows.

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Note: First released in English, with the initial eligible release in Japanese followed by Korean, making it a manga by our standards.
synonyms: Mon premier baiser avec mon cruel majordome

title.english: My First Kiss With the Evil Butler
title.native: 闇落ち執事にファーストキスを奪われました
title.romaji: Yamiochi Shitsuji ni First Kiss wo Ubawaremashita

194733.description:
Whenever Kohaku's emotions show, she turns into a fox. So even though she entered high school, she still has zero friends! In an attempt to become closer to her, the super popular Inui-senpai at school suddenly approaches her!? She shouldn't be excited! But she can't control her feelings!?

(Source: Flowercomi Like, translated)

title.native: お狐ちゃんには青春がたりない
title.romaji: Okitsune-chan ni wa Seishun ga Tarinai

194734.description:
Everyone knows the Cinderella story, but few know that her "happily ever after" only lasted 10 years. When the prince betrays her, a harvest mouse named Elodie is desperate to help her as her loyal friend. Elodie's wish brings about a miracle—she finds herself back in the past and discovers that she has the ability to shapeshift into a human. With this newfound power, she is ready to rewrite the ending of Cinderella's story. Will the two friends be able to find their own happily ever after?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: This Wild Mouse Has Taken Cinderella
The Harvest Mouse Exits the Fairytale Together with Cinderella
La Souris qui a volé Cendrillon

194735.description:
Haru is depressed after accidentally overhearing her friends true thoughts about her. One of teachers realizes this and comforts her. At first he seems like a kind and nice counselor but their relationship escalates quickly as the teacher reveals his hidden self. Haru decides to stick to this teacher but at the time she did not know just how deep the teachers darkness really was...

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

194736.description:
“Did I become a muse because I had a heart, or was I a heart from the beginning because I was a muse?”

Jeong Da-Eun, who had been obsessed with pure literature. A novel for adults that she came across by chance shakes up her daily life. She feels an unfamiliar thrill and stimulation for the first time. She decides not to just read, but to write it herself. However, the sentences she was familiar with kept slipping in front of the unfamiliar genre, and something was lacking. She returned to an old bookstore out of frustration. And there— Jeong Da-Eun meets someone. Emotions that must never be revealed, and an unbearable love for her muse. This should never have started.

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

194737.description:
In 1940, amidst an era of chaos, a beautiful mansion named Yeongchunhwa was built on a remote island, constructed solely out of a man's deep love for his wife. Time passed, and the story of the couple tied to the mansion faded from memory. Yet one day, a mysterious ‘caretaker’ appeared, transforming it into a lodging establishment. He began inviting people to the mansion—those who must love, guided by the couple's spirits...!

“Welcome to Yeongchunhwa, the secret mansion that will bring you infinite imagination. Here, any form of love is possible. Love and indulge freely. As long as the mansion permits.”

A luxurious mansion and the people who visit it for various reasons. Erotic stories for women, crafted by various authors, unfold now.

First Short Story Parachute Blouse: Influencers Choi Baek-Tan and Yang Su-Ji win a free stay at Yeongchunhwa Mansion while searching for a travel destination to celebrate their 7th anniversary. Arriving at the beautiful, opulent mansion, they explore and discover a mother-of-pearl cabinet in a second-floor room. Wearing the antique clothes found inside, they passionately make love. But after that day, Su-Ji notices Baek-Tan has become strange...?

“What is this unfamiliar feeling? It's like... he's someone else.”

What was the true identity of that other presence that had waited for Su-ji there for so long?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

194738.description:
Craft celestial-grade treasures from apocalyptic scraps, and roam the wastelands of the end times using immortal cultivation techniques. With a soul traversing two realms, truth and illusion blur… In the realm of the void, a frenzied path of cultivation begins!

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: I Dominate the Apocalypse by Cultivating Immortality

title.native: 称霸废土：我在末世执掌仙门
title.romaji: Chengba Fei Tu: Wo Zai Moshi Zhizhang Xian Men

194739.description:
Colette Milliact has been subjected to rigorous education for many years as the successor to the Earl's family. One day, her younger sister Liliane takes away both her fiance and her position as the successor to the Earl's family. Colette despairs when she learns that everything she has endured for her sickly sister was planned by her. She decides to give up her position and sever all ties with her family. Colette leaves the Earl's family with nothing but the clothes on her back, but she reaches her physical limit and collapses in the forest. However, a young man she has never met saves her. "Colette, please marry me." Who is the young man?

This is the story of a young lady who has had everything taken from her by her sister who pretends to be sickly, and how she finds happiness.

(Source: Ura Sunday, translated)

title.native: 病弱な妹に全てを搾取されてきた令嬢はもう何も奪わせない
title.romaji: Byoujaku na Imouto ni Subete wo Sakushu Sarete Kita Reijou wa Mou Nani mo Ubawasenai

194740.description:
An anniversary book to celebrate the release of Volume 10 of Fudanshi Shoukan: Isekai de Shinjuu ni Hameraremashita.
Packed with content, this must-have volume for Fudanshi Shoukan fans includes:
- A newly-written chapter by Fujisaki Moe,
- Special comics by a lineup of amazing artists,
- Reprints of past bonus content,
- And fun feature pages!

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title.native: 腐男子召喚〜異世界で神獣にハメられました〜 Anniversary book
title.romaji: Fudanshi Shoukan: Isekai de Shinjuu ni Hameraremashita - Anniversary book

194741.description:
"Will you marry me?"

Kaya's boss Ueki, who likes to joke around, suddenly proposes to her. She thought he was kidding, but it turns out that he's serious!? And before she knew it, she's going along with it? But the truth is that she's... a second virgin!?

Note: Chapter count includes two one-shots.
synonyms: そろそろモテたいお年頃

194744.description: Hero's first mission to preserve Prana, the origin of superpower! The story of the birth of a superhero.

synonyms: โอมจงอร่อยขึ้น! เพี้ยง!
おいしくなーれ！♡〜イケメンメイドに付きまとわれています〜

194746.description:
Give up the emperor's sister, the Princess Gyokuyou, in marriage. That is the condition for peace offered by the Northern Yan kingdom to the Eastern Hua empire. Tamayo is torn about leaving her homeland behind, until she meets the young man with jade-colored eyes who so forcefully courted her…

(Source: Chiffon Bunko, translated)

title.native: 龍王の寵愛　花嫁は草原に乱れ咲く
title.romaji: Ryuuou no Chouai: Hanayome wa Sougen ni Midare Saku

194747.description:
Princess Gyokuyo of the Touka Kingdom was nursing wounded prisoners of war from the enemy Hokuen kingdom, when she meets a young man with emerald-colored eyes who had come as an envoy of the Hokuen. The young man with the intense gaze forcefully tries to woo Gyokuyo...!?

(Source: Rimacomi Plus, translated)

title.native: 龍王の寵愛 花嫁は草原に乱れ咲く
title.romaji: Ryuuou no Chouai: Hanayome wa Sougen ni Midare Saku

194748.description:
Ran, the always-perfect student council president, makes a big mistake three days before the important school festival. Vice-president Nadeshiko covers for her mistake, but strangely, her heart leaps when she sees Ran so distraught. Later, Ran feels guilty that the responsibility has been shifted onto someone else, and when she talks to Nadeshiko about it, she is told, "I'll scold you."

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

Note: Originally published in Comic Yuri-Hime 2025 August issue.
synonyms: Punish You Properly, Bind You Gently

title.native: 正しく叱って、優しく縛って

194749.description:
Tatsumi falls in love at first sight with Fujimiya Mari, who works at a bookstore he happens to stop by, and the two become close enough to meet up privately. However, he lets his guard down and accidentally reveals in front of her that he's a virgin!! Tatsumi is devastated, but then Fujimiya invites him, saying, "If you're okay with me, do you want to hold me...!?"

(Source: Fanza, translated)

Note: Published in Comic Anthurium 2018-04

194750.description: The story of four sisters and their love lives. The eldest sister (35) is currently living separate from her husband, the second sister (31) used to be a high school teacher but now can't find a husband through marriage interviews, the third sister (27) used to be a volleyball player, and the youngest sister (22) used to be an idol but now has no occupation.

194751.description:
Cover Illustration: FLOWERCHILD
1. KISS TIME [FLOWERCHILD]
2. Aenai Yoru (会えない夜) [Hokuto Sui]
3. Zurui Hito (ズルい人) [Rube]
4. Konya, Nigeyou (今夜、逃げよう) [Dormicum]
5. Aru, Shitsuren Shita Yoru ni (ある、失恋した夜に) [Shishinigo]
6. Tabisaki One Night (旅先ワンナイト) [Cosmic]
7. Okurare Ookami (送られオオカミ) [Hinahara Emi]
8. Shinya 3-ji no Kabukichou (深夜3時の歌舞伎町) [Kawanami Izumi]

title.native: ワンナイト百合アンソロジー

194752.description: A net stalker type man finds out that lovely blue-collar type guy on his SNS lives in the neighborhood...! He tracks him down, and they end up having passionate sex...!? A reversible sex comic between a negative and positive man.

title.native: リバーシブルボロアパートセックス

194753.description:
Uma, a student attending art college, respects Kawaraki as a painter and a professor, but he secretly harbors feelings other than respect for him. Excited by his hips and hands, he draws Kawaraki and indulges in masturbation, and is tormented by guilt. One day, he is caught drawing Kawaraki by Kawaraki himself!? A campus love that is twisted and devoted!

(Source: Cosmic Shuppan, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: フランシス ベーコンの恋愛脳

194754.description:
Yuna, a cute high school girl, meets Emma, a gal with the same last name, at her part-time job. Despite their similar circumstances, the two feel like they aren't really friends... A strange but comfortable relationship is depicted in this story of modern sisterhood in the Reiwa era!

(Source: Comic Ogyaaa, translated)

title.native: ボーイズ・バッド・ロマンス! ハッピーウエディング

194756.description:
This is the beginning of the Human Farming Plan by zombies.

Humans are almost extinct, and zombie society is on the verge of a food crisis. Wataru, a zombie whose quirk is that he retained his human intelligence and emotions, cooked up a forbidden plan to achieve a breakthrough in the food crisis of his fellow zombies. His grand plan is: to look for surviving human males and females, get them to breed and begin farming humanity (food)!

However, the first surviving woman he encounters in his search is his ex-girlfriend, who he still has feelings for, even now!?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

194757.description:
Yuna Satou and Emma Satou work at the same part-time job, share the same last name, and come from similar family backgrounds, but other than that, they have nothing in common. Due to a strange turn of events, they end up living together. They fight sometimes, but it is precisely because they are opposites that they can stay together. A new generation's story about girls who live freely!

(Source: Homesha, translated)

194759.description:
Wan Xiang married to a civilian-born governor in troubled times because of a marriage contract after the decline and fall of Qing Dynasty. However, their marriage didn't bring any happiness but her husband's indifference to her. Until one day she met the person of destiny. When the true love comes, how will she choose?

(Source: WebComics)

194760.description:
Having transmigrated into a comic as the female lead, Cinderella, she immediately faces a hellish start.

She is not only emotionally manipulated into marrying the scumbag male lead, Haynes, but is also forced to surrender her own research achievements. Worse yet, she is reduced to a mere tool for the male lead and his "white moonlight"—his unforgettable true love—to flaunt their romance, only to be used and tragically killed.

The original heroine was a top scientist herself, so how could she have met such a miserable end?

Moreover, the "cannon fodder" second male lead, Lester, is the true gem. Devoted, gentle, and thoughtful, he protects the heroine, safeguards the nation, and is even willing to sacrifice his own life!

Now that Wang Xiaojun is here, she is determined to reverse her fate. She will save the second male lead with one hand and the Federation with the other!

It's time to write her own romantic legend!

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: The Reincarnated Heroine Has Fallen For Her Rival
我是女主，但炮灰实在太帅了签约

title.native: ヒロインに転生したが、当て馬を好きになってしまった
title.romaji: Heroine ni Tensei Shitaga, Ateuma wo Suki ni Natteshimatta

194761.description:
At the behest of his father, Qin Wenyu went to Japan, where he came into contact with a strange curse that caused him to enter a dream. Soon, he realized that he had been cursed as well, A Noh mask, Shinjya, had thus materialized, and he had also obtained Nine-Eyed Magatama. The curses were divided into five color categories: gray, white, black, blue, and red. Every cursed person would have his own Noh mask. Before the start of the next curse, the cursed would be contacted by the psychic hosting the feast and asked to participate. There was only one way to end the curse: collect all nine Nine-Eyed Magatamas…

(Source: Webnovel)

194762.description:
All players are suddenly trapped in the VR game world, and the formerly happy game becomes a death game. In order to save his sister, Li Dongyang resolutely logs in the criss-riddled game. Accidentally he gets the superpower that only he can use, and sets foot on the road to overcome the obstacles, seize treasures, save his sister, and challenge the gods...

(Source: WebComics)

194763.description:
Cho-Ah, who was running a peaceful and ordinary cafe, gets summoned by a demon just by signing a bank statement. Jin-Hyeok, the demon who was summoned in an absurd manner, demands that Cho-Ah make a contract to receive his soul in exchange for giving him his life through sexual intercourse...

"If it's sexual intercourse... how far...?"

"Shall we check?"

The passionate life exchange with the mischievous demon and the sudden visit of the demons change her ordinary daily life completely!

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)
synonyms: Summoning a Demon With a Sign

194764.description:
Lee Hu-Young, a special rookie of the professional basketball team 'HG Big Whales'. He was living a difficult life day by day to pay off his father's loan debt. When everything was burdensome and burdensome, a man appeared.

"Are you trying to seduce me now?"

"What you just did was seducing me, and I'm just trying to see."

The short break he spent with the man was sweet, but in the harsh reality, Lee Hu-Young chose to disappear instead of continuing his relationship with the man. And he didn't know that he would meet him again a year later. And that too as the owner of HG Big Whales and a player. He thought he would be caught without anyone knowing, but the owner Eun Jun-Wook's reaction was unexpected.

"If you need anything, tell me. I'll help you in any way I can. I'll be a bonus to you, not a flaw."

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

194765.description:
Custom-made bookcase for the young superstar?! And enter freely around his private home?! But how can he be so different from his look on the screen, gentle and warm? Arrogant, bad-mannered and even cannot reading! The only reason she was hired was she could read the script!

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: 君の声で聞かせて～本好き女子とワガママ俳優

194766.description:
Characters are beginning to disappear. Cognitive abilities in people are starting to decline. An underachiever named Wan Yi travels to a different dimension where he embarks on an adventurous journey. Shape-shifting monsters, divided clans, awakened ancient creatures... In a realm full of danger, can he shoulder the burden of saving the world?

(Source: WebComics)

194767.description:
In Kyoto at the end of the Edo period, Shion is a lonely young girl who is a tengu. She is chasing her brother who killed his entire clan, and is attacked by a samurai who has turned into a monster. She is saved by Heisuke Toudou, who was the captain of the Mibu Roshigumi, later the Shinsengumi's 8th unit. In order to stop her brother's ambitions and get revenge, Shion begins living in the human world with Heisuke and his friends.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

194768.description:
This is a yuri manga about a female boss and female subordinate who are constantly flirting with each other while living together. It is a sequel to the story of the two characters who appeared in " I Love You So Much, I Hate You".

(Source: Number Nine, translated)
synonyms: We Are in Love So Much We Laugh

title.native: 笑っちゃうほど恋してる

194769.description:
A girl who falls in love way too easily is working hard to take over her grandparents' café. To stay focused on her dream, she swore off love completely. But one day, a new part-timer shows up at the café—he looks like a total delinquent, and things start to get complicated…

(Source: Manga Park, translated)

Note: Originally published in The Hana to Yume King 2024 12/1 issue.

194770.description: <I>Note: Originally published in the Betsufure NEXT supplemental in the 2020 July issue.

194771.description:
My first love has the scent of cigarettes.

Shinoda Akizumi is 18 years old, 171 cm tall, in her third-year of high school.
She is done with all her club activities and she is struggling with her future plans.

Amidst her confusion, she falls head over heels for a man.

The smell of cigarettes, piercings in his ears.
This man, smaller than herself, is a mysterious, unsuccessful novelist.

A story of first love, woven between a girl wondering about her future and a novelist caught up in his past.

(Source: Ichijin Plus)

194772.description:
Minato Yoshii longs for a normal life, but she has a secret: she's actually the daughter of a yakuza family. Desperate to find a new job, she goes to an interview; however, she gets turned around and accidentally barges straight into the office of the Akaiwa Gang, her family's biggest rival. The gang members there burn some strange incense and get ready to pounce on her, but she's saved at the last minute by none other than Renya, the underboss of the gang himself. And even though they've only just met, he hits on her and asks her to be his woman...!
Minato, never having been in a relationship before, has no idea how to deal with Renya's advances... And not only that... she's starting to feel extremely strange inside due to the incense from earlier, which was an aphrodisiac. Renya is forced to save Minato from the aching desire she's experiencing, and she suddenly finds herself in uncontrollable pleasure she's never known before!

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: I Don't Want To Be A Gangster's Wife -A Month Of Being Doted On By The Young Mob Leader-
title.native: 極妻はお断り～ヤクザの若頭に溺愛される１ヶ月～
title.romaji: Gokutsuma wa Okotowari: Yakuza no Wakagashira ni Dekiaisareru 1-kagetsu

194773.description:
Growing up in a family full of chefs, Mo Ting has brilliant culinary talent but later is diagnosed with a career-ending hand problem. At the lowest point of his life, a girl shows up out of nowhere and drags him into a magical realm full of drool-worthy foods!

(Source: WebComics)

194774.description:
A trip to Yanjing made Luo Shiyi the step-wife of her brother-in-law. Everyone thought it was a marriage of convenience, but she ended up being the love of his life. So what if she was born of a concubine? This story tells you how she became the mistress of a powerful family.

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: A Concubine's Daughter and Her Tactics
The Grand Schemes of a Concubine's Daughter
大家族はいつも反乱だらけ？

194775.description:
A youth from Northwest China Zhang Mo lived his life suffering from the effects of a curse until his fateful encounter with a mysterious girl Bai Zhizhi that knocked his life upside-down.
She took him hostage and brought him into the mountains where they summoned Mu Cha, an unknown stranger who had been asleep inside the rockface of a cave.

Only after that did he finally experience a world that varied greatly from the modern society he knew. All he needed to do was to learn how to be a priest just like Bai Zhizhi and Mu Cha and he could defeat his sickness. But...

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Guanyu Wo De Shen Gun Shifu

194776.description:
The 38th generation of Lu's exorcist teaches in a high school with a very negative atmosphere. The real purpose is because there are too many ghosts in the high school, and his goal is to become the strongest Lu's exorcist.

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: คุณครูอันธพาล

194777.description:
The runaway teenager was kidnapped by a mysterious man late at night. When he woke up, he was facing the challenge of life and death in an unfamiliar laboratory...

(Source: WebComics)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

194778.description:
Minato has been living with Renya, a yakuza gang leader, confined (?) in his house. Feeling guilty about their debauched daily lifestyle, Minato declares a “celibacy order” to Renya! She thought Renya, who has been insatiable, wouldn't be able to wait quietly, but her day of reckoning comes all too soon. Moreover, she finds a love hotel membership card that fell out of Renya's pocket…

(Source: DLSite, translated)

title.native: 同棲ヤクザの彼に禁欲させたらラブホで死ぬほど犯されました
title.romaji: Dousei Yakuza no Kare ni Kinyoku Sasetara Loveho de Shinu Hodo Okasaremashita

194779.description:
High school student Tohru is in love with his classmate, the perfect beauty Kureha. One night, Tohru is attacked by a mysterious monster and it is Kureha who saves him! She is one of the fairy warriors who protect the world, and she ends up living with Tohru to protect him... Days of love and battle with the strongest and cutest heroines begin!

(Source: Comic Zenon, translated)

title.native: 妖精戦士アミュレージュのサポーターになりまして
title.romaji: Yousei Senshi Amuleuje no Supporter ni Narimashite

194780.description:
"Do you know who I am?"

Hyana is a survivor from a country that was conquered by the Empire. Now she travels alone through various lands, working as a blacksmith, finding joy from the praise she receives for her skills… Until one day, when a mysterious man confronts her, claiming to know her secret. The secret being that she possess the Rune of Fire, the power of her homeland that was destroyed eight years ago by the Empire that sought it. Is this man who knows Hyana's secret an enemy... Or is it not that simple...?

(Source: Lovebites, translated)

title.native: 恋する秘文の戦士たち

194781.description:
Yuriel thought she was trapped in a dating sim, but she soon realizes it's actually a happiness sim. To escape, she must heal the world's wounded characters and bring them happiness — without them falling in love with her! Can she do it? Or will more than one NPC fall head over heels?

(Source: Manta)

194782.description:
Koharu Mizukawa is a second-year junior high girl. She is smart and beautiful, seen as the idol of her school, and she has someone she admires very much. That person is… Anna Tsukishima, a beautiful girl who once killed a man in this town.

She is like a “goddess” to Koharu.

Believing in Anna's words, Koharu lives a pure life, striving to keep away from evil thoughts and live up to the ideal of her "goddess." But… her stepfather actions are tarnishing her pristine world with darkness, slowly driving her mad―.

Where will the girl's prayers lead her—to light, or to destruction...?

(Source: Goraku Web, translated)

194783.description:
Captain Bianca: The appearance of the new hero everyone has been waiting for!!

In a quiet seaside town, Leon, a young man doing odd jobs at an inn, meets an unexpected guest. Bianca, who gives off a scary vibe and is thought to be a pirate, is actually a kind person who finds and protects rare marine life. As she meets a pickpocket penguin, a strawberry turtle, and a con artist sea otter, Leon gradually falls for Bianca's charm. Meanwhile, Bianca senses that something is wrong with the town where rare marine life appears in abundance, and her arch enemy(?) Digor of the Silver Group appears in front of her. Leon's feelings only get more complicated as he sees Digor, who doesn't hide his feelings for Bianca...

This is different from the fantasies you've seen so far! The charm of Captain Bianca is something you can't escape once you see it!!

(Source: Naver Series, translated)

194784.description:
Promotional manga for the video game Sonic Superstars.

Note: Originally published in Corocoro Magazine 2024 Jan. issue.

title.native: ソニック スーパースターズ

194785.description:
In this empire, the position of saint sees a high turnover... Because the saints just won't stop sleeping with the knights! So when the new saint Alisa finds out her personal guard is the very man who had her predecessors excommunicated, she's determined to keep her distance. But one day, the two find themselves trapped in a mysterious room forcing them to act out a rather risqué scenario in order to get out. How will the righteous holy knight deal with this decidedly sinful situation?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Note: Part of Metatoon's Sunae Danpyeonseon (순애 단편선) Collection.
synonyms: [True Love Anthology] Please Read, Mr. Seong-Gi

194787.description: Prologue promotional comic for the video game Sonic Superstars.

194788.description:
Arts major Il Yoo is trying to force his way into music major Lee-Won On's proximity, but little does he know that he was inadvertently the cause of Lee-Won's heartbreak three years prior. One thing leads to another and the two begin to draw inspiration from each other for their respective graduation projects.

(Source: Manta)

Note: Includes seven extra chapters.

194789.description: The son of Allah has come from heaven.... A child with tremendous supernatural abilities to manipulate his elastic body, telepathy, teleportation, and even control time itself. The vortex of laughter caused by those who are bewitched by his powers will captivate you.

194790.description:
It turns out the world around us is actually an imaginary world created by the Mother Goddess Nuwa using an artifact called Scroll of the Realm. That means outside the bounds of our universe lies a magical world.

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: The God of the Land and Grain's Mountain River Map

194791.description:
Tempted by the high salary, Lucy, a maid, goes to work at a remote mansion. Her new employer is Skar, a hot-headed half-dragon said to hate humans. Despite his initial skepticism of her, Lucy starts to grow on Skar. But with his fiery outbursts, can Lucy successfully cool the flames of his temper?

(Source: Manta)
synonyms: เจ้านายของฉันไม่กัดคนค่ะ!

194792.description:
Sun-Woo Yoon thought he knew who his enemies were, but when he woke up in Yi-Hyun Choi’s home after a night out, it didn’t take him long to learn he was wrong. While he’s angry that Sun-Woo doesn’t even remember him, that’s not enough to change the situation. Yi-Hyun will have his revenge and make Sun-Woo pay for ruining his life. Now that he’s being held captive, the only way out is through. As he starts to remember what they went through as kids, will his reasons for keeping Yi-Hyun happy change?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

194793.description:
Crazy school life continues, survive Kang Haram!

(Source: Naver, translated)

194794.description: Takes place a few years after the ending of Yumeguri Yurimeguri and focus on Hiyori and her sister.

194795.description:
Seohyun is a Korean detective who was closing in on a serial killer when they both plunged off a building together. But then, she wakes up inside a novel as Himena Sylvester, a villainess doomed to a tragic end. Determined to change her fate, she sets out to repair Himena’s reputation, earning unexpected admiration along the way. But just as her new life begins to turn around, she uncovers something she missed—the serial killer fell into the novel with her, so a crime spree is about to begin!

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: Shh! I'm Not a Villainess, I'm a Detective!

194796.description:
Monaka Yukimura is a new employee at a long-established kimono store. When he arrives at work full of enthusiasm, he comes across a man and a woman making out! And the man is the company president's son! Monaka panics and worries that she's come to a dangerous workplace, but...

The heir of a long-established kimono store who is careless with women falls in love for the first time in his life with an unconventional new employee!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: みだらな御曹司に愛でられちゃう
title.romaji: Midarana Onzoushi ni Mede Rare Chau

194797.description:
Nanaka Yanagi is 18 years old. She has decided to leave university and move to her dream city, Tokyo. She is worried about her boyfriend, Riichi, who will remain in his hometown of Aichi. "Love is everything. So I'm sure I can overcome a long-distance relationship," she believes as she leaves Aichi, where she has lived for 18 years, for Tokyo, choosing a unique share house where the condition for moving in is "you must be in a long-distance relationship." In Tokyo, Nanaka learns about various types of love. Meanwhile, it seems that there are many obstacles to overcome to maintain her own long-distance relationship, such as money and time.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 巻き込まれて召喚された限界OL、ギルド所属の【魔物解体嬢】として奮闘中 THE COMIC
title.romaji: Makikomarete Shoukan sarete Genkai OL, Guild Shozoku no [Mamono Kaitaijou] Toshite Funtouchuu THE COMIC

194799.description:
Relieur is a bookbinding culture that flourished in France. Each book is bound carefully and meticulously, one by one. Hiraimoto is a silent bookbinding craftsman, and Mitsuba Taki, a younger boy who has a crush on her, helps run the shop. They are actually distant relatives, and today a book with a story is brought to them...

(Source: Comic Days, translated)

194800.description:
Sachi had the misfortune of her first job as a working adult being the type that sucked the life out of her for the last two years. Rushing to catch the last train home as usual one day, she instead gets caught up in a sudden bright light! The next thing she knows, people are celebrating the summoning of a saintess and lavishing all their praise on the high school girl next to her. Meanwhile, Sachi is tossed aside as useless when they determine her ability is something weird called Monster Mincer. But just as Sachi thinks she's out of luck, the submaster of an Adventurer's Guild appears and recruits her to mince monsters for ingredients. Will Sachi be able to handle her colorful new job and thrive in this fantasy world?!

(Source: Cross Infinite World)

title.english: From Corporate Drone to Mincemaster! One Order of Dragon Coming Right Up!
title.native: 巻き込まれて召喚された限界OL、ギルド所属の【魔物解体嬢】として奮闘中〜ドラゴンですか？もちろん捌けます！〜
title.romaji: Makikomarete Shoukan sarete Genkai OL, Guild Shozoku no [Mamono Kaitaijou] Toshite Funtouchuu: Dragon desu ka? Mochiron Sabakemasu!

194801.description:
Our protagonist, Sachiko Sasajima, is still a virgin, even though she will be turning 30 next week. Since she turned 27, she has been afraid of being found out as a virgin at this age, and has been stuck in a negative loop that has prevented her from finding love. She tried her best to get out of this negative loop while she was still in her 20's, but all she meets are shitty men. They say that if you are still a virgin by the time you're 30, you will become a wizard, but will that really happen?!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)
synonyms: I Have Nothing to Do with the Magic!!

title.native: 魔法をかけた覚えはない!!
title.romaji: Mahou wo Kaketa Oboe wa Nai!!

194802.description:
Humanity had found peace on the Moon—until a massive creature they called “it” appeared. As terror spread, a mysterious hero called Moon Cider rose to fight and save humanity. The world cheered… unaware of the secret he carries.

(Source: Niuhi)

194803.description:
Middle school student Houko lives in an apartment by the river with her three supernatural fathers—Jiroubou the Great Tengu, Sanpei the Kappa, and Kenichi the Grim Reaper. They're not human, and their personalities are all quite eccentric. But Houko enjoys her days with her fathers, who are full of love for their only daughter...?! Laughter, tears, and a whole lot of supernatural creatures await you! This quirky family comedy begins with full energy!

(Source: Kobunsha, translated)

title.native: 歴史裁判～その死罪、覆すなら賀倍まで～
title.romaji: Rekishi Saiban: Sono Shizai, Kutsugaesu nara Gabai made

title.native: 八つ裂きループ令嬢は累計人生百年目に、初めての恋をした。
title.romaji: Yatsuzaki Loop Reijou wa Ruikei Jinsei Hyaku-nenme ni, Hajimete no Koi wo Shita.

194806.description:
Tsukiko Nonomiya (25) works at a toy design company and is an extremely late sleeper. She loves to sleep. Meanwhile, her boyfriend Yoichi Momijidani (27) works at a publishing company and has a hard time sleeping. The two of them enjoy late-night snacks made by Yoichi and the time they spend together before going to bed.

(Source: Kiss, translated)

title.native: 野々宮月子はいつも眠い
八つ裂きループ令嬢は累計人生百年目に、初めての恋をした。
title.romaji: Yatsuzaki Loop Reijou wa Ruikei Jinsei Hyaku-nenme ni, Hajimete no Koi wo Shita.

194808.description:
During his last month as a student in March, Soeda falls in love with Sayaka, who is also taking the same new employee training course. Soeda has a long-time girlfriend whom he lives lives, but his feelings for her are already dwindling...

(Source: Kiss, translated)

title.native: 溶けないし混ざらない

194809.description: Note: Originally posted on Twitter, then later officially licensed and published by Beam Comics.

title.native: 塩坊主に惚れたキツネ

194810.description:
Wakaba suddenly ends up sharing a room with the daughter of her mother's Korean friend. If you grew up in a different country, the food you eat every day is different!? Japanese and Korean "deliciousness" comes together in the same kitchen!

(Source: Kiss, translated)

title.native: ビングルビングルバッサン

194811.description:
A story of a bright and straightforward high schooler and his pure, devoted childhood friend. Keita and Tomoya are childhood friends living in adjacent apartments. They always thought they'd remain friends forever, but one day Tomoya suddenly announces that he’s moving and reveals his long-held feelings.

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

194812.description:
Nico is a manga artist in Tokyo. Her family consists of her mother and grandmother, who live in Miyagi. Their home was washed away during the earthquake, but at her grandmother's request, her mother worked hard to rebuild the house in the same place. When Nico returns to her family home for the first time in a long time, she witnesses her grandmother's strange behavior... Since she was a child, her grandmother has always looked after and doted on Nico, in place of her mother who worked outside the home.

But why is her reliable grandmother acting like this...? Her beloved grandmother is becoming like a stranger... Nico doesn't know about dementia yet, but...

(Source: Comic Days, translated)

title.native: わたしのお婆ちゃん　認知症の祖母との暮らし
title.romaji: Watashi no Obaa-chan Ninshishou no Sobo to no Kurashi

194813.description:
Tachibana, a humble office lady living in Kawaguchi City, Saitama Prefecture, enjoys searching for restaurants every night while fantasizing, "If I were to go to dinner with this person, it would be here...!" This is the birth of the first gourmet manga in history (?) where the protagonist doesn't actually eat or go to restaurants.

(Source: Kiss, translated)

title.native: 立花さんの妄想サーチごはん

194814.description:
A youthful omnibus about color, depicted through correspondence between a middle school student in the midst of puberty and a student teacher!

(Source: Comic Days, translated)

194815.description:
Akiyoshi, Kenji's childhood friend who runs a greengrocer, is a handsome lawyer and the perfect man. But he's also mean, and every girl Kenji falls in love with ends up being taken by Akiyoshi! Then one day, Kenji finds out that Akiyoshi has had an unrequited crush on him for over 10 years. Kenji is excited and tries to comfort Akiyoshi, but...!?

(Source: Taiyoh Tosho, translated)

title.native: いじわるなハニートラップ

194816.description:
Kayano is a socially awkward otaku boy who spends his time in the corner of the classroom. However, when he gets close to Mayu, a girl who is supposed to be in a different class than him, the world he imagined begins to change...

(Source: Kiss, translated)

title.native: わたしたちは旅をする

194818.description: A high school girl from modern day runs a sweets shop to help revive a hot spring in another world!

title.native: 異世界温泉の和菓子屋JK

194819.description:
Ookubo-kun, a serious lawyer, has fallen in love with his boss, lawyer Hanamura-sensei. He chases after him even as he goes independent. However, he's given a "test", an SM play, and on top of that, Hanamura-sensei declares to him that he's a masochist. He can't get his beloved Hanamura-sensei to accept him unless he tortures him.

(Source: Taiyoh Tosho, translated)

1. Hanamura-san to Ookubo-kun (花村さんと大久保くん): Prologue
2-3. Nakimushi na Sadistic (泣き虫なサディスティック): Originally serialized as "Hanamura-san to Ookubo-kun".
4-7. Unmei no Hito (運命の人)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: 花村さんと大久保くん

title.native: 泣き虫なサディスティック

synonyms: Popular manga artist and Rookie voice

title.native: 売れっ子漫画家とひよっ子ボイス

194821.description:
The primordial Qi on the Blue Planet was revived, and the monsters were back in the world! Divine Beast Zhulong, Fierce Beast Fengxi, Evil Beast Qiongqi, North Sea Monster Kraken, Midgard Serpent Jormungand, Mighty Beast Behemoth... The only ones who could contend with these monsters were the awakened! But Lin Xiu failed to awaken any abilities and became a laughing stock. However, with the mysterious pendant left by his father, he accidentally gained the ability to harness monsters. King of Monsters Kuilong, Monster Tyrant Jintian, Demon Bug Queen Jiaochong, Star-breaking Giant Ape Aohen...

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: I Am the Great Master of Mystical Beasts

194822.description:
In this world that everyone pays attention to face, will anything go well as long as you're good-looking? Ai Xiaoyu is a girl who looks fashionable but shy inside, what will happen when she meet a two-faced novelist? An hilarious and sweet love story began...

(Source: WebComics)

194823.description:
For a new reality show, twenty famous actresses are transmigrated back to an ancient kingdom's imperial harem! In this era full of intrigue and betrayal, see how the disgraced "fairy star" will use her smarts and skills to overcome the crowd and take the crown!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

194825.description:
Wen Ming is accidentally transmigrated into a world of high martial arts, where he finds himself engaged to the ruling Empress, Wu Xin. His grand plan? To live the easy life as her kept man and coast through life on her dime. Unfortunately, he manages to annoy the Empress, and his dream of a lazy life goes up in smoke.

Unsure if he truly has feelings for her, Empress Wu Xin comes up with a plan: she sends her beautiful best friend, Tao Sisi, to seduce Wen Ming. It's the perfect way to test his loyalty while seeing if she gets jealous.

Wen Ming's reaction?
"You're going to use this to test a public official? What kind of official would fail such a test?"

(Source: Bilibili Comics, translated)

194827.description: Yuuki finds out that his neighbor(s?) is a plant person

194828.description:
1. Classic na Safari (クラシックなサファリ)
2. Giyaman Heart Break (ぎやまんハート・ブレーク)
3. Bara no Ki ni Bara no Hanasaku (薔薇の木に薔薇の花咲く)

title.native: クラシックなサファリ

194830.description:
A boy who lived in a different world from hers but had the same scars, and so could never hate her. Twenty-nine-year-old Hee-Rim reunited with Park Gun, who had become a gangster.

“You might not care about scars, but you actually care a lot.”

“The person I liked really hated having scars on my face.”

Although they were still in a different world, they shared a lost time, and that’s why they entered Hee-Rim’s sturdy castle once again.

“I thought… there might still be a chance.”

The time between the two, which had been at a standstill for 10 years, began to move again.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

194831.description:
After being kidnapped, Class A Omega Yeon-Weo is rescued by Kang-Woon Joo, a Class A Alpha and CEO of Cheonsang Group. However, she's also attracted the interest of another Class A Alpha, Shin-Woo Lee. Now caught between the two Alphas of the Cheonsang Group, what fate awaits Yeon-Seo?

(Source: Manta)

194833.description:
When Seul-Yeong brought a puppy home, she never expected it to be an android — a sex android that looks exactly like her terrifying boss, Manager Seo! Now she's stuck hiding her look-alike manager at home while acting normal at work. But when her boss suddenly leans in for a kiss... chaos and temptation spiral out of control.

(Source: Manta)

194834.description:
"You are the child of the moon. You must go to the moon palace with me."

Bora, a high school girl with the ability to see ghosts. One day, the moon rabbit suddenly appears and makes a bombshell announcement. Because of her useless ability, she has never been able to properly date, and she is going to the moon? No! You can't go! I will escape from Mosul!! Will Bora be able to start dating safely?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: เงยหน้ามองดวงจันทร์ด้วยเถิด โบรา

194836.description:
Born into the prominent Lee family, Yeon has always enjoyed a privileged and comfortable life. However, his achievements and competence pale in comparison to his older adopted brother, Kangwoo. This disparity fuels Yeon's constant, barbed mockery toward him. While Kangwoo usually endures the insults in silence, Yeon finally pushes him too far with a particularly offensive remark. When Kangwoo unexpectedly extends an invitation to his bedroom, Yeon's sheer arrogance compels him to accept. What Yeon doesn't realize is that his big brother is about to deliver a very intense and unforgettable lesson.

(Source: Tappytoon)

title.english: The Cocky Brother Learns a Lesson

synonyms: Voluptuous, Buxom Transfer Student Kumokawa Suzuran

title.native: ムチムチ巨乳転校生 雲川鈴蘭

194838.description:
In-Ha was always compared to Ye-Jun. Just as she was growing weary of the endless comparisons, she happened to receive an art award that brought her some attention, and so In-Ha began to pursue the path of art. Eight years later, she reunites with Ye-Jun... only to find that he, too, is now doing art. Believing it's inevitable that she'll once again be compared to him, In-Ha starts making plans to distance herself from Ye-Jun. A coming-of-age romance about In-Ha, who harbors a dislike for Ye-Jun.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.

title.native: 女王陛下の特命令嬢リリス・バレンタイン～「ハートの女王」と呼ばれる高慢令嬢が婚約破棄しようと王子をたぶらかすヒロインをスカウトしたら、よりによってとびっきりのバカが来た～
title.romaji: Joouheika no Tokumei Reijou Lilith Valentine: "Heart no Joou" to Yobareru Kouman Reijou ga Konyaku Haki Shiyou to Ouji wo Taburakasu Heroine wo Scout Shitara, Yori ni Yotte Tobikkiri no Baka ga Kita

194840.description:
Mitsu is able to see the physical manifestation of the connections people have with others. Together with Itsuki, she makes a living out of cutting the hopeless but inseparable relationships people share.

(Source: Square Enix, translated)
synonyms: It's the Rotten Bonds That Are Harder to Break

194841.description:
Saved from a lonely life as a poor orphan, Lune was taken in by House Renard. Yet try as she might to repay them, she was always treated coldly and kept at a distance, especially by her older brother Liam. When faced with financial ruin, the Renards sold her off as a bride to the crown prince, only for a revolutionary army to seize control of the kingdom and condemn her family to death.

At the moment of her execution, Lune makes one final wish for a chance to save them all. The Great Fox Spirit Reineke hears her prayer, sending her back in time and granting her fox ears that let her hear the voices of spirits. If she wants to change the future, Lune must win over her adoptive family—including Liam, who suddenly seems to be...doting on her?! With her spirit friends and Liam's affections, Lune sets out on a journey to avert her family's unjust fate and find happiness at long last!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title.english: Fluffy-Eared Realm Restoration: Taking It Slow With My Cool Big Brother
title.native: 転生もふもふ令嬢のまったり領地改革記 ―クールなお義兄様とあまあまスローライフを楽しんでいます―
title.romaji: Tensei Mofumofu Reijou no Mattari Ryouchi Kaikaku-ki: Cool na Ogikei-sama to Amama Slow Life wo Tanoshin de Imasu

194843.description:
Si-Woo has a first love from the past that comes to mind whenever the rainy season comes.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Note: Part of the 2024 Post Type GL Summer Anthology ([GL] 2024 포스타입 앤솔로지 | 여름).
synonyms: 2024 포스타입 앤솔로지 | 여름 - Blessing in disguise

194844.description:
Mitsuba is a tanuki girl who lives in human society. She can only transform into a human for three hours, so she is unable to work and lives a poor life. One day, her fate begins to change when she meets a kind young human named Tsuyu.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

194845.description:
The only way to break the rainy season jinx! If two unlucky people get entangled and mixed, wouldn't it seem like special luck would come?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Note: Part of the 2024 Post Type GL Summer Anthology ([GL] 2024 포스타입 앤솔로지 | 여름).

194846.description:
A virgin ghost always looks at me in front of my house every rainy day. As the rainy season came and I encountered her more and more often, I decided to personally satisfy her desire as a “virgin” and help her attain Buddhahood...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Note: Part of the 2024 Post Type GL Summer Anthology ([GL] 2024 포스타입 앤솔로지 | 여름).

194847.description:
Queen bee Lucy, who can't avoid Murphy's Law on rainy days, and her roommate Dana, a nerd who loves rainy days. How will the strange relationship between the queen bee and the nerd, who had no relationship at all, change during the long rainy season in Forks?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Note: Part of the 2024 Post Type GL Summer Anthology ([GL] 2024 포스타입 앤솔로지 | 여름).
synonyms: A Secret to a Rainy Day
2024 포스타입 앤솔로지 | 여름 - 비 오는 날의 비밀 사이

194848.description:
There are no bad people who like high heels.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Note: Part of the 2024 Post Type GL Summer Anthology ([GL] 2024 포스타입 앤솔로지 | 여름).

194849.description:
It's the worst, most chaotic rainy season ever, and I need some comfort right now!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Note: Part of the 2024 Post Type GL Summer Anthology ([GL] 2024 포스타입 앤솔로지 | 여름).
synonyms: 2024 포스타입 앤솔로지 | 여름 - 장마에서 살아남는 방법
How to Survive the Rainy Season

194850.description:
The low-class next door sister, she comes into our house on a rainy day and says...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Note: Part of the 2024 Post Type GL Summer Anthology ([GL] 2024 포스타입 앤솔로지 | 여름).
synonyms: 2024 포스타입 앤솔로지 | 여름 - 잔뜩 젖은 옆집 언니가 만져달라는데요?
The Next-Door Neighbor Wants Me To Touch Her Because She's So Wet?

194851.description:
Upon traveling into a novel world full of plot mishmashes, Xu Beiwang couldn't help but comment, ""Why is everyone else in the spotlight after space travel, playing the hero, or at least a king of some sort, while I'm stuck being an attendant for the villainess?"" But he soon realizes that it feels pretty good to lord it over others, especially when the blame gets pinned on the villainess. And so, Xu Beiwang is going further down the path of using power to oppress others...

"I BECAME THE ATTENDANT OF THE VILLAINESS"

(Source: Webnovel)

title.english: I Became The Attendant Of The Villainess

194852.description: Note: Published in the July 2025 edition of Monthly Gangan Joker.

title.native: トゥルーバッドエンド

194853.description:
I got cheated on and also hit by a car, but God did not abandon me! Now that I'm the CEO of a big company, I want revenge!

(Source: Webnovel)

194854.description:
Quinna, a genius girl, had her talent taken by her family, but was given another chance because of the system she awakened. Give away her precious talent to get 100,000 times the return?

The eldest daughter of the Campbell family is reborn as a great gold talent! She didn't expect to get a talent that would let her stand next to the Divine Son of the Empire!

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: After Giving Up My Talent, I Became Beloved in the Magic World
After Giving up My Talent, I Became the Magic Realm's Darling
After Relinquishing My Talent, I Became a Favorite of the Wizarding World

title.native: 让出天赋后，我成了魔法界团宠

By a twist of fate, Su Li, a cunning young girl, was bought by the cold, proud Duke as a cure to his lust for human blood. Set in the most terrifying estate in the capital, witness a hilarious performance of love and hate.

Detective Winnie Kiu entered a virtual game while in pursuit of a murderer. She put her life on the line and relied on Code Guest's help to save seven princes trapped in the game. Solving cases in the real world and adventuring in the game world, romance is everywhere in this intense and exciting game. The seven princes await their master's arrival!

(Source: WebComics)
