194859.description:
Meguri Hakaba is a high school girl who dreams of becoming an ojou-sama, but is not good at asserting herself and accepts gravure work without being influenced by the flow. She has difficulty making friends at school and is looked down upon by her classmates. One day, she meets Minawa, a tall boy with blonde curls. Minawa, who at first glance seems eccentric, declares that he will "create an 'ojou-sama club' at this school" soon after transferring to the school, but he quickly fits in with the class because he clearly expresses his opinions and remains confident even when teased by others. Meguri is envious of him, but one day she finds out that he was a "ojou-sama" that she was close to when she was young... She takes on the challenge of establishing a "ojou-sama club" that no one has ever seen before.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

Hi, my name is Ling Yu. My occupation? Your most ordinary delivery man next door. Well, the only difference is that I provide delivery services for anything. Yes, you hear me right, absolutely ANYTHING, as long as you pay me fairly.

(Source: WebComics)

The supreme leader of the Martial Arts Alliance, Yeop Ji-Chu. He was killed. However, the incident was dismissed as a minor disturbance. However, there were those who remembered it differently… It eventually became the spark of a great disturbance, burning like a wildfire.

The history of martial arts named this era the era of minor disturbances and great disturbances, and it was the most turbulent time in martial arts, and it was reinterpreted as a higher level of martial arts… It is said to be the era of heroes.

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

It is the Meiji era. A girl with neither beauty nor education nor luck, is sold to Yoshiwara. The reality is that she is sold to a place where she can make a living by selling her body. What future will she try to carve for herself in this overwhelmingly unfavorable situation? A new story set in Yoshiwara begins, depicting what is most important in life!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

An incredible martial arts has appeared in the world of martial arts. An incredibly strong guy has also appeared in the world of martial arts. An incredibly large martial arts world has also unfolded. An incredible martial arts world and… an incredibly powerful martial arts… a showdown between incredibly strong guys! Now, it will unfold in an incredible way.

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

194870.description:
18th century France. The then king, Louis XV, was known for being handsome and had many mistresses. Among them, if one was chosen as the official mistress, they could gain power second only to the queen. Jeanne-Antoinette Poisson, a commoner, dreamed of becoming Louis' mistress, and approached him when he came to the forest to hunt. Jeanne caught the king's eye, but she ended up angering the mistress, the duchess of Chateauroux.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

Hikari visits the “Kan-gumi” to ask them to wait for the repayment of the debt. There, Hikari has a fateful encounter with Jin Kan, a young leader of the Kan clan. The collateral is pure love. The world I see, the image I imagine from your voice, the taste of memories, the way I like to smell you, I want to touch you. This omnibus series depicts the wavering hearts of young girls, each story revolving around the five senses.

(Source: Kiss, translated)

Moments before victory, dark mage Kai Austin is betrayed and loses everything. His death becomes a reset, sending him five years into the past—to the day of the class assignment ceremony—with all of his magic intact. Armed with max-level dark magic and every memory of the future, Kai refuses to let history repeat itself. This time, he will protect Colette, stop the coming disasters before they begin, and destroy those who once betrayed him.

With his return, he decided to try to get married like his friends, albeit belatedly... But there’s simply no one suitable!

During his time away from the capital, Emperor Kiel had revised the laws and regulations, leaving him in an even trickier position. Can Asha manage to find a partner and succeed in getting married?

Jeongseo and Songju have been each other's solace since childhood—best friends and first loves bound by an unspoken promise. After losing her mother, Jeongseo’s life takes a darker turn when her father remarries. She is forced to live under the same roof as her cold stepmother Mira and jealous stepsister Yuri, who resent and abuse her at every turn.

While Songju, the son of a powerful conglomerate chairman, cherishes Jeongseo with genuine love, Yuri becomes obsessed with him, determined to tear them apart no matter the cost.

As their bond deepens, so does the malice surrounding them. In a world where jealousy festers and cruelty is masked by elegance, Jeongseo and Songju’s innocent love stands fragile—threatened by the very people meant to be family.

Their story begins with warmth, but fate seems poised to lead them into tragedy.

(Source: Lezhin US)

A secret relationship with a mysterious entity... In a world with demonic monsters called Shenguai, a young orphan named Kou lives alone in the mountains with a mysterious Shenguai named Chiyou. In-Suh, Yeon-Ho, and Da-El, were always together during their school days. In-Suh, who injured his hand in an accident, gives up his dream of becoming a pianist and goes into hiding, but Yeon-Ho suddenly appears in front of In-suh. In-Suh suddenly hears the news of Da-El, whom he liked, is getting married. And...

I get to know Yeon-Ho's hidden feelings...

194900.description:
Welcome to the starry forest! In a strange building surrounded by trees, the magician master Lemorin, the dragon Shelatis, and Enid, a little witch who dreams of marrying a wealthy man, live. Her wish is to grow up, become beautiful, and fall in love with a prince. Enid asks her magician master Lemorin for her wish again today, but he doesn't listen. Today, various customers come to see the three of them, and strange things happen.

To investigate a kidnapping case, Xue Zhao, a profiler, went deep into a village of a foreign race, but was haunted by the villager's worship of [Him]. The pale face of Ji Li was looming, and his cold and wet long hair followed him like a shadow. Is the grace He bestowed a gentle killing intent or a bloody love word? The sacrifice He demanded was Xue Zhao's arrogant mind or his cold heart? Is the ghost you... or me?

Kawasemi is a young man who studies painting with the aim of entering an art university. However, his talent is not recognized and he spends his days as a ronin. One day, while disposing of a painting that Kawasemi had drawn, he meets Mel, who is a freelance art dealer. And the next moment, Mel suggests to him... "Do you want to paint a fake?" The latest work from "Crowman" Chuu Yakou. 156 years after six nuclear bombs fell on Earth. In a post-apocalyptic world surrounded by machines, two siblings search for the remains of humanity. As the final hour approaches, will they find a sliver of hope? A new era of SF begins, where the last heat sparkles in a corner of a world that has ended!

(Source: Yanmaga, translated)

In the year 3215, all domestic fighting has ended and a peaceful winter has come to the world. Veteran Kirjaska Leino meets former child soldier Mjeli Haltonen, who has only ever known the battlefield. Kirjaska ends up taking care of Mjeli, who has nowhere to go, in exchange for being provided with a place to stay, and they begin living together in a small house in the forest... The two, who have lost their way, live a peaceful life together in the snowy country.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

194912.description:
24-year-old web novel writer Yeong Won isn’t interested in love, but she can’t help admiring her roommate’s handsome boyfriend, Mu-Il Shin. But Mu-Il suddenly dies, and Yeong receives a mysterious package containing a robot vacuum. The vacuum introduces itself as an AI copy of Mu-Il, and claims that he was murdered. Now, Yeong must navigate life with a digital version of the one man she couldn’t resist, as she’s pulled into a mystery far stranger and more personal than any of her novels.

For Olivia Madeleine, illegitimate daughter of a duke, her only hope of a better life away from her cold-hearted family is her betrothal to arrogant crown prince Leoford Franz. When the revelation of his tryst with another debutante comes as an unsurprising wake-up call, she has no choice but to barter for her freedom with Edwin Lowell Vikander, the ruthless, war-hardened Grand Duke of the north. As her dangerous dance with Edwin begins, Olivia seeks to leave her former fiancé with the coldest gift that vengeance can impart… A heart made bitter with regret.

(Source: WEBTOON)

194914.description:
Ariana, born into a politically arranged marriage, was nothing more than a tool, used and abused by her family her entire life. On her 28th birthday, she was tragically killed, yearning for a love that never came. Perhaps out of pity, a mysterious force sent her back to when she was 16. Reflecting on her painful past, she makes a vow:

(Source: WEBTOON)

One day, Ludia Mertens wakes up inside a romance fantasy novel as the best friend of Elian, the crown prince’s obsessive stalker. To avoid getting caught in Elian’s madness and dying like in the original story, she tries to keep them apart. But to her shock, she somehow ends up seducing the prince instead. (Source: Irodori Comics)

194933.description:
Lin Lei wakes up as Grace Gottlieb, her favorite character from a tragic novel. The bad news? Grace is destined to be murdered by her husband, a bloodthirsty tyrant. The worse news? Grace is currently only five years old. Trapped in a child's body, her plan to escape her gruesome fate by divorcing him is dead on arrival.

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: The Bloodthirsty Tyrant Turned Out to Be My Ex-Husband

title.romaji: Shixie Baojun Jing Shi Wo Qianfu

194934.description:
Thrust into another dimension—a world of nothing but monsters and combat—he discovers a unique cheat: he can "borrow" the rewards of a battle before it's even won.

He can claim equipment, experience points, gold, and even a perfect Mirror Image of his foe in advance. The catch? He must defeat the original enemy to keep his spoils permanently.

His ultimate goal: to collect and cultivate a legion of these Mirrors, turning each one into a Grandmaster of its class. He can then "log in" to any of his creations, becoming a one-man army capable of fighting as a hundred.

In this world, sheep move in flocks. Tigers hunt alone!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

194935.description:
In the era of the "new Divine Land," the old sects stand on the brink of annihilation, crushed under the heel of the cyber-enhanced New Sects. Ling Chen, a disciple of the fading Fortune Sect, witnesses his brethren and father humiliated and slaughtered in the New Sects' ruthless purge. Swearing vengeance, he clings to life... until the latent power of his sect's forbidden skills, the "veiled skills," awakens within him.

At death's door, Ling Chen becomes the perfect vessel for the primordial True God of Time. Reborn with the wrath of the ancients and the might of a god, he returns to the continent drenched in blood.

His path is clear: Carve a new epoch from the corpses of the New Sects.

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: Reborn in a Cyber Cultivation World, I Fight My Way to the Top

title.native: 重生在赛博修真世界的我杀上顶端
title.romaji: Chongsheng Zai Saibo Xiuzhen Shijie De Wo Sha Shang Dingduan

194936.description:
The protagonist of this story is an ordinary third-year junior high school student, Shuri. Her friend Yuka confides in Shuri that she might be pregnant. As Shuri gets closer to Yuka, she learns to take care of herself and love people.

What kind of relationship should I have with my boyfriend? Why do I need contraception? What would happen if I got pregnant now? I want to ask someone, but I can't seem to find the courage... A love story woven by the hearts and bodies of junior high school students.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.
synonyms: Junior High School Students' Love and Sex

194937.description:
He reached the pinnacle of cultivation in a century, only to be trapped in a lightning tribulation for 100,000 years. He escaped stripped of his power, but left with an indestructible body. It was no accident; it was a plot from a being in the Upper Realm. Now, as a mortal with an invincible form, Fang Lingxiao begins a new journey: to hunt down the one who wronged him and exact his revenge.

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: One Hundred Thousand Years of Tribulation by Heavenly Thunder
Ten Thousand Years Under Heavenly Tribulation

194938.description:
As a modern-day wage slave, Cuihua Wang thought the worst thing in life was overtime. Then she wakes up inside a web novel as Wanyin Yu, the infamous consort destined for a tragic end. Panic is a luxury she can’t afford, but as she braces for the tyrant’s famous temper, she notices something off. He isn't acting like a monster. He looks as out of place as she feels. Turns out, he’s hiding the same secret she is. To survive this nest of vipers, they form a fragile alliance. It should have stayed practical, but amid ruthless court politics, trust grows, and feelings soon follow. Then the truth surfaces: She wasn't sent here by accident. She came for one reason only—to save the tyrant.

(Source: WebComics)

title.english: I Woke Up in the Wrong Story

194939.description:
Steady and caring Yuzuki and clumsy and spoiled Miumi are unrelated sisters. They've always gotten along like best friends, but one day Yuzuki meets someone she's interested in. Yuzuki is steadily getting closer to him and is filled with happiness. But Miumi can't help but worry...

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

194940.description:
After losing her beloved mother, Juri is left all alone. Then, a man who calls himself her "fiancé" appears in front of her! And it's Kiryuu-kun, the popular boy at Juri's school! This is what her mother said in her last words... is it true!?

I'll never get engaged to Kiryuu-kun, who always says mean things to me! Juri thinks, but as she gradually learns more about Kiryuu-kun's true feelings things start to change...

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

194941.description:
The human Race is at war with the Vicious Dalki and when they needed help more than ever, THEY started to come forward. Humans who had hidden in the shadows for hundreds of years, people with abilities. Some chose to share their knowledge to the rest of the world in hopes of winning the war, while others kept their abilities to themselves. Quinn had lost everything to the war, his home, his family and the only thing he had inherited was a crummy old book that he couldn’t even open. But when the book had finally opened, Quinn was granted a system and his whole life was turned around. He completed quest after quest and became more powerful, until one day the system gave him a quest he wasn’t sure he could complete.

"It is time to feed!"

"You must drink huma n blood within 24 hours"

"Your HP will continue to decrease until the task has been completed"

(Source: Webnovel)

194943.description:
Office romance may be off-limits, but no one said you couldn't help your co-worker get off. Surely no one will develop feelings if you're just using each other's bodies on each other to masturbate, right?

(Source: Irodori Comics)

Note: Released at Comiket 103, 105

194944.description:
Transcending to a mysterious world, Jiang Cheng gained 100 million lives at the beginning. As long as he's killed, he could resurrect and gain the random abilities to defeat the opponent. From then on, all he hoped for was to be killed. "Brother, come and kill me!" "Kill me!" Opponent boss: Jiang Cheng, you little jerk, since you're courting death eagerly, I'll satisfy you!
[Ding, host, you resurrect...]

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: Beginning With 100 Million Lives as the Rewards

title.english: Starting With A Reward Of 100 Million Lives
title.romaji: Kaiju Jiangli Yi Yi Tiao Ming

title.native: 新卒保育士ちゃん、社会を知る。
組織で最強と名高い、無口な女戦士ちゃん。
title.romaji: Soshiki de Saikyou to Nadakai, Mukuchi na Onna Senshi-chan.

194948.description:
Kiri likes his classmate Fuji. He really likes him. He likes him so much that he can't stand it anymore. Whether he knows about his feelings or not, they're always together, flirting with each other every day, so Kiri can't confess his feelings... Just when he's struggling to let out his sad feelings by masturbating, Fuji comes over to play and sees him right in the act... > < You can probably guess what happens next, right? A mutually in love high school couple, a slightly complicated love between boys on a team, and forbidden love between brothers... A collection of short stories that capture the innocent love affairs of high school boys.

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

1-2. Caramel (カラメル)
3. Sunflower (ひまわり)
4-5. Miki Arata (ミキアラタ)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: I'm Being Teased by My Classmate Boyfriend

title.native: 同級生彼氏にジらされてます。
仇敵 ーアダガタキー
自由気ままに異世界ハーレム
東城雪代37歳 真夏のビーチで青姦ハメ撮りセックス 甥の言う事には逆らえない私
title.romaji: Toujou Yukiyo 37-sai Manatsu no Beach de Aokan Hamedori Sex Oi no Iu Koto ni wa Sakaraenai Watashi

194952.description:
Notes:
- Originally serialized under the title "Otoko Junky (侠Junky)."
- Includes one extra chapter.

194954.description:
A mission to find a husband suddenly falls upon Viera, a poor young lady with no money, no time, and no connections who spends her days working in the Technology Division of the Magic Bureau!

She happens to be nearby and meets a knight named Lukash for the first time. In a drunken rage, she proposes to him that he become her husband by contract, saying that she will be willing to divorce him in a year, and to her surprise, he accepts.

But later, she finds out Lukash's true identity--!

It was supposed to be a verbal promise between two drunken people that could be divorced, but what does it mean when he says, "...I have no intention of letting you go"!?

A marriage and love fantasy woven by a talented young lady and the country's strongest divine beast knight♡

(Source: Cmoa, translated)

title.native: 酔っ払い令嬢が英雄と知らず求婚した結果 〜最強の神獣騎士から溺愛がはじまりました!?〜
title.romaji: Yopparai Reijou ga Eiyuu to Shirazu Kyuukon Shita kekka: Saikyou no Kamikemono Kishi kara dekiai ga Hajimarimashita!?

title.native: ねぇ先生、こっち向いて
その秘密をキスで塞いで
title.romaji: Sono Himitsu wo Kiss de Fusaide

194957.description:
Yamada is on cloud nine dating Akkun. She pours her heart into making him homemade lunches every day, but her world comes crashing down when she spots him walking with another girl…

(Source: Manga Plus)

title.native: 山田さんはちゃんとしたい

194958.description:
Claude Buttermaker, a third-generation Japanese American, moves to Matsue in order to rebuild his ancestors' sake brewery.

(Source: Wikipedia, translated)

194959.description:
When Ren Fei arrives in a different dimension and conveniently obtains Mighty Brick, the most powerful artifact in the realm, it earns him the label of "the largest villain on the continent." He cultivates on the run and eventually finds himself tangled in a huge conspiracy, which seems to have something to do with his past life.

(Source: WebComics)

194960.description:
Minato works as a counselor for a matchmaking company. For some reason, he often gets stalked by his female clients. He switches to taking on male clients, believing he is making a fresh start, but his relief is short-lived... His first client, Akihi, is a handsome and high-profile man who unfortunately suffers from sweaty hands, which has given him an inferiority complex and made him into a closet pervert. When Minato shows Akihi some kindness, Akihi falls in love with him!! He begins to pursue Minato, regardless of their genders. Right in the middle of the consultation, he pushes Minato down, drops his pants, and declares, "I want to lose my virginity to you!"

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: I'm An XL. Could You Find Me A Spouse?
title.native: XLサイズですが、結婚させてくれますか？
title.romaji: XL Size desu ga, Kekkon Sasete Kuremasu ka?

194961.description:
Roger, a retired mage so powerful he eventually gained the title “Sage,” is surprised when his beloved apprentice Lilliant suddenly returns. She became a court mage in a neighboring empire, only to be worn down by harsh working conditions, toxic relationships, and an abrupt dismissal she doesn’t even understand. To comfort her, Roger suggests a relaxing journey of healing along the roads they once walked together. It should have been nothing more than a quiet trip down memory lane, but with two extraordinary talents on the move, they start creating legends wherever they go.

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: He Is a Retired Old Sage, but His Beloved Disciple Has Been Expelled, So He Takes Her on a Heartbreak Trip ~He Intended to Travel in a Slow Life Fashion, but for Some Reason He Ended Up Becoming the World's Strongest Master and Disciple.~
A Retired Old Sage Takes His Disciple on a Journey
은퇴한 현자 아저씨와 애제자의 힐링 여행

title.english: Back on the Road with My Apprentice
title.native: 引退したおっさん賢者だが愛弟子が追放されてきたので傷心旅行に連れて行く ～スローライフな旅のつもりが、なぜか世界最強の師弟になっていた〜
title.romaji: Intaishita Ossan Kenja Daga Manadeshi ga Tsuihou sarete Kita no de Shoushin Ryokou ni Tsureteiku: Slow Life na Tabi no Tsumori ga, Nazeka Sekai Saikyou no Shitei ni Natte ita

194963.description:
Ye Chen, a lowly outer circle disciple of the Ye clan, had never accomplished anything in his life. But one day, fate bestowed upon him twelve ancient symbols. Each symbol, once activated, provided him with a mysterious power and an ancient martial art skill. From then on, the former good-for-nothing began his journey to become number one in the world.

(Source: WebComics)

194964.description:
Ye Liusha had a blind date with a man, but surprisingly, the man was the young uncle of her ex-boyfriend, and he insisted on marrying her. What should she do?
He said, "If you marry me, you'll be the Duchess, and your ex-boyfriend will have to call you aunt."
"Aunt?! Okay!" she said excitedly.
So, Ye Liusha married Murong Mobai. However, what she didn't expect was that, although her husband always looked aloof and serious, he was actually lively, tricky, and jealous inside! His brain was filled with all kinds of ways to "trick" her into doing it with him.
What could she do now? Run away with her baby of course!

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: My Cute Wife Is Not Easy to Bully

title.english: The Duke's Cute and Tough Sweetheart

194965.description:
At the age of 12, Soalis, the daughter of a nouveau riche viscount, married Alendio, the son of a poor count, in an arranged marriage. He was apparently unhappy with the marriage and immediately enlisted in the military, leaving Soalis behind. Ten years later, Soalis' family has fallen into ruin, and Alendio has become a national hero, so she decides to divorce him. However, when Alendio returns, he dotes on Soalis as if she were a completely different person!? What is going on when he should hate her!? A love comedy about the misunderstandings between a wife who wants to divorce and a husband who wants to dote on her!

(Source: Zero-Sum Online, translated)

title.native: 嫌われ妻は、英雄将軍と離婚したい! いきなり帰ってきて溺愛なんて信じません。
title.romaji: Kiraware Tsuma wa, Eiyuu Shougun to Rikon Shitai!: Ikinari Kaette Kite Dekiai Nante Shinjimasen.

194966.description:
Heavy are the shoulders that bear the burden of a household. To keep his waning clan afloat, leader Mujin Baek has no choice but to leave his homeland and venture out into the martial arts realm. When he passes the entrance exam of the Northern Sky Union with flying colors—leaving behind one unconscious opponent in the process—Mujin soon finds that the realm is not the noble place he once envisioned. With his powerful frost-style qi, however, he sets out to make a chilling mark amidst the fiery maelstrom engulfing the realm.

(Source: WEBTOON)

194967.description:
Tensions are brewing in late 19th century Ireland, shortly before the Irish War of Independence. Author Raymond Ler Lyndon lives isolated in his romantic clifftop mansion, scorned by his fellow countrymen as a traitor while he waits for his long departed beloved to return. But when Owen, his first love's son, saves him from certain death, he is given a second chance at reclaiming the lover who abandoned him. Meanwhile, the rebellion is gaining traction and Owen's behavior grows increasingly suspicious. At the conflict's climax, which will they choose — love or freedom?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Part of CNC Revolution's Cheot XX Danpyeonseon (첫XX단편선) Collection.
synonyms: [Difficult First XX Anthology] On the Lake Where the Waves Reach

title.english: My First XXX: At the Lake Where Waves Crash

194968.description:
Joo-Hong is a popular BL fan artist, but doesn't expect to see her fitness instructor, Neung-Geum, in full cosplay at her fan convention booth. Now that she's seen his glorious muscles in action, she has to recruit him as a model for her next spicy project. Despite the fact that both of them are inexperienced, their modeling session at a hotel leads to a surprisingly heated acquaintances-with-benefits relationship. Their hobbies and bodies are certainly well-matched, but will their nerdy yet passionate hookups lead to something more?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Part of CNC Revolution's Cheot XX Danpyeonseon (첫XX단편선) Collection.n.

194969.description:
Geon-Woo is a bodyguard who works on the security team for the idol group Magnum. He doesn’t really have any complaints about his job, except for one person who keeps getting on his nerves: Do-Yoon. Throughout his career in the industry, Geon-Woo has never met a more irritating idol who seems ungrateful to his fans. Do-Yoon is simply a brat with a pretty face, in Geon-Woo’s opinion, which is why he never intended to get mixed up with Do-Yoon in any personal way… So how did they end up in bed together?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Part of CNC Revolution's Cheot XX Danpyeonseon (첫XX단편선) Collection.

title.english: My First XXX: Fan In Denial

title.native: MSGKちゃんは恋にむちゅー

194971.description:
Becoming an adult brings many new experiences, but having his first wet dream was not on Joo Seong-Min’s bucket list. What’s worse is that he dreams of getting down and dirty with a devilish version of his best friend, Seo Gyu-Ri. He could just brush it off as a random wild fantasy, but why does this dream feel a bit too close to reality...?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Part of CNC Revolution's Cheot XX Danpyeonseon (첫XX단편선) Collection.
synonyms: [Difficult First XX Anthology] Childhood Friend Summoned as a Succubus

title.english: My First XXX: My Friend Turned into a Succubus!

194972.description:
Princess Elena is devastated when her hand in marriage is rewarded to war hero Marquess Lupus Bernardo against her will. Her dreams of marrying the kind Count Favio are dashed, and she has no choice but to wed the rumored brute who demanded her as a trophy. Trapped in a seemingly loveless marriage, both her heart and body ache for true love and warm affection. But as it turns out, Lupus may be hiding some heat beneath his cold exterior...!

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note:
- Includes three extra chapters.
- Part of CNC Revolution's Cheot XX Danpyeonseon (첫XX단편선) Collection.
synonyms: [Cheot XX Danpyeonseon] Deulgae Hujageun Gongjureul XX-handa
[Difficult First XX Anthology] The Wild Dog Marquis XX the Princess

title.english: My First XXX: The Marquess is Wild for His Princess

194973.description:
Luzette Madal, the only daughter of an earl, has had her sixth engagement called off. The reason for this is that her name is similar to that of the popular young lady "Luzette Dadal"!? Unmarried women are generally not allowed to show their faces and marriage proposals are usually made by letter, so Luzette is constantly being called off by suitors who mistakenly believe the wrong person. All she can do is suggest that the engagement be called off so as not to hurt the suitor's pride and public image when he realizes his mistake. Luzette, who is already used to having engagements broken off, receives a proposal from Lawless Vizant, a famous elite duke. Luzette wants to quickly make Lawless realize that it's another case of mistaken identity and call off the engagement, but Lawless, who is serious about "Luzette", passionately pursues her...

(Source: Cmoa, translated)

title.english: The Wrong Count's Daughter: I was mistakenly proposed to, so I shall call it off for you
title.native: じゃない方の伯爵令嬢 人違いで求婚されたので破談にして差し上げます
title.romaji: Janai Kata no Hakushaku Reijou: Hitochigai de Kyuukonsareta no de Hadan ni shite Sashiagemasu

194974.description:
Framed by her own sister, Serena found herself in a one-night stand with a total stranger...and she got pregnant! After a terrifying, near-fatal delivery, she watched helplessly as they took her baby away. Years later, she returns home, a gorgeous little girl holding her hand. Suddenly, a handsome man grabs her arm and snarls, "How could you steal my child?" The little girl shoves him away, sticking out her bottom lip. "You can't touch my Mommy! Not unless you agree to be my Daddy!"

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: Chief's Cute Baby: Buy One Get One Free
President’s Adorable Babies: A BOGO Surprise

title.romaji: Shouxi Meng Bao Mai Yi Song Yi

194975.description:
I’m Zhu Yuzhi. Five minutes ago, I transmigrated into a novel. The good news? I’m the daughter of a prince. Barring disasters, life should’ve been a breeze. The bad news? Disaster struck. I’m about to die tonight. The worse news? My mother and brothers are the story’s ultimate villains. But as Zhu Yuzhi roasts her way through this mess, she discovers something shocking—the villainous family is defying fate?!

(Source: Bilibili Comics, translated)
synonyms: After the Novel Villains Heard My Inner Voice

title.english: When the Villains Heard My Inner Voice
title.native: 全书反派听见我心声后
title.romaji: Quanshu Fanpai Tingjian Wo Xinsheng Hou

194976.description:
Liao Tingyan, the newest and lowest-ranking disciple, unexpectedly managed to subdue the terrifyingly powerful demon of Gengchen Immortal Palace, sparking widespread debate among everyone.

Some asked her, "Sister Liao, how did you manage to do that?"
Liao Tingyan: "...By relying on the instincts of a slacker?"

(Source: Bilibili Comics, translated)
synonyms: Offering Salted Fish to the Master

194977.description:
Onigiku, a company employee, had decided not to hold anything precious after losing everything due to a heart disease. But then, a high school girl, Rinko, suddenly confesses her love to him...

(Source: Comic Pixiv, translated)
synonyms: In times of love and times of disease

title.native: 恋するときも、病めるときも
title.romaji: Koisuru Toki mo, Yameru Toki mo

194978.description:
It started in anatomy class. The corpse on the dissection table... it was my ex-girlfriend.
Ever since that day, I've been pulled into a world of incomprehensible horrors.

A decommissioned bus that only lets passengers on, never off, on a one-way trip to the bottom of the reservoir.
An ancient, thriving tree in the hospital courtyard that devours people, leaving not even the bones behind.
A giant carp by the river, begging for help night after agonizing night.
And a deadly brothel draped in human skin, a place that never, ever closes its doors.
A ceaseless, vicious cycle... a nightmare that seemingly has no end...

(Source: Bilibili Comics, translated)
synonyms: My First Case: The Corpse of My Ex-Girlfriend
The Corpse Collector: I Start by Dissecting My Ex-Girlfriend

title.native: 让你当收尸人，你开局解剖了前女友
title.romaji: Rang Ni Dang Shou Shi Ren, Ni Kaiju Jiepou Liao Qian Nüyou

synonyms: ゆいちゃん😈とりあんちゃん👼

194980.description:
Woody was exiled to the desert because he was given the production skill "Tree Planting". However, in the harsh desert, his ability awakens - the skill "Tree Planting" is a cheat-level all-purpose skill that can plant the legendary "World Tree", create trees that bear the finest fruits, and create trees with the attributes of the four elements!

Furthermore, divine beasts also appear, looking for the World Tree...!? Woody helps the indigenous people of the desert as the new lord, and in order to create a comfortable and safe place for himself and his people, he makes full use of his cheat powers to solve food and housing problems one after another!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: スキル『植樹』を使って追放先でのんびり開拓はじめます
title.romaji: Skill "Shokuju" wo Tsukatte Tsuihou Saki de Nonbiri Kaitaku Hajimemasu

194981.description:
"Only if you vow to keep this secret and continue serving me your blood as "food" for eternity..." Ruri, a weak and overworked office worker, finds solace in Gilbert, her favorite character from the otome game "Vampire Mansion." One morning, after pushing herself too hard, her co-workers find her collapsed at the office, and her body is already cold... However, when she awakens, she finds herself in the game world, and even meets Gilbert...! She has been reborn as Fiona, the fiancée who is destined to be killed by him! Fiona's struggle to avoid this fate and to be close to her beloved character begins. Over time, her feelings shift to wanting to save this man who has never been rewarded. Thus begins the story of the cursed vampire duke and the reborn side character.

(Source: Coolmic)
synonyms: In My Second Life, I'm His Favorite Food?!

title.english: In My Second Life I Became Food For My Bias?!
title.native: 2度目の人生は推しの食糧です！？
title.romaji: 2 Dome no Jinsei wa Oshi no Shokuryo desu!?

194982.description: Hanako Kikuchi, who was about to get married, was enviable for her beauty and career, and was at the peak of happiness. However, even though she hadn't made any particular changes to her lifestyle, she began to gain weight, and people around her started making fun of her for it Hanako's only allies are her best friend from college, Natsumi, and her grandmother, who raised her after her parents died in an accident. However, these women also turn into people who push Hanako to the depths of misery... This mystery depicts the horror of a woman who was revered as a "winner" and then gets caught up in a spiral of misfortune as she grows bigger!!

194983.description: In a world where people are given several skills as a blessing from God when they turn 10, the eldest son of the Desemann family, Alec, was only able to acquire one unpopular skill, earth magic - even though everyone in the family is amazing!! But this is only the beginning of his journey to become the greatest earth magician that ever lived!

title.native: アレクサンダー英雄戦記～最強の土魔術士～
title.romaji: Alexander Eiyuu Senki: Saikyou no Tsuchi Majutsushi

194984.description:
Bernie Rose, an aspiring writer who worked as a waiter, met the perfect rich man Ian Bentley and has been living together for n years. Bernie wants to live happily with Ian, but Ian, who wants a child, is dissatisfied with Bernie's immature behavior, and Bernie, who is unemployed, thinks that Ian will acknowledge him only if he succeeds at work, and their relationship gradually grows apart. Meanwhile, Bernie's ex-girlfriend Lisa is a reliable best friend who listens to Bernie's worries and gives him advice, but she is not very good at solving her own love problems. Bernie gets a college classmate who understands him, and Lisa gets a decent man who seems to have a secret...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

194987.description: Set several years after the ending of Yumeguri Yurimeguri and focus on Hiori and Tsubaki, now university students.

194988.description:
22XX. A world where only the chosen ones are allowed to live in a city with umbrellas. Ahn, a resident outside the city, runs a cafe with his sickly son and lives a difficult life in extreme weather. Then one day, he finds out that his ID and health insurance, which he had prepared to cure his son's illness and start a new life, have been canceled. In order to restore the cancellation, he contacts a terrorist organization and heads to the Third City. After successfully completing his sniping mission to assassinate the target, Ahn meets Senator Enraque Giltare, a representative figure of the city for a certain minority and a government spokesman. The two, who seem to have no connection, had a brief encounter eight years ago, and the memory of that still lingers in Ahn's mind. However, the black hand of a terrorist organization reaches out to Ahn, who is trying to prepare a new future for his young son...

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

194989.description:
Employee-of-the-Month champion and service-industry all-rounder Lim Seongshik thought he’d seen everything, until he wakes up inside a bleak BL novel as none other than Elliot Brown, a minor villain doomed to die. In the original story, everyone meets their end at the hands of the protagonist, Arzen Theron. So Elliot decides to keep his past life as a writer hidden, lie low, and quietly avoid the one event that triggers the tragedy: ghost-writing a love letter.

But life—and his cat—have other plans. A desperate situation forces him into becoming Arzen’s personal bed attendant, of all things. To make matters worse, his “secret identity” as a writer gets exposed to the novel’s original love interest. Before he knows it, Elliot is back to ghost-writing letters… this time for Arzen himself! But something’s off. The Arzen in front of him doesn’t match the cruel lead he remembers...

Can Elliot keep faking those letters just enough to dodge his scripted death ending? Or has the story already started to change?

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: Should I Write You a Love Letter Instead?

title.english: Shall I Write Your Love Letter?

194990.description:
The talented and hardworking Bitt Geum learns her fiancé cheated—just a month before their wedding! Desperate and furious, she proposes to rookie developer Haneul to spite her ex, only to find out he’s the brother of her company's CEO. Just how will this chaotic office relationship turn out?

(Source: Manta)

194991.description:
Seo-In's family fled to America after learning that their lives were threatened by someone close by. Seven years later, Seo-In and his family are once again threatened in Korea. Seo-In decides to take everything from them and gather strength for revenge. In order to take revenge, she visits 'Jaden Taylor' of Taylor Corporation. He is a man who is the epitome of arrogance. Seo-In's will is actually burning as she sees Jaden acting selfishly as if he doesn't know Seo-In's desperation. Was that why? The more Seo-in struggles to get what he wants from Jaden Taylor, the more the presence of Jaden Taylor in Seo-In's heart begins to grow...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

194992.description:
A-Yoon Kang hadn’t planned to stay at StreamTech for this long, and now they’re being bought out. With only three months to go until she can cash out, she decides to stay and help the incoming CEO. But now that she knows her new boss is none other than Soo-Hyeok Cha—the man she left waiting at the altar four years ago—she’s having second thoughts. Was four years enough time for him to move on? Can she keep the reason why a secret that much longer? Or will their past prove too much to leave behind?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

194993.description:
Taak-Ri, an abandoned village that no one visits because of ghosts...

The Mystery X-Files production team takes interest and visits the place. However, what awaits them are ghosts that died in the incident at the time, and Nam Do-Cheol, who has become a living evil spirit through an evil spell called Yeommae. The reporting team that saw them tries to leave the village in a hurry, but Nam Do-Cheol has no intention of letting the reporting team go kindly. The reporting team tries to run away, and Nam Do-Cheol and Cheong-Song try to catch them!! And the truth from 50 years ago is revealed!

(Source: Naver, translated)

194994.description:
A girl whose wish is to see the ocean. A boy who is afraid of the outdoors goes on a school trip that was canceled to fulfill her wish.

(Source: Naver, translated)

194995.description:
Hasama Shin is a solo guy who loves being alone. He even changed jobs to enjoy his time alone after coming home, and one day, a girl living in the apartment next door asks him if he wants to hang out with her.

"It's creepy that she asked me out on our first meeting, and more than anything, I don't have time for other people! ...Or so I thought, but I was tempted and ended up hanging out with her, and she started following me around every day...?!"

A comedy about the struggle between a solo guy and a lonely girl!!

(Source: YanMaga Web, translated)

title.native: ソロフェッショナル～ソロ活男子とボッチ女子の攻防戦～
title.romaji: Solo-fessional: Solo Katsu Danshi to Bocchi Joshi no Koubou-sen
